question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurataho: Matilde ari omu mwaka gwa 5 omu ishomero erikuru. Ayine oburemeezi bwingi kandi akakuzaho okuteekateeka kw'akabonero. Aha kutandika kwa semista ya kabiri, ekiina ky'abakugu kikatunga ngu omuizi omukazi ogu ayine oburemeezi omu kutebeekanisa emirimo ye y'eishomero. Omu butumwa bw'embeera egi, ekiina kikaacwamu ngu omuringo gw'okwegyesa gushemereire kutaangwa omu nkora kwetenga kwe. Omu miringo y'okwegyesa erikukurataho, orikuza kukora aha bushobozi bw'omutwe obw'okutebeekanisa na Matilde ni guruha?
answer_a: Okuteekateeka omu mutwe: omuringo gw'okucweekamu ebintu nigwija kukorwa kuraba omu kikorwa ky'okugamba ekikozesebwa ekiteebwa Go Talk.
answer_b: Okwegamira omu mushomo: akakarenda k'entebeekanisa z'omushomo nikaija kukorwa n'obuyambi bw'ebishushani.
answer_c: Okwegyesa kuraba omu bizibu: eki nikiza kwombekwa kuraba omu kiyungiro ky'ebigambo eky'ekyuma n'eky'akabonero k'ekintu kikuru.
answer_d: Okwegyesa kuraba omu biteekateeko: eki nikiza kwombekwa kuraba omu PPT n'ebishushani hamu n'ebipapuro ebirikworeka ebiteekateeko ebyo omu muhandiiko

question: Omuhanda gw'okukora "bwanyima y'okushoma" nigumara gukora ki omu muringo gw'okwetegyereza ebi orikushoma?
answer_a: Higa omutima aha kukoresa obuhangwa bw'okuragura ebyirikubaho omu kwetegyereza ebitabo omu muringo murungi.
answer_b: Kukura obushoboorozi bw'okubaka eby'okuragura n'okugarukamu ebibuuzo ebiri aha mutwe gw'ekyahandiiko
answer_c: Kora aha bishoboro by'okukurakulana ebi orikwenda kukura nk'okuhandiika amagambo marungi
answer_d: Higa omuringo gw'okukoresa ebigambo byaawe wenka kushuuruura ebiri omu mutwe gw'ekyahandiiko.

question: Shoma omu mbeera egi: Rodrigo, omwegyesa omu butandikiro ogurikwenda omu ishomero erikukwata aha ndimi ez'omutaano, atungwa ahabwokwetaba n'okutahumuza. Nikikira kumubaho kutamara emirimo omu bwire bw'amasomo, ahabw'okuba ahinduka kuruga omu ntebe ye, akaisa ebintu by'abanywani be, nari atandika kukora omurimo ogutari gumwe n'ogu omwegyesa w'ebintu by'omutaano yaaba asabire, obutoosha yeihamu. Twaba niturora embeera erikugambwaho, omu bicweka ki ebi twine kwikiriza kwongyera amaani kugira ngu tugyezaho kukendeeza ebirikuzibira omwegyesa kwega?
answer_a: Emyemerre
answer_b: Obuzima
answer_c: Okuteekateeka
answer_d: Okworekwa omu biteekateeko

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurataho: Omu ishomero ry'orurimi n'okuhurirana, omu kiraasi eya 4, omwegyesa atongoza ekigyendererwa ky'okwega "Kuhandiika ebicweka ebirimu amakuru kugira ngu obuurize amakuru aha mutwe gw'ebintu". Eki nikyo kireetera abegyi kutoora omutwe gw'ebintu ebi barikukunda, bacereebe, bashome, kandi bakwaate amakuru agukwaataine nago. Omwegyesa aha omwegyi omwe n'omwe ekikubo ky'okutebeekanisiza ebitekerezo kugira ngu batebeekanise ebitekerezo bikuru by'ebyahandiikirwe ebi bacereebye. Omuringo ogurikushoboororwa omu mbeera eyo yaaba guri omu kiicweka ki ky'okuhandiika?
answer_a: Kuhindura
answer_b: Kuhindura
answer_c: Okutebeekanisa
answer_d: Okushushaanura

question: Omuhanda gw'okuhandiika ogurikurugamu eby'okukora, omu biteekateeko ebi orikuza kwenda, niki ekirikubaasa kuba ekigyendererwa ky'ekicweka ky'okuhandiika?
answer_a: Tebeekanisa omuringo n'ebirikukirimu omu mutwe.
answer_b: Kora okwetegyereza ebikwaata aha biri omu mutwe gw'ekicweka
answer_c: Nyetegyereza aha bitegyeko by'okutebeekanisa ebihandiiko n'omuringo ebihandiiko bitebeekanisibwamu.
answer_d: Shisha omu biteekateeko ebikuru ebikwata aha bigambo n'ebirikukirimu

question: Teeka aha mbeera egi: Bwanyima y'okushoma orubaro orurikwetwa Omukozi w'Omuruli orwa Hamelin, omwegyesa abuuza abegi: "Orikuteekateeka ekyo omukozi w'omuruli yaakozire aha muheru gw'omugani kikaba kirungi? Iwe waaba ori omuri itwe rye waakukozire ki?". Omwegyesa akabuuza abegi ekibuuzo ky'omutaano ki?
answer_a: - Okutendeka
answer_b: Kuhangaana
answer_c: Ekirikworeka omuhanda murungi
answer_d: Eihangirira

question: Eki aha ebikorwa ebi orikukurataho nibyo birikukwatana n'okukora omumwanya gw'"enyima y'okushoma"?
answer_a: Taaha emisingye y'ebirikukwata aha biteekateeko
answer_b: Eby'okurorraho by'ebyahandiikirwe
answer_c: Garukirira ebibuuzo ebirikukurahura omu kusoma
answer_d: Taaha emitwarize omu kushoma ekyahandiikirwe

question: Ni eni ahaansi ebi orikukuriraana omuringo ogu Piaget yaagambireho aha by'okwega?
answer_a: Ni muringo gw'okukuza obureezi n'obushoboorozi.
answer_b: N'ekirikuruga omu kuhaata ebi orikumanya n'ebipya.
answer_c: N'okuhindura nikwetengwa omulingo ogurikukwatanisa hamwe okwegyesereza n'okuhindura.
answer_d: Ni nkugutaanira hamwe ebyo omuntu arikurabamu ebirikumwemerera kutunga obwengye butarikuteekateekwa.

question: Ni enki aha miringo ei, erikushoborora okwegyenga orurimi kurugiirira omu biteekateeko by'abegyesi b'emitwarize?
answer_a: Omwana azaarwa aine ekintu ky'omunda eky'okugambira, enteekateeka y'omunda ey'omuntu buzima eragwa omu гене, erikumuhwera kwega n'okwegamira empindahinduka z'okuhariirira n'orurimi.
answer_b: Omwana aine obwengye obutahandiikwe omu mutwe bweeruhandi rwe, oburikumuha obushoboorozi bw’okwetegyereza n’okuzaara sentensi kurugiirira aha muringo gw’ebirikugambwa omu rurimi rwe.
answer_c: Omwana naayegyesa orurimi kurabira omu kwegyerera, okwetenga kuhikiiriza ebi yeetaaga, n'amaani agarikugumya ebi abazaire be n'ekitebe ky'orurimi omu magara ge barikumuha.
answer_d: Omwana aine okukura kw'orurimi okuhikiriire n'okukura kw'obwomeezi bwe, n'ahabw'ekyo naija kwega kugamba yaahika aha mutindo ogurikwenda omu kukura kw'obwomeezi obwo.

question: Eky’obuhangwa bw’okutunga obwomeezi, embeera y’okwegyesa ey’obuhangwa n’ey’enyimaishwa zigyana zita?
answer_a: Omwetwarize gw’obuhangwa nigugira ngu omwana ayegyesa kuraba omu kugeza n’okushobya, obwo omwetwarize gw’eby’embeera n’obuhangwa nigukora eki kuraba omu kwegaita.
answer_b: Omwetwarize nigwo guratongoza ngu ebiteekateeko nibitureebwa omu kuhinduka kw'obwomeezi, obwo omu nyegyesa y'eby'embeera n'obuhangwa, nibitureebwa omu miringo y'okuringaaniza.
answer_c: Omwetwarize nigugamba ngu okumanya kutungwa kuraba omu kuhamiibwa, shi teooria y'embeera n'obuhangwa neekatiriza okuyambibwa embeera.
answer_d: Omwetwarize gw'obuhangwa nigugira ngu okwetegyereza ensi nikikorerwa omu muringo gw'okuteekateeka, obwo omugasho gw'enyegyesa y'obuhangwa n'embeera y'abantu nigusiiga aha kutooreza.

question: Eki ekikuru eky'enyegyesa ya Vygotsky yataireho niki?
answer_a: Shuuruura obukuru bw'okubuurana n'abantu omu kukura kw'obwomeezi.
answer_b: Orikugambisa okuhiga nk'ekirikureeta omulingo gw'okwega.
answer_c: Kugamba aha kukura kw'obwomeezi omu biteera, ekurikugambwaho okutebeekanisa kw'emiramizo y'obwomeezi.
answer_d: Shobora okwega nk'omuringo gw'okutegyereza omuhendo oguhinguraine aha bi omuntu arikwega ebirikukwatanisa n'ebyo ashoberire agizireho.

question: Okurikugyenda aha biteekateeko bya Vygotsky eby'omutindo gw'embeera z'abantu n'obuhangwa, ni ndyoha aha bigambo ebi erikworeka omugisha ogu omwegyesa aine omu klasimu?
answer_a: Ateekateeka kandi oraganize ebintu ebirugiremu obwomeezi oburikwemerera abeeshuri kukuza obwengye bwabo kandi bakakuraniza obuhanga bw'amaani.
answer_b: Nyakora emirimo ey'omugashani omu ayemerera nk'omutabaganya orikukuru omu kumanyisa kw'abeeshuri n'omuringo gwabo ogw'okutunga obumanyi.
answer_c: Nikumanyisa abeeshuri obumanyi oburikumutebeekanisa n'okukuraaza emicwe ye okurikukora emirimo mingi n'okugyenda n'omuringo ogurikugyenda n'omuringo ogurikugyenda n'ebirikukora nk'omugabe.
answer_d: Atebeekateeka emirimo erikukurirana omu muringo ogurikugyenderera kandi ogurikukuraine, omubucweka oburikumuha obushoboorozi bw'okugira akamanyiso aha miteekateekyere y'abanyeshuri n'okuhinduka kwabo.

question: Shoma omuteko ogurikukurira, ogurikushoboorora ekyetengo ky'omuhandiiki omwe aha bikorwa by'orurimi: Omu biteekateeko bya saayansi ebirikushoboorora omuringo orurimi rw'abantu rurikukora harimu grama ya generative [...], eyamanywa hati nka biolinguistics. Ekyetengo eki nikiteeka ahameisho obubaho bw'ekikorwa ky'omutwe ekirikukizaarwa ekirikukwasa kureeta n'okwetegyereza ekigambo kyona omu rurimi rwona orwa butoosha, kandi nikikwasa n'omulingo gw'okutunga n'okumanya orurimi orurikugambwa gutarikwetenga bingi ebirikukwata aha rurimi ngu gukore gye kandi nikikurira haihi nk'omulingo gw'amaani. Ekyetengo eki kirikushoboororwa ahaiguru niki kya omuhandiiki ki aha bahandiiki abarikukurira?
answer_a: Chomsky
answer_b: Skinner
answer_c: Piaget
answer_d: Vygotsky

question: Shoma omubazo ogurikukurataho: Omu kiraasi ky'abana omu ishomero eririmu puroguraamu y'okwegyesa abantu boona hamwe, omu isomo ry'eby'obuhangwa n'obuteeknologia, omwegyesa ashabire abegi kukora omu butiina kugira ngu bakore eky'okureeberaho ky'enju. Kugira ngu bakikore, abaheereza ebiragiro ebihandiikirwe n'ebikozesebwa ebi baine kukozesa. Aha mirimo erikukurataho, niki omwegyesa arikubaasa kukora kugira ngu atumbure omulingo gw'okuteekateeka (metacognition) omu beegi omu bwire bw'ekiraasi?
answer_a: Shaba abeshomesa kubaza abegi kukora ekishushani ky'eky'okureeberaho eki baraayombeka hamu n'okugaba emirimo ei buri omwe araakore.
answer_b: Mugambire abeeshuli kworeka omulingo gwabo ogw'eky'okureeberaho ekibiina ekindi, kandi bagambe oku kitebeekire omulingo ogwo gw'eka eyombekirwe.
answer_c: Gambira abeshomesa kureeba vidiyo ezirikubahabura omu kuzooka eky'okureeberaho n'okuheereza oburyo obuhyaka obw'okukikora.
answer_d: Gyezaho abeeshuri kuhandiika entaanira ei bakuratizeire kukora ekitebe n'okushoboorora ezi basanze zigumire munonga n'okuhakanira ahabwenki.

question:
Shoma omwegyendereza embeera egi:
Omwegyesa orikukora n’omwegi owa P7 atandikire kukora n’omwegi ou aine oburemwa bw’obwongo. Oburemeezi obukuru ahariwe nibukwata aha kwijuka ebintu by’omumazima, okuta omutima aha kintu obwire buriho n’okutebeekanisa, kandi oburemeezi nibureebwa n’aha kushoma n’okuhandiika. Twaba nitwegyendesereza omuringo ogurikukwata aha bintu bingi n’emitwarize y’omwegi eyashobooroirwe omu mbeera egi, niki ekikuru kuteekateeka aha bintu ebi twaba nitutebeekanisa ebyokwegyera?
answer_a: Eby’obuzibu n’okwetaba omuntu omu
answer_b: Okugira omubaro n'emyeshuro y'obuhangwa
answer_c: Obushoboorozi bw’obwengye n’okwetaba omu mirimo
answer_d: Obwengye n'emitwarize erikuhinduka

question:
Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho:
Martin ni omwegyeshwa ow'emyaka mushanju orikwegyesa omu kiraasi ya kabiri aine ekizibu ky'obwongo. Abari omu timu y'ekiraasi erikukoragana nawe nibashwijuma oku arikugyenda omumaisho omu mwaka gw'eshomero kandi nibashanga ngu, n'obu hakozirweho enkyukye omu muringo gw'okwegyesa n'obuhwezi obuhairweyo, omwegyeshwa tagiireyo nk'oku kyabaire kitegyerezibwe. Ahabw'ekyo nibaija kushangaana n'eka ye hamwe n'okutebeekanisa omuringo gw'okukoragana hamwe ahagati y'enyima zombi (eka n'eshomero). Kurugiirira aha mukago gwa American Association on Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities (AAIDD), ni engyenderwaho ki egihinguraine omu kukora kw'abari omu timu y'ekiraasi ya Martin n'eka ye?
answer_a: Ekizosistemu
answer_b: Omukoro ogurikugyenderera hamwe
answer_c: Omukura ogukurukurana
answer_d: Omukura gw'obutini

question:
Okushobora kumanya obuhabuzi obu omwegi orikukwata oburemeezi bw’obwengye arikwetenga nikikwata aha kutebeekanisa n’okukoresa emiringo y’okushwijuma emwe ahu abegi barikubaasa kworeka obushoboorozi bwabo n’obumanyi bwabo kuraba omu kwega okw’amazima.
Orikuraba aha ekyo ekirikugambwa, omu miringo ki ey’okushwijuma erikukworeka obuhabuzi bw’eby’obwegyesa obu omwegi orikukwata oburemeezi bw’obwengye arikwetenga?
answer_a: Okukoresa ebipimo by'amazima
answer_b: Okukoresa ebikoreso ebirikugyeragyeranisibwa
answer_c: Okureeba omuhendo n'ebizibu by'omwana omu by'ayegire.
answer_d: Okushwijuma ebyarugiremu omu kubazisa omuntu omu biteekateeko

question:
Shoma omwegyesa omu mashomero ag'obwaana akakorera aha kigendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikukurataho okumara wiiki nka zingi: "Kwegyesa aha magara g'abakazi n'abashaija abamwe abaahwereireho omu bwire bw'enyima n'obu bw'omuri obu, bakakora ebirungi omu kitongore kyabo, omu ihanga ryabo, n'omu nsi yoona, kuraba omu nteekateeka nari n'obuhwezi bw'eby'omugisha bya ICT." Kucungura ekigendererwa eki, omwegyesa akateekateeka aha mitwarize y'abegi boona yaabaasa kushaaba abareeberezi b'abaana kutoora omuntu orikukiikirira omu byafaayo bya Chile n'okuhwera abaana baabo kwega ebimukwataho, nukwo bwanyima bashobora kukora omuzano gwa leedio, omuri buri omwe atwaare omugabo ogurikubahwera kubaririra ebyafaayo by'abantu abaatoorainwe.
Omwegyesa naareeba omurimo ogu nk'omugisha gw'okucungura ekigendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikukwata aha kutuurana omu bumwe n'obwenegura: "Kwooreka embabazi n'obumwe omu mbeera ezirikutunga abarikwegana nari ezirikureebwa omu bitabo nari ICT, bakora ebikorwa by'okuhurikiza, obuhwezi, n'obukorani."
N'okuteekateeka aha murimo ogurateekanisiibwe omwegyesa, niki ekirikukirayo kurungi kucungura abegi?
answer_a: Okugumisana hamwe omuntu n'ondiijo
answer_b: Okwebuza
answer_c: Okweyesuuma kw'abandi
answer_d: Okuteera omucweko n'akakiiko k'abantu abarikukuratira omuntu.

question:
Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurataho:
Amalia ari omu mwaka gwa kabiri kandi ahabwa obuhwezi kuruga omuri puroguraamu y’ekuteerana omu ishomero, ahabw’okuba aine oburemeezi bw’omutwe. Omu ishomero, azirikiirwe ahabw’okuba omushaanzi, orikukora, kandi orikukora ebintu, kwonka obumwe atendekire kwetantara, eki nikimureetera kwetangaaza omu mbeera ezirikubiisa. Omu isomo ry’Ebyafaayo, Eby’obutwaare, n’Ensi, omwegyesa ariyo naashoma ekigyendererwa ky’okwega “Kwetegyereza, kuteerereza, kukoresa, n’okushoboorora obukuru bw’amateeka agataaine kuburwa kwetantara embeera ezirikubiisa ezirikukwatana n’obuteekaniza bw’engira.”
Kurugiira aha mbeera eri ahaiguru n’okurugiira aha biteekateeko by’omuringo gw’eby’obutonde, n’omuringo gw’okushoma ogurikukurataho nigukwatanisa okushoma ekigyendererwa ekirikushomwa?
answer_a: Tebeekanisa n'abeeshuri orugyendo rw'okwegyesa omuhanda omuhanda omu itungo, abetabise omuri rwo bakolese ebi baayegire aha bikwata aha bubonero bw'engira.
answer_b: Abeekusomesa omuri ক্লাসি kutebeekanisiza omukura gw'ebintu omu bitoogo by'eshomero ebirikworeka obukuru bw'ebirango by'omuhanda n'akabi akurikurira hamwe nabyo.
answer_c: Kora emizaano n'ebikorwa ebindi ebyetaagisa abagyetabamu kumanya obubonero bw'enguuto obw'omutaano, nga okweyambisa embeera ezirimu omu bwomeezi obwa bulijjo, ebyokukozesebwa nga tukozesa ICT.
answer_d: Kora hamwe n'omwegyesa w'emibiri, omuringo gw'okutendeka omubiri ogurikwetenga okuhitsya omuhanda ogurimu obubonero bw'etraafiki ebi oteekwa kushoborora omu buringaaniza okuhikiiriza orugyendo rw'okutendeka omubiri.

question:
Shoma omuzingo ogurikukurira:
Gabriela ni omwegi omu mwaka gwa kashatu kandi aine oburemeezi bw’omu bwongo. Omu biteenwa bye, arikwetenga obuhwezi kwikiriza obwengye bwe (arikubaasa kubukuumira kumara edakiika 3 kuhika 5), ekirikimugumira kutandika n’okumaliriza omurimo; kandi arikwetenga obuhwezi obutahwera kumanya eki ashemereire kukora omu kiraasi (obutwaaro obu emirimo eine obutaanwa obukira obubiri nari obushatu) kandi, aha rubaju orundi, obutoosha asherura okusiimwa kw’abakuru ahabw’okutaguma.
Nikiraganisibwa ebiteenwa bya Gabriela, ekikundi ky’omu kiraasi nikiteekateeka omuringo gw’okukora ogurikukurira:
- Okuhwera kwikiriza obwengye aha murimo kurabira omu kucwekyereza ebintu ebiri kumutwara obwengye omu mbeera ye.
- Okumuha “Omugisha gw’omurimo” ngu, omu bweeru, abeasa kwebuzya aha ntunguuka ye atakagendire omu maisho.
- Okukakasa ngu ayetegyereize ebiragiro kurabira omu kubigamba kandi, omu kubumbura omurimo, okubaho ekyakozirweho obwo ngu obwengye bwe bugume aha bintu ebikuru.
Nikiraganisibwa embeera ezo, niki ekirikusiimisa obuhangwa bw’omuringo ogurateekanisiibwe?
answer_a: Omuringo ogu nigwija kuhikiiriza ebi omwegi arikwetenga, ahabw’okuba nigutwarizaamu obuhwezi bw’okwetegyereza ebiragiro n’omukuruzo gw’ebiteekateeko ogurikumwebembera omu kuhingura omurimo gwoona nari ekikorwa kyona eki ashemereire kukora, niguhiga kuhangaanisa embeera n’entebeekanisa eziramuha kuhikiirira omuri ebyo.
answer_b: Omuringo ogu nigwija kuhikiiriza ebi omwegi arikwetenga, ahabw’okuba nigweshongora aha miringo y’okuta omutima aha bintu egi eri omusingi gw’ebikorwa byona eby’obwengye: okuta omutima aha kintu kimwe n’okugumizamu. Kandi, niguha obuhwezi butahurugire n’obw’omuntu bwite, nigutwara omu biteekateeko obwire bwe arikumara ata omutima aha kintu, obu ni obuhwezi bukuru bw’emico ya Gabriela y’obwengye.
answer_c: Omuringo ogu nigwija kuhikiiriza ebi omwegi orikugambwaho arikwetenga, ahabw’okuba nigweshongora aha miringo y’okutunga ebintu omu bwooro, kandi nigwegyesa okukura omu kweyamba n’emitwarize y’okwetegyereza, ebi bireetera okwetegyereza obwengye bwe hamwe n’oku arikukoramu ebintu ebi atungire, ekirikukonyera omu kwireetera emitwarize erikukura.
answer_d: Omuringo ogu nigwija kuhikiiriza ebi omwegi arikwetenga, ahabw’okuba nigwija kuteeraho ebintu bikuru eby’omumutwe ebi arikwetenga obuhwezi omuri byo. Kandi, niguhiga obwetegyeki n’okwetegyeka omu miringo egi erikuhiga embeera z’omutwe ezirikumuha obushoboorozi bw’okukurikiranira haihi oku arikukora ebintu kurugiirira aha mugasho gw’omurimo gwoona nari omukoro.

question:
Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho:
Omwegyesa w'abaana abaine oburemeezi bw'omutwe nayenda kukuza obwengye bw'abaana abarikworeka oburemeezi bw'omutwe. Kuti kukikora, nk'ekicweka ky'emirimo ye, naija kuteekateeka omugisha. Kurugiirira aha mbeera eyo, omu mirimo egi erikukurataho, omu ki omwegyesa arikukorera aha bwengye?
answer_a: Mugabe: Reeza, obu obu ni omuryango gw'aha muhanda ogurikwenda, nyoreka ahu orugyendo rurihwera. Hati bikore iwe wenka orikuronda omuhanda ogurikutuura aha orugyendo rurihwera.
answer_b: Mwegyesa: Reeberaho, oshemereire kureeba omugisha ogu omu buringwa bwa maizi oreebe ngu aha niho h’okutandika kandi aha niho h’okuhendera (n’okwoleka). Oshemereire kukuratira omuhanda ogu nari oguriya?
answer_c: Omugyezibwa: Eki n'ekihita, nomanya ekihita kiri ki? Orakikora? Nokikunda? Hati oshemereire kukuratira omuhanda ogurikukutuura kuruga omwihuriro. Buri obu orakore enshobi, hindura ibara ry'ekaramu.
answer_d: Mugyezaho: Reeba omuhanda ogurikwenda, ogushoboorore. Ego, harimu emihanda etari emwe, kwonka gumwe nigwo ogurikwiija kukuhitsya aheeru. Nooteekateeka ngu oshemereire kukora ki? Noobaasa ota kushanga ogwo muhanda? Waamara kumanya gwoona, taaha omushwiija ogwo muhanda.

question:
Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho:
Omwegyesa w'abaana abaine oburemeezi bw'omutwe nagambira nyina w'omwana ogwo ngu, okushobora kumanya obuyambi obu omwana arikwetaga, bashemereire kwesigama aha bintu bitari bimwe nk'okumanya embeera y'eka nk'omulingo eshomero ririyo omu maka, ebi abazaire barikwenda ngu omwana abe akigaireho, obushobozi obu atungire, omukago gw'omwana na banywani be na begesa, emikisa y'okwetaba n'obuyambi obu ekigo kirikumuhaire kubaasa kwetaba omu by'omushomo.
Kurugiirira aha byamanyisibwa ebi, omulingo gw'okucweekereza n'okushobora obuyambi bw'omwana nigukorwa omuhanda guliha?
answer_a: Omuringo gw'eby'obutonde oburikukora n'omikro-sisitemu yaagwo hamu na meso-sisitemu yaagwo
answer_b: Omuringo gw'okwegyesa ogurikukwata aha miteekateeko n'obwengye bw'omwegi hamwe n'ebicweka by'okukora omukoro gw'okukungaanya amakuru agariho.
answer_c: Omuringo ogurikukwata aha bintu bingi n'ebicweka ebirikukwatanisa n'embeera y'omwana erikukuraho.
answer_d: Omuringo gw'okwegyesa ogurikukwata aha mbeera n'ebintu ebi biri omu butonde ebi birikukwata aha mbeera y'omuntu kwega.

question: Shoma omuzingo ogurikukurira: Kevin ni omwegi oine oburemwa bw’obwongo. Abeera omu kiraasi ya kana omu ishomero eririmu puroguraamu y’okwegyera hamwe. Obwezirikiro bwe nibukirira aha kuteeraho omutima, ahabw’okuba bumara obwire bw’edakiika 3 kuhika 5. Obwo obwire bumwe, n’agonza obwezirikiro aha kwijuka ebintu n’okutebeekanisa. Eki nikireeta okuzibu okutari kumwe, nk’okukora ebibazo by’okubara. Twaba niturora embeera ya Kevin, omwegyesa w’okwegyera hamwe nashaba omwegyesa w’ekiraasi engyenderwaho ezirikukurira: Obu otakatandika kukora ekibazo ky’okubara, ijutsya omwegi entarikwa z’okukurataho kukora omurimo ogwo kandi ozikoree nk’oku ekibazo kirikukorwa; bwanyima, boona hamwe, bashemereire kuteeraho ebigyendererwa biryabire bikuruukuru ahabw’entarikwa ezirikushabwa; omu bwire bw’omurimo, yamba omwegi kukora enkoresa y’okutwara ebi orikwenda kwijuka kwandika ebintu ebirikwetagisa kukora ebibazo by’okubara. Twaba niturora embeera egi, ni engyenderwaho ki ezirikukurira ezirikuhakanira okukoresa engyenderwaho ezirikushabwa?
answer_a: Emi engyenderwaho negyenda kureka Kevin kutandika n'okumariza omurimo, kuta omanya bwona oburikwetagisa, atarikusaanya amakuru agurikwetaga kukora, kuteekateeka oku araagukore, n'okukurikiraniza aha ku araabe nagenda aha kiragiro.
answer_b: Emi engyenderwaho neja kwikiriza omwegiisa kwetantara aha bintu omu bwira burikurengaaho, hamwe n'okumanya ebintu by'omugasho kuruga omu bitari by'omugasho omu bibuuzo ebi ahaweirwe, narukurinda kugarukamu ebibuuzo arikukozesa engyeso y'okugeza n'okushobora.
answer_c: Emiteeka ei turikutebeekanisa neeyija kuhwere Kevin kureetera obwengye bwe kukora gye, nukwo kimworobere kukunganya amakuru agurikwetagisa kukora ebibuzo by’okubala, kimuhwere kumaliriza buli omwezi.
answer_d: Ebiragiro ebiragisiirwe nibiza kuhwera omwegi omu kushoborora embeera z'obwengye n'ez'okwetegyereza ezirikubaasa kukoresibwa omu kukuza ekizibu kyona ekireetsirwe, okutebeeka entebeekanisa erikutebeekanisiza okukikora n'okukikiriza omurimo okumarizibwa.

question:
Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurikira:
Camila ari omu giraade ya 5 kandi ahabwa obuhwezi kuruga omu kitongore ekirikukwatanisa abantu hamwe, ahabw’oburemeezi bw’eby’omushomo oburikuruga omu kuteebereza kwe ngu aine oburemeezi bw’obwengye. Hati, Camila nashoma ebyahandiikwe ebirikureenga omu bureingwa, kwonka aine oburemeezi aha mutindo gw’okwetegyereza, na munonga omu kwihamu eki bari kugambaho. Omu isomo ry’Orurimi n’Okugambirana, omwegyesa ari kukora aha kiragiro eki: “okushoma n’okwetegyereza ebyahandiikwe ebitari by’obuhangwa byenyine”, omu muringo ogu, amakuru. Twaba niturora ekigyendererwa ekigambirwe, oruhe rw’emirimo erikukurikira nirwo rurikukwatanisa gye omu kukuza obwengye bwa Camila obw’okukurikiranisa amakuru?
answer_a: Shoma omu bishangwa omu makuru reero okore omukyeeto orikurora ebyabaireho eby'omugasho munonga n'abantu abakuru abarikukwata aha mutwe gw'ebishangwa.
answer_b: Shoma omu bizooba by'amakuru orikukoresa omuringo gw'okushara n'ekyaranzi, nooshara enshonga nkuru n'ebintu ebirikugambwaho omu mweshongoro.
answer_c: Shoma amakuru orikukirizibwa n'ebibuuzo ebirikukwebembera ebirikworohereza okukungaanya data, okumanya oburemeezi, emikwatane n'ebyarabiremu, n'ebindi
answer_d: Shoma omukura gw'ebyahandiikirwe by'amajanja n'okukora akatebe k'obwengye kuruga omu mikago eyashimwirwe ahagati y'ebintu ebirikukirayo obukuru n'ebirikubaho ebirikugambwaho omu byahandiikirwe.

question:
Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurataho:
Mateo aine emyaka 15 kandi aine oburemwa bw’obwongo. Ni muntu ow’omukago mwingi kandi akunda kuhurira omuziki n’abanywani be, okutega ebifaananyi, n’okukoresa app aha ssimu ye. Emyeezi mikye enyima, Mateo akagamba ngu nayenda kwega okuza aha bbaasi kuruga omu ishomero okwija omu ka, nagira ati: ndi mukuru okumara obutoora aha motoka y’abaana. Okugarukamu okusaba kwe, ekibiina ky’omu kicweka kikaikara n’omurezi we kandi bakikirizana kuta omulingo gw’okutambula gwa bwonyini ogurikwija kuteekateeka okukoresa ssimu nk’obuhwezi bw’okuhanganisa embeera ezirikubaho omu rugyendo.
Kurugiira aha muheru ogu n’okutwara omulingo ogw’emitwarize mingi nk’eky’okureeberaho, ni nshonga ki aha zirikukurataho erikukirayo kwikiriza okucwamu kw’omulingo ogwatwirwe ekibiina ky’omu kicweka?
answer_a: Omuringo ogwo gukomeza okukuza obwengye bwa Mateo bw'okuganiira n'obw'enyabantu kuraba omu kukoresa esimu nk'obuhwezi.
answer_b: Omuringo ogu twatooraine nigukwatanisa okukuza obureezi bw’okwetegyereza, nibuhikiiriza ebi Mateo arikwetenga omu bantu n’okwetungira ahaiguru.
answer_c: Omuringo ogu twatooraine nigwo gukozesa tekinologia ezirikuhwera nk'obuhangwa bw'okushagika, nigwo guhikaho Mateo omu kweyamba.
answer_d: Omuringo ogu twatooraine nigutwara omu maisho ebi Mateo arikukunda n'ebimureetera kukora, omukutwara hamu n'okukoresa esimu nk'obuhabuzi oburikwija kumworohoza omu rugyendo rw'eibaasi

question:
Shoma omubaire omu:
Ekikundi ky’abeeshomo omu kiraasi ey’omukaaga nikyenda kukuraho okwetaba kw’abeeshomo kurora ebyo baayegire omu ishomo lyabo kumaliriiza eizooba ry’eshomo. Okukora eki, bakashaba abeeshomo kubaza ebyo baayegire kumaliriiza ishomo, baitu obutoosha abato bayegire nibo barikwetaba. Omurundi ogundi, bakakoresa “emigogo y’ebibuuzo,” baitu abeeshomo bake barikwetaba, ahabw’okuba abandi bakagamba ngu tibarikumanya eky’okugarukamu rundi tibarikugarukamu ahabw’ensoni.
Ni ngyenderwaho ki ey’eteknologiya erikukiraho kwemerera okuhurirana n’okwetaba omu ishomo eli?
answer_a: Poroguramu ahu omwana weena asobora kuhurra ebiragiro omu bwomezi, hamu n'okubisanga bihandiikirwe, ahabw'okukora emirimo omu labu y'ekikoompyuta
answer_b: Poroguramu ahu abeeshomeri barikubaasa kutaaho ebibuuzo nari okugarukamu, kandi aha muheru gw'eklassi, tiimu y'eklassi neebaasa kubyoreka, baahandiika enshobi, kandi bagaba eby'okubahabura
answer_c: Puloguramu ahu abeeshuri barikubaasa kugarukamu ebibuuzo omu bwabo kandi aha muheru gw'eklassi, tiimu y'eklassi neebaasa kureeba lipooti y'omutwaro gw'ebirikugyendererwa ebi batungire.
answer_d: Poroguramu omwegyegyesa arikwohereza emirimo n'ebikorwa omu ishuri abanyeshuri kukikorera kimwe kandi bagyeranisya eby'okugarukamu ebirungi ebihairweyo nk'obuhabuzi

question: Omuhurikiirwe omuringo ogu: Omwojo orikukura omwaka munaana aine oburemeezi bw’omutwe, orikwenda omu ishomero ry’abaine oburemeezi, aija omu ishomero aine obucafu n’emiziizo mibi omu butoosha. Obutoosha ashutama ahaitaaka kandi tarikukwatanisa na banywani be ab’omu kiina. Omu murimo ogurikwebemberwa omwegyesa, omuri abaana baragizibwe kureeba omu ndeeberwamu kwongyera okugamba ebigambo ebirikugattwa, omwojo agaanisa munonga kureeba omu ndeeberwamu, eki kimureetera kutateerwa kandi akakora ebintu ebirikumukora kubi. Okugarukamu omuringo ogu, omwegyesa ataaga nyina w’omwojo kwetaba omu kiina yoona, kumwikiriza kucwamu emirimo kandi akahiga omwojo kumwegaitaho. Omu mutindo gw’amagara marungi, nk’oku kiragizibwe ekibiina kya American Association on Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities (AAIDD), ahabwaki okucwamu kw’omwegyesa kukwatanisa n’omulingo omwana arikwegamu?
answer_a: Ahabw’okuba omwana naija kutunga obumanzi bwingi bw’okukora emirimo egi etegurirwe.
answer_b: Ahabw'okuba ab'eka baryaija kugarukamu ebi omwegyesa arikukora omu ka, kandi omwana naija kwega.
answer_c: Ahabw’omuringo ogurikukoresibwa maama ogu nigwija kubaasika kukoresibwa omu kicweka ky’ekyegyeso.
answer_d: Ahabw’okuba embeera z’okukora ebintu nezigyezibwa hamwe omu mbeera zoona ezoombi

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Paulo ari omu mwaka gwa 3 ogw’eshomero kandi aine oburemwa bw’omu bwongo. Oburemwa bwe obukuru buri omu bintu ebirikukwata aha rurimi n’okuhurirana, okukira munonga omu bintu ebirikukwata aha kushoma n’okuhandiika, ahabw’okuba tamanya eiziina rye rihandiikirwe omu mazina amaingi, namanya akahandiiko k’enjwekyera zimwe, n’eddoboozi erikubanza ry’ebigambo by’erikubanza n’enjwekyera ezi arikumanya. Ayenda munonga okuhandiika kandi ebi arikukora biri aha mutindo gw’okuhandiika ogutakahandiikirwe enjwekyera. Omwegyesa nayenda kutandika kumuhwera omu kuhandiika kandi ashaba obuhwezi kuruga owa special education. Kuruga omu muringo gw’okwegyesa ogwa constructivist ogw’orurimi oruhandiikirwe, ni miringo ki erikuhwera Paulo kutunga obuhangwa bw’okuhandiika?
answer_a: Okukora kuruga omu iziina rye, okubanza oyorobanise enyuguta ahabw'okuba amazi, nk'eky'okurorraho a na p, reero omworeke ebigambo ebindi, birikumpiirira n'ebishushani ebirimu enyuguta zimwe; omuhe omugisha gw'okuhandiika iziina rye omu buryo obuhikire kandi agyende omu maisho omu kwega enyuguta nkuru ezirimu.
answer_b: Muhe omugisha gw’okuhandiika iziina rye; muhe akatabo k’okukora omurimo gw’okwongyera aha ka, orikurimu ebigambo ebirikushushana n’ebyo arikukunda, ngu abe n’ashobora kukopiinga n’okushoma enyuguta ezo arikumanya, hamwe n’okumuheereza enyuguta ezirikuhuriirwa nk’oku zirikugambwa ezizo atarikamanya gye.
answer_c: Muhe obuhwezi kuruga omu musomesa orikukwata aha by’abaana abaine oburemeezi bw’okwega omu mashomo agatari gamwe, kumuhwera kuhandiika ebigambo birikwera, kumugambira enyuguta ezi arikumanya n’okukoresa orutindo rw’enyuguta orwine ebishushani aha mesa ye; muhwere omu kwega kwe n’ebipapura by’okukoreraho ahu arikukora n’enyuguta nkuru ezi atarikukimanya gye bwanyima mutandike n’enyuguta nkye nk’eza m, p, na l.
answer_d: Muhweereza omuhendo gw'okukora ebintu omu obusinge bw'enjwebwa z'enyigirizi z'arikumanya, kuraba omu kubaho kw'ebifo by'okushoma (eshomero n'eka), ahu ebipande ebirimu amazina g'ebintu ebiriyo birikuteerwa; kurora aha kuhandiika kuraba omu kuheereza emigisha erikushushaane kandi omushabe kuhandiika nk'oku arikuteekateeka ngu nikwo kushemereire, nooha ekitiinisa eby'ahangiire kandi nomubuuza ebibuuzo ahabyo.

question:
Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurira:
Sofia ari omu mwaka gwa kabiri omu ishomero erikuru, aine emyaka mwenda kandi omu isomo ry'Orurimi n'Okuhurirana, omu mutwe gw'okushoma, nabasa kumanya eiziina rye erihandiike n'ebihandiiko ebitandika n'enjwekyerwa; omu mutwe gw'okuhurirana omu kanwa, nabasa kwetegyereza ebiragiro biryoha n'ebyahandiikwa biryoha ebirikumushomerwa, naruga omu kanwa kugarukamu n'ebigambo nk'ego nari ngaha, n'ebirikukwata aha byetengo by'okurya, obweresi, n'amagara, nibiherekerwa n'obubonero. Okuruga omu kanwa kwe nikushagikirwa n'ekikopo ky'okuhurirana. Omwegyesa we yateekateeka kukora aha mugingo gw'okwega ogurikukurira: Kworeka okwetegyereza kw'ebyahandiikwa ebirikushomwa, kurugamu amakuru agirikwerarikira n'agahisire. Okucungura nikwija kuba kw'okugamba ebyabaireho omu muringo gw'okugamba.
Ninkuratira omugingo gw'okwega ogugambirwe, niki aha hindura z'omurongozi ezirikukurira ekirikukwata aha kwikiriza ebyetengo by'obushagikiro ebi Sofia arikworeka?
answer_a: Muhemu ebishushani by'omugani, asobole kugugamba kuruga aha kutandika kuhika aha muheru
answer_b: Eky'okubuuza ebibuzo ebirikugarurwa omuhanda gumwe, ebirikugyenderera kugarukamu ebyagambirwe, eby'okugarukamu biri egooba nari si egooba.
answer_c: Muhe obupapula n'ekaramu ngu ashoobore ebyagambirwe, bwanyima obuuze ebibuuzo ebirikugyenderera kushuuruura ebyabaireho omu muko gw'ekiganiiro.
answer_d: Mutwarire omu kibina ky'abanywani, omu murimo gw'okushushana ebyahandiikirwe, obagambire kushushana ebyafaayo kuruga aha kutandika kuhika aha muheru.

question:
Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurira:
Isabeli ari omu mwaka gwa 3 ogw’eshomero kandi afayo kuruga omu kitongore ekirikukwatanisa abantu hamwe omu shomero rye ahabw’okuba aine obuhabuzi obuhikire ahabw’oburemeezi bw’obwengye obutari bwingi. Ayoreka okukunda kwingi emirimo y’eshomero. Omu isomo ry’ekibalangulo, omutwe ogurikukwata aha Nkora y’Eihanga y’Esheeri nigwija kworekwa, eki nikireetera abazaire ba Isabeli okutangara ahabw’okuba obwahati ashooroire kwongyerera hamwe emirimo etari y’amaani omu bubare kuruga ahari 0 kuhika 50.
N’okurikira aha mbeera eri ahaiguru, ni muringo ki ogurikukirayo kuhikira okuhiga okwega n’okukoresa enkora z’ekibalangulo ezirikukora Isabeli?
answer_a: Genda omu Isabeli aza omu bintu ebirikukorwa omuhanda nari akore omu itendekero, ahu arikubaasa kukoresa amagezi n'obureezi omu kwegura n'okutunda n'okumanya emibaro omu mbeera za butoosha.
answer_b: Tebeekanisa "akatale k'eby'okubanza" n'obuhereza kuruga omu bwire bw'abantu boona abari omu ishomero, ahu Isabel n'abanywani be barikubaasa kuteeka omu nkora obwomeezi oburikukwata aha kukoresa ebicweka by'esente n'empapura z'Eshente y'Eihanga.
answer_c: Omuzaano gwa "Monopoly" gutebeekanisibwe nk'omutindo ogutera kukozesebwa, aha muheru gwa buri kiraasi y'ekibalangulo, nk'omuringo gw'okugumya obwengye bw'Enteekateeka y'Eihanga y'Emihendo, kuraba omu murimo ogushemeire kandi oguhiga abeeshuri.
answer_d: Teeka enyikirizo y'emyolesyo erimu emirimo egikwata aha Muringo gw'Eshente y'Eihanga, omuri yo harimu n'emirimo y'okukyusa n'okuringanisa, okutandika n'emyolesyo omu bwingi bw'emibaro obu Isabeli amanyire, oburikugenda nibwongyera obugumu.

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurataho: Danieli ni omwegyesa omu mwaka ogwa kana omuishomero, aine oburemeezi bw’obwengye. Aha bi arikukora gye harimu obushoboorozi bwe obw’okutwara abantu n’okuhurirana nabo, arikusherura n’okushemererwa omumigisha y’okubuurana n’abanywani be n’abakuru, nangwa n’obu arikuba ahikire abantu abatarikumanya. Omu isomo ly’Ebyafaayo, Jografia, n’Ensi n’obwomeezi bw’abantu, Danieli abaire aine oburemeezi obumwe okwetegyereza emirimo n’obujunaanizibwa bw’abamwe ab’obushoboorozi omu bitebeekaniso by’eby’obufuzi n’obutegeki bwa demokarasi omu Chile. Twaba niturora omuhanda gw’okukora ebintu omu bwomeezi, oruheko orurikukurataho nirwo rurikukwata aha byetengo bya Danieli?
answer_a: Rekooda vidiyo erimu dramatizasiyoni z'abakuru ab'obuyinza ab'ekikuru omu bitebeekaniso by'eby'obufuzi na demokulasiya omuri Chile, omu buri mukozi w'eby'obufuzi arikushoboorora obujunaanizibwa n'emirimo mikuru ei buri omwe ashemereire kukora.
answer_b: Koresa ekikwaikuru ekyakozirwe hamwe omwegyesa w'ebyafaayo n'omwegyesa w'abana abaine oburemeezi, ekirimu obuhweerezi bw'abakuru ab'omutaano omu kutebeekanisa esomero rye, ekirimu ebibuuzo ebikwata aha bintu bikuru ebi barikukora.
answer_c: Tebeekanisye eky'okubaanisa aha bantu ab'obushoboorozi abarikukwata aha itungo rye eirikumwegyerera haihi, nk'eky'okureeberaho, omukuru w'eishomero, purezidenti w'akakiiko k'abanyeshuri, omubazi w'eklassi, n'abandi, kurugiirira aha kubuuza oku kubabuuriza aha mirimo yaabo n'obujunaanizibwa bwaabo.
answer_d: Ha omuhanda gw'abakuru ab'eby'obufuzi abakuru omu ihanga kandi oye omu kicweka ky'ekicweka ky'ekicweka ky'eishomero okushaka amakuru agarikukwata aha mirimo yaabo n'ebikorwa byabo, omu mutindo gw'entebeekanisa y'eby'obufuzi na demokarasiya ya Chile, kandi okuruga ahari ekyo, tebeekanisa orugyendo n'obuhwezi bw'ekipande

question:
Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho:
Omwegyesa w’ekika kya mushanju owa Mathematics omu ishomero naija kutandika kukora aha kigyendererwa “Kworeka okwetegyereza ebintu ebirikugyenda omu muringo gumwe n’ebirikuhinduka.” Omu banywani b’ekika eki harimu Andreas, ou orukurataho kuruga omu puroguraamu y’okwegyereza hamwe ahabw’oburemeezi bw’omutwe. Andreas akunda munonga okwootsya emigaati, ekimureetera kwesherura omu banywani be, ahabw’okuba obutoosha agabana emigaati nk’emikeeka, empai, n’obukuki n’abanywani be n’abegyesa, ebi arikutebeekanisiza hamwe na mukuruwe.
Kurugiirira aha muringo gw’okukora ogurikurugiira aha biteenwa by’obwomeezi, niki eki orikuteekateeka ekirikukiraho kureetera Andreas kwega ebintu ebirikumugasa n’okuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ky’omwegyesa?
answer_a: Ha abaana omwegereeso ogurikugambira aha ntambwe ezirikukuratirwa omu kutebeekanisa ekyokurya, kirikushagikwa n'ebishushani ebirikwongyera aha kwetegyereza eki hamwe n'omugatte gw'ebintu ogurikukoresibwa.
answer_b: Tukorere hamwe okukora akatabo n'abegyesi b'eky'omubaro n'abegyesi ab'enjuraano, omuli emirimo n'okwegyesa ebikwaata aha mugano ogutangaana n'oguhindukire, omu mbeera y'okuteeka emmere, ahabegyesi boona.
answer_c: Gamba abeshuri abamwe, omuri bo na Andreas, kukora vidiyo z'okworekwa omu ishomero, nibereka nibateeka emicwe yabo omuka, niberekana omuhendo ogukozirwe n'empiinduka ezigizirwe obu omuhendo gwahindurwa.
answer_d: Shaba omuhandizi w'eby'okurya, orikwija kweta abeeshuri omu kicweka ky'okutebeekera eby'okurya omu ishomero, aharikwija kuteeka eky'okurya kicweekye, naagumisiriza aha bukuru bw'emigabo. Bairaareeba ekirikubaho emigabo y'ebirikuteekwa omu ky'okurya yaahindurwa.

question: Shoma omushomo ogurikukurataho: Omwegyesa owa ক্লাসে ey'abegyegwa b'omwaka ogwa kabiri omu ishomero eririmu Enteekateeka z'Obwegyesa Ezegataire ashaara kukora aha mugingo gw'okwega ogurikukurataho: "Kumanya omugasho gw'emirimo nk'engendo, obuhabuzi, n'akatale omu kugasa abantu." Eki nikishemereire kuteekateekwa ngu ক্লাসে harimu abegyegwa babiri abarikugira oburemeezi bw'omu bwongo, abarikumanywa ahabwokukora emirimo yaabo omu muringo ogurikukora. Twateekateeka aha miringo y'ek ক্লাসে, oruhe rw'emirimo erikukurataho orurikukwatanisa obwegyesa obw'omutaano?
answer_a: Omugyezibwa naayoreka vidiyo erikukwata aha mirimo etungiire abantu omu kitongole, reero asaba abeeshuri kutoorana ogu baraakunde kutandika nagwo; omu muringo ogu baatooraniize, omugyezibwa naabaha amakuru arikukwata ahari gyo arikukoresa obusaani, nukwo bashobore kuza kukora akapande bakoresa ebintu bitari bimwe.
answer_b: Omugyezibwa nayoreka abaana ekaadi ezirikworeka ebishushani by'ebintu ebirikukozesibwa omu kwenderera, omu kubuurirana n'omu kutunda, yaabaasa abaana kukora omukago, buri omukago guhondeho ekintu kimwe kuruga aha bishushani ebi, gurondereho amakuru agirikukwataho. Bwanyima y'okukundaania amakuru, baine kureeta orupapura rw'ebyo barikwenda kworeka, nibakozesa ebishushani n'empapura ezirikworeka ebi barikwenda kumanyisa.
answer_c: Omugyezaho nashoborora emigisha nk'okutwara abantu n'ebintu, eikatale, n'okuhurirana, arikweta abanyeshuri kureeba vidiyo erikukwata ahari byo. Bwanyima, bahandiika omu buuku bwabo oburikugira omukuru gwabyo. Eky'ahaheru, nibaha orutindo ahari emigisha eyashomwa nibakoresa ebikoreso by'okureeba n'okuhurira.
answer_d: Omugyezibwa naayoreka abana oburemeezi obutali bumwe obw’omuri obutoosha nk’obw’engendo nari obw’amashaza kandi abana bakatsyuba oburemeezi obu barikumanya kurungi. Abegyi bashemereire kucweekereza enshonga ezirikubaasa kukoresibwa kuraba omu maka gaabo nari omu itungo ryabo, bwanyima bakakora enyikiriza n’enshonga ezirikubaasa kukoresibwa kandi ezirikukora.

question:
Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho:
Ekibiina ky’abegi ab’omu mwaka ogwa 7, ekibiina eki kirimu obwenzi munonga, nikiraga okutwara kubi embeera y’abegi baakyo ahabw’okuba harimu abegi babiri omu kiraasi egi abarikugumirwa kwetegyereza ebi barikugambirwa, nk’eky’okureeberaho, obu baraabe nibahabwa ebiragiro nari okushoboororwa aha bintu ebimwe.
Omu mbeera y’okukuratira emicwe erikwatanisa abantu boona, ni engyenderwaho ki ehi erikukirayo kuba eshemeire kumara ebyetengo by’abegi abari omu mbeera egi eyagambirweho?
answer_a: Omurimo nigwija kwesigamizibwa aha muringo gw'okukoragana (okwegyesa abandi n'okukora omu bibinja), ahabw'okuba embeera z'eklassi nizikora ekyo kishoboka, omu kwongyera aha kwetegyereza omurimo n'ebirikuragirwa.
answer_b: Omuringo ogutari gumwe ogw'okuza omanya ebintu nigwija kuhangwa kandi okukoresa amagezi g'omutwe n'okwetegyereza nigwija kworekwa, nukwo buri omwe arikubaasa kwetegyereza gye eki omwegyesa arikwenda kumanyisa.
answer_c: Omuri buri kasumi ekyorekwa kirikuhairwa, omwe aha bakuru abarikukora omu class azookyerera abegi kureeba obwengye bwabo, kandi obuhwezi oburikwetagisa nibuhaibweho kworekereza okutahurira kwabo.
answer_d: Omwegyesereza omwegyesi omukuru aryegyesa abegi abarikugira oburemeezi, naayambaza okwetegyereza ebiragiro n'ebirikwegaanwa bisya, kwongyera aha kwetaba kwabo n'okwega, obwo kyetaagisa kyona.

question:
Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurira:
Felix ari omu razide ya 3 kandi natunga obuhwezi kuruga omuri puroguraamu y’okwegamira y’eishomero, ahabw’okuba aine obuhwezi obw’omutaano ahabw’oburemwa bw’obwengye. Ekintu kimwe eki Felix akunda munonga ni okushushana, n’ahabw’ekyo obutoosha orikumureeba naaba naakora ebishushani by’ebintu byoona ebirikumutaata. Omu isomo ry’Ensi n’ebintu ebirimu, omwegyesa aine ekigyendererwa ky’okugyenda aha kigyendererwa ky’okwega: “Kureeba no’kushoboorora, kuraba omu kunoonyereza kw’okugezesa, ebi ebiti birikwetenga n’omukago gwabyo n’emirizi, ekikondo, n’amababi,” arikukoresa orubari rw’eishomero nk’obuhwezi oburikukwatanisa, oru abegi barikwija kutaayaayira buri sande.
N’okurikurira aha mitwarize ya Felix n’emisingi y’okusesa ebirikukwata aha mazima, ni muringo ki gw’okusesa ogurikukwata aha kigyendererwa eki kirikugambwaho?
answer_a: Okushumbura ekipande eky'enyongane erimu ebishushani n'amashagamaizi agirikukwata aha byareebirwe omu musiri
answer_b: Okushumbura ekishushani ekyakozirwe kurugiirira aha kureeba ekimera ekitoroirwe omu musiri gw'eishomero
answer_c: Ebirango ebirimu ebitabo by’ebyahandiikwa bya buri sande ebikwata aha byarorwa omu musiri, hamu n’ebishushani n’obuhandiiki bw’ebyarorwa omu musiri
answer_d: Omugambirizi ogurikukwata aha kimera eki orondireho n'ebishushani nari PowerPoint erimu ebifaananyi n'obushoborozi buri bumpi

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurataho: Marcelo, omwegyesa owa 7, aine oburemeezi bw’omutwe, ahabwekyo atunga obuhwezi kuruga omuri puroguraamu y’ekishomojo y’eishomero. Omu myaka, atungire obunywani n’abegyesa bagyenzi be abarikumuhereza obugumiizi oburikwetagisa kwetaba omu kwoleka omu maisho g’abegyenzi be. Kwonka, omu mbeera ei arikureebana n’abantu abatarikumumanya, nabaasa kureebeka nk’omunyara kandi naabaasa n’okutayenda kwegaita. Nk’ekicweka ky’okukuza Omubizo gw’Ebitabo, omwegyesa we arateekanise okwoleka omu isomo ry’Orurimi omu maisho g’amasomo gandi g’eishomero. Kutiisa omurimo ogwo, yaatooraine ekitabo ‘Omwana Omuto,’ ahabw’okuba n’ekimwe aha bitabo ebi Marcelo n’abegyesa bagyenzi be barikukunda munonga. Twaba niturora emitwarize ya Marcelo n’omurimo ogurateekanisiibwe omwegyesa, omu nkyukira ezi orikukurataho, engyenderwaho z’okutunga n’entebeekanisa y’ensi yoona zikozesiibwe omu muringo murungi?
answer_a: Omugyezibwa naateekanisa omurimo arikurora emiringo ebiri y'okwetaba: amajwi agarikootwa kare n'okushushana okurikukorwa omu bwire obwo, kandi asaba abeeshuri kutebeekanisa n'okwehandiikisa aha murimo gumwe aha mirimo egi ebiri.
answer_b: Omugyezibwa naateekanisa omurimo ogundi ogw’okuhindura ahabwa Marcelo, amugambira kweteekateeka orutaro oruhango aha kitabo ‘Omwana Omuto’, oru arikubaasa kwooreka omu kiraasi, omu maisho g’abanywani be.
answer_c: Omugurusi w'orurimi aha Marcelo omugisha gw'okutebeekanisa n'okuhanga, hamwe n'abanywani be abamwe, eby'okubanza ebirikwija kukoresibwa kwongyera amaani omu mizano, arikukora eki arikurora ebi omwegi arikukunda n'obuhanga bwe.
answer_d: Omugurusi naaha omwegi orikumwegyereza, ekirikubaasa kuba omunywani we ow'ahaafi, kumuhwera na kumuherekeza Marcelo omu mirimo erikukorerwa omu maisho g'amasomo agandi, ahabw'okuba omu muringo ogu, omwegi naija kwehurira kurungi.

question: Okurikuratira omuhanda gw'okuteekateeka, ni kirikukurata aha bigambo ebi nikyo kirikuhikaana n'endengo y'okukura kw'orurimi?
answer_a: Nikigira ngu okukuura kw'orurimi nikwetenga omulingo gw'okukuura ogukumireho omu bice by'obwomeezi ebindi ebirukugwasa kukurugura.
answer_b: Nibirikwenda ngu okukuura kw'orurimi nikweyimbiirwa omu mikoranire erikukorwa omu bantu n'obushangwa bwabo
answer_c: Ekiragura ngu amaani agari omumotoka y'orurimi rw'omwaana nigasangwa omu kwegyerera eby'okureeberaho by'orurimi n'okuhwera okuhendwa abakuru.
answer_d: Nikyooreka ngu okukuura kw'orurimi nikubaho ahabw'okubaho kw'ebintu ebirikuzarwa nabyo ebirikutebeekanisa ebirikureetera omuntu kukunda orurimi.

question:
Shoma omubazo ogurikukurataho:
Ekikundi ky'abegyesa omu kiraasi ya kashatu nibateekanisa isomo ry'ekibaro ahabw'okushobora kumanya omulingo abegi barikukora omu kubaza. Okukora eki, nibateekanisa obwomeezi bw'okwega oburikukwata aha mulingo abegi barikukora n'ebyetaago byabo boona omu kiraasi, nibahereza ebintu ebirikwetagisa okubahiga kwetaba omu isomo.
Ni obwomeezi ki oburikworeka omu mulingo ogurikuhikire okukoresa emisingi y'okuhikaana n'enteekateeka y'okwega ey'omunsi yoona?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza ebitebe ebirikukyusa omurimo gw'obuhanga bwona oburikukwata aha kwongyera, abeeshuri bashemereire kukora emirimo omu omwe n'omu butiima nibakoresa ebintu ebirikukwatwaho, ebirikushushana, nari ebintu ebirikwolesa obuhangwa.
answer_b: Nibarikira kushuuruura omwegyesa ogurikwegamira aha baine omugasho gw'abeeshuli aha kucuura ebizibu by'okubaaza, noobaha obuhwezi bw'ebishushani n'okubaha eky'okureeberaho aha kutandika kw'omurimo.
answer_c: Nibakora oruteeka orukusomesa ahu bareetera embeera erimu oburemeezi erikwetenga okubaasa kw'okwingana, abeeshuri bashemereire kushoboorora oku baataireho eky'okugarukamu. Nibakoresa omuringo gw'okubuuza "enkoni z'omutaayi" (popsicle stick questioning) kureetera abeeshuri boona kwetaba omu kiganiro.
answer_d: Nibarikora omurimo ogurikugambira aha kugura n'okutunda ebintu, ogurikwetenga okukoresa okubisa. Kureetera buri omwe kwetaba omu murimo ogwo, obugumu bw'emibuzo nibuhindurwa kukurugiira aha mbeera y'omwegi orikugumirwa munonga omu isomo eryo.

question: Omuhwezi w’omwana orikwegyesa abaine oburemeezi bw’okushoma, Soledad, omwegyesa w’omu mwaka gwa kabiri, arikugamba ebigambo ebi aha muranzi owa Soledad, arikumuha lipoota y’okukura kw’omwana: Omu maani agabonwa omuri Soledad omu kasumiro akabanza, okuteeraho kwe omu mirimo y’okushoma, okukunda ebintu ebirikubonwa, n’okuteeraho kwe kwega kushoma nibimanyisa. Kwonka, akagumizamu kutoorana omu mirimo ei arikuba asaana kumanya enyigizo ezirikukora ekigambo ekiri omu sentensi. Akatoorana kandi kumanya ebigambo ebirikutaandika nari birikuhwa n’enduru emwe, kutoorana ebintu ebirikutaandika n’enjuga ei turikukora, n’okucwekyereza n’okukora ekigambo ekirimu enjuga ei turikwenda. Ni muringo ki gw’okuteekateeka ogu omwegyesa orikwegyesa abaine oburemeezi arikugambaho arikushoboorora ebi Soledad arikwetenga kumuhwera?
answer_a: Okukuratiirira omutima gwawe omuringaanize
answer_b: Kushobora kutooroora ebintu omu maisho
answer_c: Okumanya eby'amajwi g'orurimi
answer_d: Obushoboorozi bw'okushoma ebigambo

question: Shoma omwana Mateo, orikweshomesa omu mwaka gwa kabiri kandi aine oburemwa bw’okwega, ashoma omu ishomero eririmu enteekateeka y’okumushomesa nk’omuntu. Omwegyesa we ow’abaana abaine oburemwa bw’okwega nagira ngu omwegi asobora kwetaana ebigambo, kwonka n’obu ahabwa obuhwezi, tasobora kubiteebereza omukigambo. Aha rundi, omwegyesa we ow’omuklassi nagira ngu Mateo ahemerwa omu mirimo erimu okukurata entekaniza y’ebintu. Okukurata amakuru aga, omwegi ayetaga obuhwezi omu ki?
answer_a: Okukora ebirikukwata aha bigambo
answer_b: Okuteera aha murulirizo
answer_c: Okwetegyereza kuraba omu matwi
answer_d: Okutegyeka ebiragiro by'orurimi

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurira: Ekikundi ky'omu kicweka ky'abanaishomero abari omu mwaka gwa kabiri, omu ishomo ry'Orurimi n'Okuhurirana, nibakora omurimo ogurikukurira: 1. Okushoma hamwe 2. Akunda kutaayaaya, kuhumurirwa eby'omubazi, n'okukungaana enjugu ezirikugwa kuruga omu miti.  Kurugiirira aha ekyo ekyorekwa, niki ekirikwetagisa okushagika eki Emilio arikworeka?
answer_a: Shanga amakuru agarukire aha bantu abarikukorera omu mutwe gw'ebyahandiikwa
answer_b: Shangaaza ebiri omuhandiika ebikwata aha bintu ebyabaireho
answer_c: Kuruga ebi orikubaasa kumanya omu mutwe omuhandiike
answer_d: Shobora omukago gw'obwire n'obugarukiro aha bikorwa ebiri omu mutwe gw'ekicweka

question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurira: Ekikundi ky’abegi omukiclass ya 4 omu ishomo ry’orurimi n’okuhurirana nibashaba abegi kuhonda ebigambo bishatu ebirikumanywa obuhangwa nibabishobora omu kuhandiika orukundo. Ana, omwegi aine oburemeezi bw’okwega, nahonda ebigambo ebimuli, emiti, na bururu, natandika omulingo gw’okukora ebyahandiikwa bye. Omu mutendera gw’okushooka, omugurusi w’abegi abaine oburemeezi akazoora ngu omwegi akashooka ebiri aha omu kabooki ke: Omubwire obwahwereireho hakaba hariyo enju ya bururu eyabaire nungi munonga, ekaba eri omu orubuga kandi ekaba etwireho eshemerire hamwe n’ebitungwa byayo. Akaba aine embwa erikuru erairu n’empaka ezaire zikazana n’emiti n’ebimuli bye. Omu bintu ki ebirikukwata aha kuhandiika ebi Ana arikurwanisa oburemeezi obukuru?
answer_a: Endagaano y'ebyahandiikirwe
answer_b: Okutebeekanisa ebintu omuhanda gwabyo
answer_c: Okutangatangana n'okwegatta
answer_d: Ekyombeko n'ekigyendererwa ky'okuhereza amakuru

question: Shoma omubaire: Ekikundi ky'omuklassi ky'abeesika ya kana omu pulayimare, omu isomo ry'Ekibaro, nikikora omurimo ogu abeeshuri baraabe baine omutaano oguhikire gw'okugura ebintu. Ebiro by'ebintu ebirikugurwa nibyorekwa aha bboardi kandi nibahabwe orupapura orucapirwe kwandika ebirikukorwa. Abeeshuri, omu bwabo, baine kutoorana ebintu batarikurenga aha muhendo ogurikugambwa. Omu kubarinda omurimo ogu, omwegyesa orikukora n'abeeshuri abarikwetenga obuhwezi naagira ati: "Nshemererwa okubareeba nimushemerererwa kandi nimukora, mujjukire ngu omu rupapura orubahairwe harimu taabulo erimu ekaati kwandika emihingo n'ekaati endiijo y'omutaano gwona, ndebire ngu nimubiteera hamwe byona. Obumwe nibatoorana ebintu ebirimu emihingo erikukira, eki nikyo kibareetera kurenga aha muhendo ogw'okubanza, mugezeho obundi." Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, niki ekirikwetengwa abeeshuri kukwasibwa munonga?
answer_a: Okwebembera n'okweshomesa
answer_b: Okuteebereza n'okutebeekanisa omuhendo
answer_c: Okubara hamu n'okukora emirimo erikukirayo obuhangwa
answer_d: Okuteekateeka omuhendo n'okumarayo obwire obwingi nooteera ahari ekintu.

question: Shoma omu mbeera egi: Omu bwire bw'okukorera hamwe kw'ekibiina omu kika kya 2, nikiteekwa haihi ngu okwega kushoma n'okuhandiika nikuza kukorerwaho nikukoresibwa emiringo erikushoborora okwegyesa ahabw'okugarukamu okuzibu abegi abarikugambira omu muringo gw'okushoma. Ahabw'ekyo, nibarikiriza ngu omwegyesa w'abegi abaine oburemeezi aza kuseruliiriza engyenderwaho ezirikuruga omu muringo gw'okucweekamu. Kurugiirira omu mbeera egi, ni engyenderwaho ki omwegyesa w'abegi abaine oburemeezi arikubaasa kukoresa kugarukamu okuzibu kw'abegi?
answer_a: Manya, orikumize, hamara amazina g'enjojo omu butumwa, okutandika n'enjojo ezirikwenda kutaayaaya enjojo ezitarikwenda kutaayaaya
answer_b: Yega omugano gw'ebihara n'ebigambo, orikugenda orikwongyera aha miringo y'omugano ogurikubaasa kukorwa kurabira omu kwegaita kw'ebihara.
answer_c: Manya omuhendo gw'ebigambo kandi obiteeze, okubanza obitaaburemu enyigirizo zaabyo nk'oku zirugire, okwa kabiri obitaaburemu enyigirizo zigumire, hanyuma obitaaburemu enyuguta zaabyo.
answer_d: Koresa ebigambo nk'emitwaro y'okugambira hamu n'okwetegyereza, orikuruga aha bigambo birikwenda kumanywa omu bwangu kuhika aha birikugumire.

question: Shoma omugani ogurikukurira: Ekikundi ky'abeeshuri omu kika kya 2 nikikora n'abeeshuri baakyo aha muhanda gw'okutunga obushoboorozi bw'okushoma n'okuhandiika kurabira omu muringo ogwa "global method", ogurikukunda okumanya ebintu ebiriho nk'ebimwe omu bigambo n'omu sentensi. Kwonka, abeeshuri abamwe aha mutindo ogu bahikiremu oburemeezi omu kicweka ky'okubanza "okucweekereza", okukiraho omu kumanya enjwi n'ebicweeka by'ebigambo. Noorekire omuringo ogwa "global method", mugisha ki ogurikukwata aha kwega okushoma n'okuhandiika omu beeshuri abarikworekwa omu mugani ogu ogwabanzire?
answer_a: Handi ebigambo ebirimu enjatu eziri kumwe nk'oku bandikopiire omu bukwomi bwabo
answer_b: Baza ebibuzo ebirikugyenderera, ebirikukoresa emirundi mingi ebigambo ebirikwegwa.
answer_c: Eta ebintu ebiri omu kikaali n'amazina gaabyo, basome ebigambo byabyo nibashuubangaanisa amajwi.
answer_d: Ekirango by'ebigambo ebirikworeka ebicweka ebirikushushana ebi ebigambo ebyo birimu

question: Alicia, omwegyeskuru omuri ক্লাssi ya 3, aine oburemeezi omu muringo gw'okwegyera obureezi n'okuhandiika. Okugarukamu ekyo, omwegyesa w'abaana abaine oburemeezi bw'okwega ateekateeka kwegyesa buli herufi omu buringo oburikworekwa, naaza aha bigambo, sentensi, n'ebyahandiikwa; n'ekyo nikyo kigambirwa ngu n'omuringo gw'okwega ogurikugyenda mpola mpola kuruga aha kumanya amakuru g'ebyahandiikwa okuhika aha kwetegyereza ekyahandiikwa, nikitindika aha muringo gw'okuhandiika. Kurugiirira aha ky'okureeberaho eki, n'omuringo ki gw'okushoma n'okuhandiika ogurikukurata omuringo ogukozesibwe omwegyesa w'abaana abaine oburemeezi bw'okwega?
answer_a: Omuringo gw'okwetegyereza omuhendo gwona
answer_b: Omuringo ogwegyendereize
answer_c: Omuringo gw'okuhandiika ogurikukoresa obubonero oburikwimira amajwi
answer_d: Omuringo gw'obuhangaazi

question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurataho: Ekikundi ky’abasomesa omu kiraasi ey’omunaana omu ishomo ry’ebyobutonde nibatebeekanisiza hamwe n’abanyeshuri baabo okushoma omutwe gw’ebyamagara ogurikukwata aha butima bw’akantu (cell), kwenda kugarukamu ebibuuzo ebirikukwata aha mutwe ogwo. question: Omu klasa y'ebya butonde, abanyeshuri abari omu mwaka gwa mushanju nibakwatanisa ebyabaire nibyegwa omu mutwe gw'okwegyesa ogurikukwata aha by'obushwere n'okufaaho omubiri gwabo, kuraba omu kuhandiika ekyeshongoro ekirikugizibwa ebicweka bishatu, omuri bo barikushoboorora ebintu ebi barikureeba nk'ebikuru kukoreraho. Ekikundi ky'abanyeshuri omu klasa, nibareeba omulingo omuhandiiko guri kugyenda, nibareeba ngu Eduardo, omunyeshuri aine oburemeezi bw'okushoma, atarikugumisiriza, konka arikumanywa ahabw'obuhangwa bwe omu kuhandiika, naabaasa kugumizamu aine oburemeezi omu kwongyera kwega ebintu. Omwegyesa w'abanyeshuri abaine oburemeezi acwireho kutahakanisa Eduardo omu kuhandiika kwe, kutahwerekyereza ebi arikuteekateeka, konka naamanya ngu ashemereire kwetantara omu kubihindura. Eki nikireebeka, ni bumwe aha mulingo ogurikukwata aha kukora na Eduardo omu kubihindura omu kuhandiika?
answer_a: Mushaba kumushaba akore omugyigizo omu paragrafu emwe yoonka y'eki ahandiikiise omu mushaho gwe ogw'okubanza.
answer_b: Mugambire amanye kandi aronde endimi nkuru eziri omu bitundu by'ebyahandiika bye.
answer_c: Mute omwete, ahingurire kandi atondekanye buri kamwe aha bice ebi orikukoraire.
answer_d: Mugambire kumwebembera ebirango by'okugyendererwamu ebi akozeseze kwenda kutebeekanisa omukuruzo gw'ekicweka kye.

question: Omu kubanza, kikuru kukora aha kutebeekanisiza abaana abarikugyenda kureeba ebyahandiikirwe eby'omu bwire bw'ahaire. Omu kukora eki, nikikuru kutebeekanisiza abaana aha bintu ebi baraayegyeho omu byahandiikirwe ebi. Eki nikibaasa kukorwa omu kubagambira eby'omu bwire bw'ahaire, okubereka ebishushani, nari okubagambira eby'okuroraaho ebirikukwata aha nshonga egi. Eki nikibaasa kuhwera abaana kwetegyereza ebyahandiikirwe ebi n'okubihuumurizamu.
answer_a: Yolesa vidiyo erikukwatana n'omutwe gw'ekigambo, erikuhwereera aha biri omu mahano g'ebyafaayo.
answer_b: Kukora aha bigambo by'omutaano ebiri omu izooba ly'ebyafaayo kugira ngu oyongyere abeeshuri obwengye bw'ebigambo.
answer_c: Emyogyeso y'okukoresa okwetegyereza kurugiirira omu bintu ebirikworekwa obuhangwa bw'ebyafaayo
answer_d: Haandiika ebiri omu by'obuhangwa obundi omu Latin America kubaasa kumanya enshaanju n'ebyahandiikirwe eby'ebyafaayo ebyashomwe.

question: Omuhwezi w’ekicweka ky’orurimi n’okuhurirana omu kiraasi eya 7, ekikundi ky’abegyesi kishwijuma embeera y’omutindo gw’abanyeshuri kandi kishanga ngu kiraasi egi neetaaga kukuza okukunda kushoma n’okwongyera amaani omu mirimo y’okushoma omu maka. Kuruugiira aha kizibu eki, omwegyesa ow’omutaano asaba okutandika ebibiina by’okushoma, ebirikutebeekanisibwa kurugiira aha ebi abanyeshuri barikukunda, ahu emirimo erikukorwa, nk’okurundaaniza aha kitabo ekirikushomwa n’okushoma hamwe, n’ebindi. Kurugiira aha biri ahaiguru, niki ekirikureetera omwegyesa kucwamu kutandika ebibiina by’okushoma?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza omikorere y'obwomeezi
answer_b: Nibarikiriza okwetegyereza ebi orikushoma
answer_c: Nibarikurabanganisa okwetaba omu murimo ogwo
answer_d: Nibagumya obushoboorozi bw'okuhuurana n'abandi

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurira: Ekibiina ky'abeeshomero ab'omwaka gwa kabiri, omu ishomo ry'Ekibalo, kireeba omweeshomesa orikugira oburemeezi bw'okwegyesa omu kubara, ayoreka oburemeezi omu kushanga namba ibiri ezirikugattwa hamwe, zaaba zihikire aha muhendo ogurikumanywa. Nk'eky'okureeberaho, obu arakuuzibwe kushanga namba ibiri ezirikugatta kuhika omu ikumi na ibiri. Omweeshomesa kandi aine oburemeezi omu kwega obu aheebwa obwingi bw'ebintu kandi yaakuzibwa ngu ebindi binga byetaagisa kuhika aha bwingi obundi, nk'eky'okureeberaho, obu arakuuzibwe kumanya ebyoya binga ebiri kwetaagisa kuhika omu ikumi, yaaba aine bishatu byonka. Ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurira erikukwataana n'okugyendaana n'oburemeezi oburikugyendera omweeshomesa ogu?
answer_a: Kukora ahaire omuburyo oburikwemerera kurugiirira omu kwolesya omuhendo gw'omubazi aha ruteera rw'emibazi
answer_b: Kukora aha ekishushani ky'emikorere y'ebibarizo orikurugiirira aha kumanya emitwarize yaabyo
answer_c: Tebeekanisa obusingye bw'okukora ebintu omuhanda ogurikugaruka kuraba omu meza y'okureeba ebirugiremu
answer_d: Kora omukago gw'omutaano gw'enamba orikukwatanisa ebintu ebiri omu butonde

question: Omu omukuru omu class ya Mathematics, team y'abanyeshuri abari omwaka gwa 3 omuri puroguraamu ya Gastronomy bari kukorera hamwe n'abanyeshuri aha bikorwa by'omugano. Omu kubakurikirana, omwegyesa mukuru akagira ngu ekibiina ky'abanyeshuri kirikugumirwa kwetegyereza okuteekateeka kw'omugano, narwo omuri obumwe aha muhendo ogurikushushana. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, ni engyenderwaho ki aha hansi ezi erikukwata aha kucuura obugumirizi bw'abanyeshuri?
answer_a: Teekateekire ngu noobaasa kukora omugaati murungi kurungi orikukoresa ekicweka ky'ekikopo kimwe eky'omushana n'ebikopo bibiri by'obutta. Waaba nooyenda kukora omugaati mwingi, oine kukoresa ota omushana n'obutta? Shoboorora oku orikubaasa kuhindura omuhendo gw'omushana n'obutta okukora omugaati mwingi kandi ogumeho nigwo gumwe.
answer_b: Kukoresa ebintu ebirikukwatwa omubiganja kurora emigaruro y'ebintu ebirikukoresibwa omu kicweka ky'ebyokurya omu kubitebeza.
answer_c: Yegyesereza omuringo gw'okubara emigabo buri obwire, noohamya aha muhendo ogwabuzire kushemerereza emigyerero y'ebyokurya.
answer_d: Koresa omumeza gw'omugabo, orikureeba emikago etari emwe n'emwe aha bungi bw'emigabo n'ebirikozesebwa omu kufumba.

question: Shoma omubazo ogurikukurataho: Ekikundi ky'abanyeshuri ab'ekitaano omu kiraasi y'Ekibaro, nibakora aha mugingo gw'okwega: "kucumura ebizibu kuraba omu miganuro n'obutamanya omurundi gumwe erikukwatanisa okwongyera n'okucwa kuraba omu bishushani n'omu muringo gw'ebimanyiso." Kucumura ekizibu ky'ekibaro kuruga omu magara ga buri izooba, ekikundi ky'abanyeshuri omuri kiraasi nikikora aha myemerero y'emiganuro n'okubara, nibareeba ngu Antonia, omunyeshuri orikwoleka oburemeezi bw'okwega omu kubara, nakora eki: Omyemerero ogwateirweho ekikundi ky'abanyeshuri omuri kiraasi: 2 + x = 7 Okugarukamu kw'omunyeshuri: 2 + x = 7 â 2 + x = 14 Ni muringo ki ogurikukirayo kuhikiraana kukwata aha bwetaago bw'obuhwezi oburikureebwa omu kugarukamu kw'omunyeshuri?
answer_a: Yolesa ekikwataganyo aha minzaani, noohamya amakuru g'obubonero oburi omu myoleso.
answer_b: Teekateekateeka, gamba nti twine ebinyagano 15. Twagala kubigabana omuhendo oguringanire aha bantu 3. Buri omwe azaakwatamu bingahi? Teekateeka omu mutwe kandi onshoborore oku orikutunga eky'okugarukamu.
answer_c: Yoreka omurungo gw'ekicwecwe aha murongo gw'emibaro, noohamya okwetegyereza omuganyulo gw'emibaro.
answer_d: Gyerondera omukyekwa omu biteera ebirikwetagisa kukorwa, noohamya okumaririza kw'emikorere.

question: Omuhanda ki ogurikukiraho obuhikire okukoresa aha kureetera omwegi kukuratira embeera egi?
answer_a: Kukora emizaano y'obwongo kwongyera amahe za okuteekateeka omuhanda gw'okuteekateeka n'okumaraho ebizoobu omu kubara.
answer_b: Kukoresa ebintu ebirikukwata aha misho gye kutunguura obuhangwa bw'okubara n'okuhameza ebirugiremu omumwa n'omuhandiiko.
answer_c: Koresa ebirango by'okubara kumumanyisa emiteekateeko etakahikirire egirikwata aha kwega okubara n'okuhiga omuhendo
answer_d: Mukoreshe omurongo gw'emibaare ogurikwenda kwimurwa kumuhwera kwetegyereza emico y'omuringo gw'ebitaro ikumi n'omuringo ogugwo ogutebeekaine omuhandiike.

question: Ekibi y’ekiro gya 4 omuri eshomero bashemereire kutebeekanisa omurimo omu isomo ly’Ekibaro ogurikukora aha Kiragiro ky’Okwega: "Kupima obureingwa n’ebipimo ebirikukwatagana n’okuhindura aha butungi bw’ebipimo ebi." N’okurora aha rumwe, obutarikukunda kwega obu abegi barikwoleka, n’aha rundi, obwangyezi obu ekirasi eine kukora hamwe, ekibi kicurira kukora omurimo gw’omukago omuhanda y’ekirasi ahu abegi bashemereire kutoorana ebintu ebirikugyerera nk’empande nyingi ebirikusangwa omu shomero yoona, kubipima, n’okuhandiika obureingwa bwabyo kwonka kucuurira amakuru n’okuhindura aha butungi bw’ebipimo. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, ni enshonga ki aha zirikukurataho erikuhakanira omuringo ogurikukoresibwa ekibi y’ekirasi?
answer_a: Nikorahoza okwegyendesereza kw'abeeshuri omu kwega kuraba omu mbeera z'okwegyesa ezirikukwatana n'obwomeezi bwabo
answer_b: Nikiriza abeeshure kukwatanisa omu murimo, kuraba omu kutaana-taanisa embeera z'okwega
answer_c: Nikiriza okukura kw'orurimi n'ebishushani ebikwatanisa n'ebyetengo omu kubumbura n'omurimo ogukorerwa omu mitwe n'okukuratira embeera.
answer_d: Nokukura abegi kwegumira omu miringo etari emwe ey'okwega.

question: Ekibi y’ekika ky’abanaishomero ab’eky’omutaano, omu bwire bw’okukorera hamwe, bashanga ngu oburemeezi bukuru bw’abanaishomero omu kubara (Mathematics) buri omu kicweka ky’ebishushani (Geometry), ahabw’okuba nibata omutima aha kushiisha ebishushani kandi tibarikumanya obureingwa bwabyo, engoro, n’omubazo gw’empande, n’ebindi, ebi byetaagisa omu kubishobora omu maisho. Ahabw’ekyo, omwegyesa w’abaana abaine oburemeezi, arikurora ngu ekika kine obushoboorozi omu kukoresa ICT, ashohora kukoresa puroguramu ya kompyuta y’ebishushani ahu abanaishomero barikubaasa kurora ebishushani omu muringo ogutari gumwe. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, ni enshonga ki aha zirikukurataho erikuhikiiriza eki omwegyesa w’abaana abaine oburemeezi arikushobora?
answer_a: Nikirikukwasa kusheshemura ebiri omu kushushaniro kuraba omu kureeba ebishushani by'omutindo gw'ebintu.
answer_b: Nikirikukolesa kwetegyereza empindahinduka z'ebishushani by'omutindo oguhendekeire.
answer_c: Nikirikukwasa kureeba ebintu by'omutaano ebiri omu bishushani by'omutindo.
answer_d: Nikiriza kwetegyereza emitwarize y'okukyusa ebindi by'omubazi by'ebishushani.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Ekikundi ky’abanyeshuri ab’omwaka ogwa 7 omu ishomo ry’orurimi n’ebitabo nibaija kukora aha kwetegyereza ebihandiiko n’rapooto ezirikworeka amakuru. Kuti kukora eki, twarikurora embeera y’ekibiina n’abanyeshuri abaine oburemeezi bw’okushoma, omwegyesa w’abaine oburemeezi bw’okwega nashaba kwongyera omu nteekateeka y’okwegyesa emisingye y’Enteekateeka y’Okwegyesa Eyanguhire egiurikukwata aha kwegaita kw’abanyeshuri n’emitwarize n’okugambira hamwe okutari kumwe. Kandi, nashaba kukuza omurimo gw’okutebeekanisiza omu banyeshuri. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, ni engyenderwaho ki aha ezirikukurataho erikurora ebi omwegyesa w’abaine oburemeezi bw’okwega yashaba?
answer_a: Yoreka omutwe gw'ekigambo kuraba omu maapu y'ebiteekateeko, shaba abeeshuri kuteekateeka omu bibiina, kandi okore okweyeshaho nk'omuntu omwe aha muheru gw'omurimo.
answer_b: Yolesa omutwe gw'ekiganiro abeeshuri kuraba omu vidiyo, ebishushani, n'ebyahandiikwa birikukiraho obuhupi, oreeke omutwe kuraba omu muzano, reero oteekeho ekigyendererwa ky'omukago ahabw'okukura kw'omurimo.
answer_c: Yoorozaho omutwe ogurikukwata abeeshuri omutima, oreebire ebi basomire omu mweshongoro, orw'ebyakushangwa, rundi omu rureeto, reero okore orutonde lw'ebyo baine kukora kubaasa kureeba ebi basomire.
answer_d: Mugambe aha mutwe ogurikutegyerezibwa, osabe abeeshuri kukora vidiyo erikushoboorora omu muringo gw'ebiteekateeko omwe barikukora omu kiraasi, kandi omuhereze vidiyo egi omu kiraasi orikukoresa ebibuuzo by'okwetegyereza.

question: Shoma omu mbeera egi: Ekikundi ky'abegyesa omu kiraasi ey'omwaka ogw'okubanza omu secondary kigyenda kukora n'abeeshuli aha mutwe gw'eky'okureeberaho ky'omutaano gw'abashaija n'abakazi, omubo bagyenda kutebeekanisiza omuzano. Omu kasumi k'okutebeekanisa okwegyesa, omwegyesa ow'abeeshuli abaine oburemeezi naatekateeka aha biteekateeko bya Cristina na Carlos, abeeshuli abazindwire oburemeezi bw'okushoma, oburemeezi bw'okugamba omu kanwa n'omutima mubi aha bikorwa by'ekikundi. Eki nikireebwa, ni bumwe aha miteekateeko egi oburikukirayo obuhangwa bw'okukwatanisa okwegyera n'okwetaba kw'abeeshuli bombi?
answer_a: Yoreka abeshomesa ebiri aha vidiyo by'emyeteekateeki y'ebishushani by'omuzano, obatekateekere omukumo gw'ebintu ebirukukwata aha muringo gw'abakazi n'abashaija omu muzano, haza obareke bakore omurimo ogwo nk'omuntu omwe.
answer_b: Shaba abeegi kwandika oku baabaire nibagenda nibakora n'oku baakozire bwanyima, kuraba omu bifaananyi nari obushushani, obagumye omutima ahabw'okuhinduka n'okuteeraho oku baahikireho, kandi obegyese emiringo erikushoborora.
answer_c: Shwijuma abegi kureeba vidiyo ezirikukuririza ezirikukwata aha kukorera hamwe omu timu, ohe abegi emiringo n'oburyo oburikubaasika obw'okwetaba omu kuzannya n'okutebeekanisa enshobi ezirikubaasa kubaho omu kuhandiika n'okugamba.
answer_d: Teeka abeshomesa omuringo gw'okwetegyereza, oreebe ebibiina by'okukoragana ebiine ebigyendererwa n'obujunaanizibwa oburikworekwa omu kuzoora omuzanyo, kandi otebe omuzanyo orikukoresa emiringo etari emwe ey'okwehangira.

question: Shoma omwana w’eky’okushatu omuhandiko gwe gukomereire kandi aine oburemeezi bw’okushoma n’okubara, akomeireho kugumirwa n’obu abegyesi barikukoresa emiringo etari emwe ey’okwegyesa. Agumirwa ahabw’okuba ebi arakuuga tibirikushomeka gye kandi akahindura enyuguta n’emibaro, ekimureetera kukwatwa ekiniga ahabw’okuba atarikwetegyereza oku akorire n’ebirikuruga omu mibaro ye. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, kiki eki twine kukora kumuhwereera omwana ogu?
answer_a: Kwikiriza okumaririza eby'okukora omu kamwa.
answer_b: Koresa ekikoreso ky'abakasi kwolesya omuhendo gw'emibaro.
answer_c: Koresa namba n'obubonero by'omugyegyezi aha kaadi enyeru erikugyezibwa.
answer_d: Mureke abeesomesa bakozese ekibalangulo omu kuza kw'emyolesyo.

question: Ekibi y’eky’omukura owa Saayansi omu klasse y’omwaka ogw’omukaaga nigwenda abegi baabo kushoborora obukuru bw’amaani ngu nibukwasa ebintu kuhinduka n’okukira ngu ebiramu nibagyetaga kukora emirimo yabo ey’obuhangwa. Kutiija ekigendererwa eki, nibateeka omu nkora engyenderwaho ez’omutaano ez’okwegyesa, nibagenderera omu miringo etali emwe ey’okutebeekanisa abegi n’okwetaba kwabo omu bwingi, ahabw’okuba ezi nizo bushobozi oburikukirayo omu muraano ogu. Omu butumwa obu, ni engyenderwaho ki ezirikukurira ezirikukwata okuteeka omu nkora twarikureeba ekigendererwa ky’okwega n’obushobozi bw’abegi?
answer_a: Mushomere omu kibina aha by'amaani n'omugasho gabyo omu miringo y'obwomeezi y'ebintu ebiriho.
answer_b: Tebeekanisye omuzingo gw'okushwijuma ogurikworeka omugasho gw'amaani kuruga omu by'omugasho ebya buri izooba aha birimu amagara
answer_c: Murembe omukono gw'okushushaniisa omu kibina ogurikwetenga emigari y'amaani etari emwe, omuringo gw'okugitebeekanisa, n'okuheereza kwayo.
answer_d: Mukoze omugure gw'okucereeza ogurikworeka ebirikukurataana n'amaani omu bintu ebiriho n'ebintu bitari bimwe na bimwe

question: Shoma omubaire: Ekikundi ky'abegyesa omu kiraasi ya 2 kikaba nikikora n'abegi baabo aha mutwe gw'okwegyesa ogurikukwata aha bantu abatuura omu ihamba rya Atacama, omuri gwo baine kushuuruura emitwarize y'amahanga g'abantu ab'omuriika abaatuuraga omu kicweka eki eky'ensi. Ahabw'okukura kw'entebeekanisa, omwegyesa w'enjegyereza arikuteekateeka okubaho kw'abegi abaine oburemeezi bw'okushoma, abarikukirira oburemeezi omu kwetegyereza ebi barikushoma, munonga omu buhairwe oburikukwata aha kuringaanisa n'okutaana kw'ebirikukuratirwa. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, n'omuringo gw'okutaana ki ogurikukirayo obuhangwa okutwarwa omu ntebeekanisa y'okwegyesa?
answer_a: Yoreka eby'okureeberaho ebirikworeka emitwarize y'abantu abaabaire nibatuura omu Rwengyerero rwa Atacama rw'obu, otaashe abareebi kubamanyaho.
answer_b: Yoreka vidiyo erikworeka buri tauni eyaatuuraga omu ihamba rya Atacama ery'obunaku obu, kandi oteeze abeeshuri kukora orutonde rw'ebintu ebirikumanyisa buri tauni.
answer_c: Shoma eby’afaayo ebirikukwata aha mbeera y’abantu abaabaire nibatuura omu Rwacumita Atacama orw’omuri obu bwire, reero oteeze abegi kugyeragyeranisa ebyo by’afaayo.
answer_d: Yoreka ebishushani ebirikukwata aha mbeera z'abantu ababaire nibatuura omu Rwangaano rwa Atacama orw'omuri obu, oohamye abegi bakore akatabo k'okugyeragyeranisa aha buri omwe.

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurataho: Gabriela ni omwegi owa 5 omuishomero erikuru aine oburemeezi bw’okushoma oburikukwata aha kwega, aine oburemeezi bw’okwetegyereza ebi arikushoma, obw’okuta omutima aha kintu kimwe, n’okukora n’amaani. Oburemeezi bwe nibureebeka muno omu isomo ry’Orurimi n’Obuhangwa, ahu arikwangana kuhuuka, agamba omwegyesa arikushoboorora, kandi tarikumariza emirimo. Ab’ekibiina ky’omu kicweka, bwamara kukoresa engyenderwaho ezirikushushana hamwe n’okumuha obuhwezi bw’omuntu omwe, nibacwamu kutaaho engyenderwaho y’okuhindura ebiri omu programu y’okwegyesa, ekirikukwata aha kutebeekanisa embeera. Nk’omu yaanukura y’eby’obwegyesa y’okukora aha buremeezi bwe, Gabriela akateebwa omu mwanya murungi omu kicweka, ahabw’okuba emitwarize ye neeyoreka okuremesa okwega kwe hamwe n’okw’abegi bagyenzi be. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, ni enyimaanisha ki aha zirikukurataho neeyimaanisha omuhendo gw’ekicweka ky’omu kicweka?
answer_a: Neegiraasa obushoboorozi bw'omutaano obukuru n'okwega omu bwengye ebirikukirraho obukuru omu kuza omu maisho n'ebirikurugiirira aha by'okusoma.
answer_b: Nikumanya omuntu omwe-mwe n'ebintu ebimwetorooire by'omwegi, n'okusiima enjawulo eziri omu kikaati.
answer_c: Kukendeeza ebirikumanyisa ebirikubaasa kuzibira abeeshuri kwetaba omu by'okushooma kandi n'okutunga amakuru, kwonka otarikureetera abeeshuri kutoorwa aha bitegyereize kubaruga omu kushooma kwabo
answer_d: Nikuzahoza obwengye bw'abantu oburikukwata aha kwetaba kw'omwegi kandi bukakuza obwetengyesereza omu muringo gw'okwega kwe.

question: Shoma omu mbeera egi: Ekikundi ky'abeeshomero omu kiraasi ya 2, omu ishomo ly'orurimi n'okuhurirana, bagyenda kukorera hamwe n'abeeshomero baabo aha mugasho gw'ebyahandiikwa ebiragiro, okukiraho ebiteekwa by'okuteeka. Entebeekanisa ina zitebeekanisiibwe, ey'okubanza ahagati yazo neyoreka omuringo ogukurira aha kutandika kw'eisomo: - Okukangura okumanya okwabaireho enyima okurikukwata aha kyahandiikwa eki twagambaho, kuraba omu bibuuzo. - Okushoma hamwe ekiteekwa, kirikukwasirwa ebishushani. - Okureeba vidiyo omuntu, orikwebemberwa ekiteekwa, arikuteeka. Kurugiira aha mahame g'Omuringo gw'Ensi Yoona ogw'Okwegyesa, niki ekirikuhikiiriza omuringo ogukozesibwe aha kutandika kw'eisomo eririkugambwaho?
answer_a: Abeshomesha nibahukana omu muringo ogu barikwetegyereza n'okwetegyereza ebiri kubahwa, n'ahabw'ekyo emitwarize erikukwata aha bwenge, emiringo y'okwega, ebi barikukunda, n'ebi barikukiraho kwenda bishemereire kwetegyerezibwa obu ebiri kubahwa.
answer_b: Abeshuri nibetenga ngu ebiteekateeko by'okwega birikuba biryorobi kandi birikushoboroka, n'ahabw'ekyo, embeera ez'omutaano zishemereire kutebeekwa kwanguhya omugisha, okukwata, n'okwetaba kw'abeshuri omu programu y'eshomero.
answer_c: Abeshuri nibegira omu mbeera y’okwega erimu okusoomooza okurikusiima, nibarikuza kugarukamu ebibuuzo ebibarinda omu mikoranire, kandi nibaha engyenderwaho ezirikuhindurana kwongyera amaani n’okubashisha.
answer_d: Abeekuri omwegyesa nibareeta emitwarize etari emwe, obushoboorozi, hamwe n'ebirikubashemeza omu mbeera y'okwega, kukora n'okushoborora eki baraabe bamanyire nari beegire, n'ahabw'ekyo emiringo etari emwe y'okushoborora eki kyeegirwe eshemereire kuteekateekwa.

question: Juan ari omu giraade ya kana kandi aine oburemeezi omu kushoma, okukira munonga omu kwetegyereza ebigambo ebirikukoresibwa omu muringo gw'ebyahandiikwa ebirikushushana. N'obu omwegyesa akakoresa emiringo mingi ey'okwegyesa, omwegi tarikumanyisa ku ayongyeiremu omu maisho omu kicweka eki kandi nayoreka obutasiima kushoma. N'ahabw'ekyo, twarikureeba okwejumba kw'abazaire omu kwega kw'omwana waabo, ekibiina ky'omu kicweka kyahamire kukibahabura kukora nk'abahabuzi b'okushoma kandi kyorobiize omuringo gw'okwega gwa Juan omu ka, nibamugambira kumuhurikiza arikushoma, kushoma hamwe nawe, n'okuhanga ebicweka by'okugamba omu ka omuri ebyo ebigambo ebirikukoresibwa omu byahandiikwa. Twataireho omutima aha ki, ni enshonga ki aha ezi ezirikuhakanira omuringo ogurikukoresibwa ekibiina ky'omu kicweka?
answer_a: Hamuura omwegi obushoboorozi bw'okwetegyereza ebyo arikuhurira omu bitabo ebirikushushana, n'ekigendererwa ky'okugaziya ebigambo bye.
answer_b: Orugambo rw'akanwa n'omusingi mukuru ogw'okuhangaanisa n'okwetegyereza, kandi nirukuruura obwengye n'okumanya omu bwire bwona. Nirukukwasa abantu kwegamira, kuteekateeka, n'okugambira abandi ebi barikuteekateeka n'ebi barikumara. Orugambo rw'akanwa rurikukwasa omuntu kukura omu biteekateeko, okwetegyereza abandi, n'okugira emikago mirungi n'abantu abandi. N'ekikuru munonga omu by'oburezi, emirimo, n'obuzima bwona.
answer_c: Higa omukundwakazo gw'okushoma, orikwikiriza omwegi kukoresa ebigambo ebirimu omu by'ashoma omu mbeera za buri izooba.
answer_d: Higa omwegyendeso gw'ebigambo bingi ebirikukozesebwa omwegiisa, ebirikumwemerera kworeka ebi arikuhurira omu muringo oguhikire.

question: Shoma omu mbeera egi: Francisca yaingire omu kasharamu ka kindagarte kandi arikwetaba omu mulingo gw'eby'oburezi omurundi gwe ogw'okubanza. Omu kwezi kw'okubanza kw'amasomo, abakozi b'omu kasharamu bareebire embeera omwegi ou arikwetantara okwegaita n'abandi kandi yayoleka emicwe y'obusungu aha bagenzi be. Ku arikugamba, orurimi rwe orurikwolesa ebi arikuteekateeka nirworeka okutindika kandi narugaamu ebigambo nari ashinga ebindi. Obutoosha atarikwetegyereza ebiragiro ebi ahabwa omu kanwa kandi agwa omu busungu bwingi omu kukuraaza emirimo ei ashemereire kukora. Kimugumira kandi kukuratira amateeka g'okutuura hamwe omu kasharamu. Twashoma aha mbeera erugaireho, micwe ki ei abakozi b'omu kasharamu barikubaasa kuteekateeka ngu Francisca aine oburemeezi bw'okuhurra?
answer_a: Orurimi rwe orurikworeka orurembo nirwo rurikworeka okutindika kandi nafeerwa obumanzi omu kuza kukura ebikorwa.
answer_b: N’arikwenda kwegaita n’abantu kandi obutoosha atahurira gye ebi arakuutirwa omu kanwa.
answer_c: N’ayoleka emicwe y’obushaarizi kandi omu rurimi rwe orw’okugamba, obutoosha arikushukamu ebigambo nari amajwi.
answer_d: Omu ku rurimi rwe orukugaragaza ebi arikuteekateeka, atarukugambira kimwe ebigambo byona nari ebirimiisho byona kandi nikimugumira kukuratira amateeka g'okutuura hamwe n'abandi.

question: Shoma omwana omu owa Prekindergarten, orikugira oburemeezi bw’okuhurira oburikukiraho kandi atarikukoresa bikoreso by’obuhurizi, yeetaba omu ishomero. Abarikumuzaara tibarikuhurira, n’ahabw’ekyo tarikumanya orurimi rw’ebikomo; akoresa obukomo bukye kandi agarukamu ebintu ebitarikwetegyeka. Omwegyesa w’abaana abarikugira oburemeezi asaba abazaire b’omwana kwetaba omu rukurato rw’okwega orurimi rw’ebikomo, beena bakanga, nibagira ngu omwana waabo azaakure omu rurimi orw’omumwa arikukwatana n’abandi bahungu n’abashiki omu bwire bw’obwo azaamare omu ishomero. Okurikira aha mbeera eyo, ni bintu ki ebiraabe bireebereirweho okuhwera omwana ogwo?
answer_a: Okugambirana n'obushomereirwe
answer_b: Ekirukiriza n'embeera z'obuntu
answer_c: Okugambirana n'eka
answer_d: Ekiragiro n'okwetegyereza

question: Okuruga okugambwa oku: Kuruga omu biteekateeko by'abantu n'eby'embeera zaabo, obu orikutebeekanisa engyenderwaho z'okwegyesa n'okwega ahabw'abegi abatahurira, nikyetaagisa okwetegyereza omuringo abegi abataire kukora bahurira baraabe nibareeba, omuryango gwabo, n'orurimi rwabo. Ni ngyenderwaho ki eirikukwatanisa n'okwetegyereza oku?
answer_a: Omuringo gw'okukora ebintu omu muringo ogurikwata aha mpande zombi
answer_b: Omuringo gw'Okukoresa Okuhurira n'Okugamba
answer_c: Omuringo gw'okwegyesa ogurikukoresa endimi ibiri n'emicwe ebiri
answer_d: Omuringo gw'okuhurirana omu buringaniza

question: Shoma ekyeshoborora eki: "Ekigyendererwa ky'omuringo ogu n'okugamba omu kanwa, okurikurata omuringo gw'ebigambo ebigambirwa, omu bwire bumwe nokukoresa amakuru g'emikono y'Orurimi rw'Emikono nk'obuhangwa oburikuzibira amakuru agarikurugiira omu kushoma eby'omu kanwa." Obuhabuzi bw'okukwasa amaka g'abaana abatahurira. Ensheko ya Mati­as n'eka ye. Obushomesha. Kurugiira aha kyeshoborozi eki ekiri ahaiguru, ni engyenderwera ki aha zirikukurataho erikwoleka omuringo gw'obushomesha ogurikukoresibwa kukorera hamwe n'abanyeshuri abatahurira?
answer_a: Omuntu orikukoresa omumwa kwegyesa abantu abataire kumuhurra.
answer_b: Ebirimu emiringo ebiri
answer_c: Omuntu orikugamba endimi ibiri
answer_d: Okuhurira hamwe omu muringo gwona

question: Ekirikurugyiraho ki aha birikukurataho, ekirikukiraho kusaana kucungura oburemeezi bw'abegi abataahurira omu kuhandiika n'okugamba?
answer_a: I.D.E.A
answer_b: Okugyezibwa kwa TEVI-R
answer_c: Omugyereso gwa Kendall
answer_d: Okugyeragyerana kw'omukozi

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurira: Fabiana ni omwegi omukookyi orikukoresa orurimi rw'ebyamaisho. Ori omu kiraasi eya 7 omu ishomero eririmu programu y'okwegyesa abantu boona kandi aine oburemeezi bumwe omu nteekateeka y'ebigambo n'omukoresa gwabyo omu kuhandiika kwe. Omwegyesa w'Ebyafaayo, Geography, n'Ensi n'obuntu bw'abantu naayenda kworeka efilimu ndyaki (documentary) arikukora aha mitwarize y'Obwire bwa hati n'ekibiina, kwonka tamanyire oku arahabura Fabiana kutunga ebirimu. Kurugiira aha mbeera eyo, niki kikoreso ky'ebyentegyereza ekirikukiraho kukwata aha kukoresa okuhabura omwegi kutunga amakuru?
answer_a: Omuredita ya vidiyo erikukwasa kuteekateeka vidiyo y'okushoboorora omu rurimi rw'ebig signs omu nyegyesereza, omwegi ashobore kutunga amakuru g'omumwa omu rurimi rwe rwa kavuyo.
answer_b: Ekikoreso kya kompyuta ekirikukora obushorozi bw'okuteera ebigambo ahansi y'efiriimu y'ebyahandiikwa ebi omwegyesa arikukoresa, abegi bashobore kutunga amakuru agarikugambwa kuraba omu bigambo ebiterirwe ahansi y'efiriimu.
answer_c: Vidiyo z’omukura gw’eby’okusoma ezirikworeka ebiri omunda omu rurimi rw’ebigagu (sign language) ezikoledwe orubuga rw’eby’oburezi, ngu omwegi ashoobororwe kutunga ebirimu, kwonka arikukoresa ebintu ebirikworohera kutungwa.
answer_d: Ekikoreso kya kompyuta ekirikukwasa okukyusa ebigambo ebirikugambwa omu kanwa okubihandiika, n'ahabw'ekyo omwegi asobora kutunga amakurru g'ebirikugambwa omu katabo aka documentary kuraba omu bihandiiko ebirikukorwa ekikoreso eki.

question: Shoma omuzingo ogurikukurira: Daniela omwishiki orina emyaka etaano, orikwoleka oburemeezi bw'okuhurra obw'amaani kandi oburi aha matwi goona, kandi abadde nakoresa eby'okuhurra kuruga obu oburemeezi bwe bw'okuhurra bwazindurwa aha myaka nka ebiri. Naragana n'abantu arikukoresa ebigambo by'omwe kandi n'ebigambo bikye ebirimu enyeegyesa-grama embi kandi aine ebigambo bikye. Omwegyesa omukuru atandika obuhwezi n'okucweekereza okuhurra okurikugizibwa omu lukalala rw'ebinyigizo by'ebigambo by'empindahinduka omu bigambo birikwenda kugambwa butoosha kandi n'ebinyigizo by'ebigambo by'empindahinduka omu bigambo biri ahagati y'enyigizo (okuraba omu muringo gw'okuhurra gwonka) ebi Daniela ashemereire kugarukamu, nk'oku, hamwe n'eka ye, bacwireho kwongyera aha buhurri bwe obusigaraire. Buli kwezi, omwegyesa omukuru akoresa okucweekereza oku kwonka kandi akamanya okukula kw'omwegi orikukwata aha murimo ogukozirwe kwongyera aha buhurri bwe. Kurugiirira aha kirikugambwa, bwegyesa ki bw'okuhurra obu omwegyesa omukuru arikukora na Daniela?
answer_a: Okuteekateeka
answer_b: Okijukiro
answer_c: Okuteekateeka
