question: Eklaasi ya Pre-primary omu ishomero ly'abataahurira neebembera aha kukuza emikorere erikukwatana n'orurimi. Okukora eki, omwegyesa omukuru owa special needs education naayoreka abegi empapura ezirikworekana ebishushani by'emirimo n'obucwezi omu itungo ryabo, naruga n'okubayoreka obubonero oburikukwatana nabyo, reero abagambire kutoorana omurimo gwe barikukunda. Kurugiirira aha mikorere y'orurimi eya Jacobson, ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurira aha kukura kw'omukorere gw'orurimi ogurikworeka omu mbeera egi?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza abarikubariirira omurimo gwabo ogu baatooraine nari obuhangwa.
answer_b: Nibarikira ahabw'enki bakunda obucuruzi obu baatooraine nari omurimo.
answer_c: Nibarikira omuringo gw'okukora eby'okubonera omulimo ogutoraine nari obucuruzi.
answer_d: Nibarikiriza banywani baabo kworeka obucuruzi rundi omulimo ogu baatooraine.

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurira: Omu ishomero ry'abantu abataire kumuhurira, abanyeshuri abali omu mwaka gwa kana nibegyesibwa eby'okuhandiika omu rurimi rwabo orwa kabiri, n'ahabw'ekyo omwegyesa w'abanaaba baine oburemeezi bw'okwega naayenda ngu bakore ekihandiiko ky'ebaruha y'okuseereza omwegyesa orikurugaho aherize okwegyesa. Kurugiira aha biri ahaiguru, ni bumwe aha bwakorwa obu bukwataire omwegyesa w'abanaaba baine oburemeezi bw'okwega kukora omurimo ogu?
answer_a: Omugyezibwa w’abaana abarikwega omu muringo gw’omutaano areeta aha baana ekyahandiikirwe eki yaateekaniziise ebaruha y’okuseereza omwegyesa ondiijo. Omu kubanza, abagambira ngu ekyahandiikirwe eki kirimu enshobi kandi baine kukikosora hamwe, barikworeka enshobi ezikozirwe n’okuteerereza enkorora ya buri emwe.
answer_b: Omugyezibwa w’abaana abarikwega omu muringo gw’omutaano naabaasa abaana be omwe-aha-mwe omu maiso g’eklassi kwatura omu rurimi rw’ebikomo ebi barikwenda kuhandika omu baruha y’okuseereza omwegyesa orikugyenda. Bwanyima, nibaganiira ebi bateekateeka kandi nibatoorana ebiteekateeko bitaano ebi basanga nibihikire munonga aha klassi yoona. Eki nikimara, nibatandika kuhandiika hamwe ebirikugambwa.
answer_c: Omugurusi w’abaana abarikwega omuhanda gw’okwegyesa ogw’omutaano naashaba abeegi be kwija aha kibaho kimwe aha kindi, omu buri omwe akahandiika ekiteekateeko kimwe ky’ebaruha y’okuseebura omwegyesa ondiijo. Buri mwegi ku araangize okwongyera ekiteekateeko aha lukalala, omwegyesa naatandika kubigorora kimwe aha kindi, naaranga enshobi arikuhindura nari okwongyera ebintu ebirikuhikire omu buri sentensi.
answer_d: Omugyezibwa naabuuza abeeshuri be kukora orutondekwa omu rurimi rw'emikono rw'eki baraabe nibenda kuhandiika omu baruha y'okusherura omwegyesa ondiijo. Nk'oku buri mweeshuri arikugamba eki arikuteekateeka, omwegyesa naakihandiika omu Rushaniish. Bwanyima, nibatoorana ebiteekateeko bishatu ebi abeeshuri abarikukunda munonga kandi omwegyesa naabihangana, yaandika baruha.

question: Omuhanda ki ogurikukiraho obuhikire okukoresa kwongyera amaani okukura kw'okuhandiika kwa Macarena omu mwaka ogwa 5 omu ishomero ry'abatahurira, Macarena orikutaha, oraije omuri egi kiraasi emyaka ebiri enyima, ahabw'okuba akaba ataine oburemeezi bw'okushoma? Nangwa Macarena obwahati asaasaana gye omu rurimi rw'ebikomo, akagumizamu aine oburemeezi omu kuhandiika, nasangwa ari ahansi y'omutindo gw'abandi boona omu kiraasi. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, omuringo ki ogurikukiraho obuhikire okukoresa kwongyera amaani okukura kw'okuhandiika kwa Macarena?
answer_a: Koreka eky'okuhandiika kw'omwegi okw'obutonde n'okukoresa akatabo k'okuhurirana
answer_b: Hamuura kuhandiika orikuraba omu kubangaanisa enyikiriza ezirikukwata omwegi omutima
answer_c: Yegyesereza kuhandiika orikurabira omu kubangaanisa ebitabo ebirimu ebyahandiikwa ebirikukwasisa ebirooto n'ebigambo.
answer_d: Higa omwandiko ogurikukurirwa aha sentensi ezirakozesibwe omu rurimi rw'emikono omwegi n'azikora, omwegesi n'azihandiika.

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurataho: Omu class ya 4, omwegi ou arakuire atari kwenda kuhurra naayegyesibwa, ou arikuhurirana n'abandi arikukoresa obubonero bw'emikono kandi atarikumanya gye orulimi rw'obubonero. Abegyesi b'omu class nibakora aha kutebeekanisa Omutaano III: Omubiri gw'omuntu n'emirimo yaagwo etandika, ogu orugyenderwamu rw'okwega ruri: "Kumanya n'okushoboorora, arikukoresa ebitebyo, emisingi y'amagufa n'emwe aha mirimo yaago, nk'okurinda (embabazi n'eky'omutwe), okushagika (enkingi z'omugongo n'omugongo) n'okwehindura (eky'aha kikondo n'egufa ly'aha maguru)." Kurugiirira aha mbeera eyo ereetsirwe, mugisha ki ogurikukirayo kukwatanisa okwegyesa obu orikukora aha rugyenderwamu rw'okwega orwo n'ekicweka eki?
answer_a: Mureebire vidiyo y’eby’okwegyesa ebikwata omubiri gw’omuntu, mukoremu ebibinja ebirimu abantu abataafaanaine, mureete ekirooto ky’amagufa g’omubiri ng’omureeta ebintu ebirikukwata aha misho.
answer_b: Tebeekanisa omushoonzi gw'eky'erangaanisa (PowerPoint presentation) ogurikushobora buri kimwe aha miteerere y'entebeekanisa y'amagufa, kandi okore akatabo k'okukorera hamwe omu bubiri, orangirize n'ekibuuzo aha mutwe gw'ebyo.
answer_c: Shaba abeshomesa kumanya ebicweka by'amagufa omu mibiri yaabo, barikushoborora amagambo agirikukwata aha mutwe gw'eky'okushooroza; bakorera omu bibiina ebirimu abantu abarikushushana, omubo barikworeka omurimo gwabo kuraba omu muringo gwona ogu barikukunda.
answer_d: Shushani omubiri gw'omuntu ou murikukoragana nawe aha rupapura rurikukura kubaasa kumanya ebirikugwara omubiri by'amagufa. Buri omwegi naija kweshushana omu kabooki ke arikushushana embabazi, ekikokoro, enkingi z'omugongo, omugongo, akabanga, na feemba. Ku kuhwekyesa, nibaija kukora okucwekyereza oku baratandika kutebeekanisiza omu mitwe ei barikwenda.

question: Alonso omwegyeshuri omukuru atarikuhurira orikukoresa orulimi rw'ebikomo kandi ali omu mwaka gwa 3 omu ishomero eririmu enteekaniza y'okwegaita hamwe. Aine obuhwezi bw'omusemuzi w'orulimi rw'ebikomo kandi aine oburemeezi omu kusoma n'okuhandiika. Omwegyesa w'ebyafaayo, eby'obutungi bw'ensi, n'eby'embeera z'abantu aine kukora aha kumanya n'okushanga ebice by'ensi ebirimu obwire obutali bumwe ng'akoresa maapu. Twaba niturora embeera egi, ni bumwe aha bintu ebi ebikuru kukora Alonso akwatse ebyo omwegyesa arikwegyesa?
answer_a: Kukora maapu y'omutwe hamwe n'ekibiina ky'ekuru n'omuseeri w'orurimi rw'ebikumu orikuseera ebiri omu maapu egi omwegi orikukama.
answer_b: Kukora omukura ogurikwatanisa hamwe ogw'ebitundu by'obwire bw'embeera y'obuhindagano, orikworeka n'obubonero ebice by'ensi ebirikukwataho munonga ahabw'okuhinduka kw'obwire bw'embeera.
answer_c: Kuhereza obuhabuzi oburikwija kukuzibwa hamwe, kushaba omushogomi w'orurimi rw'emikono kuhwera omu kutebeekanisa eby'okugarukamu bya Alonso, reero bikayorekwa omu rukurato rw'ekuraasi.
answer_d: Kukora omurimo gw'ekikundi omu kiraasi omuli abeeshuri abaine kworeka omu maapu y'ensi ebitundu by'obwire bw'embeera y'obwire, nibabishanga n'akabonero k'embeera y'obwire akarikugyererana n'ekitundu ekyo.

question: Shoma omwana orikushoma omwaka gw'okubanza omu ishomero eririmu enteekateeka y'abaana abaine oburemeezi bw'okwega erikwetwa Sebastian, orikugamba orurimi rw'ebikomo. Aha bikwaata aha kukura kw'okuhandiika, omwana ou aine oburemeezi, arikukora enshobi omu herufi kandi tarikumanya herufi z'empindahika zoona ezi zimaze kukorwaho. Kureetera omwana ou kukura omu buhingurizi bw'okuhandiika, omukuru w'eishomero hamwe n'omwegyesa w'abaana abaine oburemeezi bw'okwega, bakacwamu kuhandiika amaziina g'ebintu ebirikushangwa omu kicweka ky'okwegyeramu, nibakoresa eiziina erihandiike n'orutindo rw'engaro. Kandi, ebigambo bisya byaba bireebeka omu kiraasi, omwegyesa w'abaana abaine oburemeezi bw'okwega abihandiika aha bbaaho kandi omushoboroozi w'orurimi rw'ebikomo areeta akakomo, hamwe n'okubihandika n'engaro. Kurugiirira aha mbeera eyo, ni enshoborozi ki aha zirikukurataho erikuhakanira enteekateeka erikukoresibwa omwegyesa?
answer_a: Nikiriza omukwatagano gw'amaisho n'ebihandiiko
answer_b: Neeyongyera omubazi gw'ebigambo by'abeeshuri
answer_c: Erizaaho erikukwata aha muringo gw'ebigambo ogurikushushana
answer_d: Nikyoreka aha kukoresa orurimi rw'ebikopo omu kicweka ky'okwegyeramu omu buringaniza

question: Omu bwiine kukuratirwa omwegyesa omu ishomero ry'omukaaga, arikworeka vidiyo y'okwijutsya ebi baayegireho ebiri aha mbeera z'amaizi n'oku birikureebwa omu butonde. Omu ishomero eri harimu abeeshure abatahurira gye abamazire kugyenda aha mutindo murungi omu kushoma n'okuhandiika. N'ahabw'ekyo, omwegyesa acwireho kukoresa omuringo ogurikwija kubahwera kutunga amakuru agurikwija kubaha. Twaba niturora ebi biri ahaiguru, ni muringo ki ogurikukwata aha beeshure abatahurira na kakye omu ishomero eri kutunga ebi omwegyesa arikukora?
answer_a: Shuubamu omubyangu by'okurugiirira omu vidiyo egiija kworekyerwa omu kiraasi
answer_b: [Instructions intentionally omitted]
answer_c: Omuhanda gw'okushoborora ogwateirweho omukono omwegi orikukozesa orurimi rw'emikono arikugambira abantu
answer_d: Taaha omukoki omuhanda gw'abaana kukora omugyano gw'ebirikukwata aha mbeera z'amaizi.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'essomo ly'Obutonde bw'Ensi owa kiraasi ey'okushatu omu ishomero ry'abaana abataahurra, asaba abegi kukora aha kiragiro eki: "Kwatura ebintu ebiri omu Mukura gw'Eizooba, orikureeba ebintu nk'obunene, omwanya, okushusha, n'obuheeru bw'omutwaro aha Ensi." Nooreeba ekyo, ni bumwe aha bungi obu oburikukurataho oburikukwatanisa gye kukora aha kiragiro eki?
answer_a: Yijuza eky’okukuratira aha bicweka by’Ekyanya ky’Eizooba n’ebishushani ebirikworeka emitwarize yaabyo erikuru munonga n’amazina agaahandiikirwe kugira ngu bigyeranisibwe n’ebyahandiikirwe by’omutwe gw’enyegyesa
answer_b: Bumba ekishushani ky'enkora y'Eizooba omuri byona ebigigiziremu, kandi ohandiike ebintu by'omutaano ebya buri kimwe ahakubaasa kugambiraho aha nshonga egi omu kiraasi, turikushoborora okushushana n'obutahikaanisa aha biri omunda.
answer_c: Murembeire ebipanka ebirikworeka ebice by'Ekyanya ky'Eizioba ebi abeeshuri baraaziremu, ebi birimu emitwarize yaabyo ehandiikirwe haihi nabyo, kwija kukora orutaro omu maisho g'eklassi nibagyeragyeranisa emiringo y'ebipanka ebi bakozeseze.
answer_d: Reeba vidiyo ezirikukwega aha bicweka by'Eiziiba ry'Enyanja n'emitwarize yaabyo omuli n'okushoboorora omu LSCh, bwanyima mugishakire hamwe omu kiraasi kandi mureete ebiteeso by'omutwe omuli abeeshuri abarikugamba aha bintu ebi basanze nibishemeza.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omwegi w’omu mwaka gwakabiri omu ishuri eririmu puroguraamu y’okwegyesa abantu boona hamwe, Carla, omwegi omukookyi orikukoresa orurimi rw’ebyama, nayegaho. Ab’ekibiina ky’omu kicweka bakacwamu kutaho enshobero zimwe omu by’okwegyesa ahabw’okuba bareebire ngu ebi omwegi ogu arakuhandiika nibiba biryaha kandi bitarikukura gye. Omurimo gutandikira omu Rurimi n’Empurizana: Carla nagambira omwegyesa w’abaana abaine oburemeezi omu rurimi rw’ebyama ekyo arakuhandiika, yaaza omu maisho kukora orukato rw’ebi arakuhandiika, kandi akahikiiriza omulingo ogwo n’okweyongyera kumwebereza hamwe n’omukozi okukakasa ngu ebi yagambireho omu kutandika nibyo biri omu bihandiiko. Okurikurugiirira aha mbeera erikugambwaho, niki ekirikukwata aha nshobero ezi ab’ekibiina ky’omu kicweka bakataho?
answer_a: Nikugumya okukoresa LSCh omu masomo agatali gamwe
answer_b: Nikumanyisa gye biri emisingi y'orurimi orwa kabiri orurikukorerwaho.
answer_c: Erihaba omuhanda gw'okuhindura orubuga rw'ebigambo by'emikono omu rurimi oruhandiike.
answer_d: Nokukuratira omulingo gw'okukozesa Orulimi rw'Enyamaishwa (LSCh) kuraba omu kworekana okufaanana n'orulembe oluhandiike.

question: Shoma omugambwa ogurikukurira: Omugyezibwa omwegyesa w'abaana abaine oburemeezi bw'okwega atungire omwegi omusya, arikukora aha kumukorera hamwe amanye g'omutaano arikumwemerera kumanya gye ebimurikukora omu kwega. N'ahabw'ekyo, amanye ngu omwegi aine oburemeezi bw'okuta omutima aha kintu n'okwijuka ebintu by'omumazima, hamwe n'okwegatta omu bibiina ebirikukora hamwe. Kurugiirira aha Muringo ogw'Emyanya Emyingi, myanya ki ebiri ei omwegyesa ashemereire kukurira hamwe kugira ngu amanye oburemeezi bw'omwegi?
answer_a: Obusingye n'okwetaba
answer_b: Emitwarize n'emyeshongoro n'okwetaba omu mirimo
answer_c: Obushoboorozi bw'omutwe n'okwetaba omu mirimo
answer_d: Obwengye n'emitwarize erikuhinduka

question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurira: Pedro aine emyaka ikumi na emwe, aine oburemwa bw’obwengye, kandi ari omu kiraasi kya 4 omu ishomero ery’abaana abaine oburemwa obutali bumwe. Ayoleka okukunda ebintu ebi arikubaasa kukwata, okukira munonga yaaba nibimuha omugisha gw’okubiteeka omu mitwaro. Yaaba aine emirimo ei arikukunda, abaasa kugumira ahari yo okuhitsya obu agimariiriza, kandi yaaba aine oburemeezi, abaasa kushaba omwegyesa we kumuhwera. Oburemeezi bwe obukuru nibureetera omu kwegamba kukora emirimo ya buri izooba, nk’eki aine kukora omunyeeto yaahika omu ishomero na omu by’okurya nari okwecenuura, ahabw’okuba nyina atendekire kukora ebintu ahabwe. Kandi, akacyetenga kwega kuhandiika n’okushoma, ahabw’okuba abaasa kukora ebintu by’omugasho byonka, n’okugaziya omuhendo gw’emibaro ogu arikukoresa okuhitsya 100. Ahabw’ekyo, naahwerwa kurugiirira aha mitwaro: Embeera n’Emitwarize Emihikirire. Kurugiirira aha mbeera egi n’okurora Omuringo ogurikukwata aha Buremwa bw’Obwengye oburikurugiira omu Mitwaro mingi, niki ekirikuhikiriza okuhwera okurikuhairwe omu mitwaro egi?
answer_a: Ahabw’okuba obuhwezi nibwetagisa omu kuhindura emiteekateeko n’enyikiriza ezirikuruga omu butumwa obuto, hamwe n’okuhiga omu maisho okukuza obwengye n’obushoboorozi bw’omutwe n’omubiri.
answer_b: Ahabw’okuba okwetaba nikikuru munonga omu kukura kw’abantu omu mbeera zaabo; okwongyera ahari eki, nikyetaagisa kukuza obushobozi oburikukora nk’okuhandiika, okushoma, n’okukoresa eminamba
answer_c: Ahabw’okuba obushoboorozi bushemereire kuteerwa ahaiguru oburikumuha kweteengyereza omu bice by’amagara gye agari omu bantu, okwongyera aha kwegaita n’eka ye aha bintu by’omutaano ebi ashemereire kwega.
answer_d: Ahabw’okuba nikyetaagisa kugira obuhwezi bw’eka kumuhiga kuteeraho hamwe n’okwetaba omu bintu bitari bimwe; okwongyeraho, okukura kw’obwengye bwe nikwija kumwemerera kwijanjara gye.

question: Shoma nikuru kukoresa Omuringo gw'Ebiragiro by'Obutonde bw'Ensi (Functional Ecological Approach) omu kubumbaho emirimo n'okushomesa Pablo?
answer_a: Nikirikukiriza okushoborora emiringo emihyaka y'obuhwezi omu kutebeekanisa n'okushwijuma omu kicweka ky'okwegyeramu.
answer_b: Nikirikukwasa kutebeekanisa engyenderwaho ezirikubaasa kukurikiranizibwa kuruga omu maka g'omwegi
answer_c: Nikikonyahoza kumanya oburemeezi n'obuhabuzi oburikwetagisa kwetaba omu ishomero, omu ka, n'omuri community
answer_d: Nibyasobora kworeka ebi omwegi atungire n'ebyo ashemereire kukora omu muringo ogurikugyenda omu maisho omu mirimo y'eshomero.

question: Shoma omu mbeera egi: Lorena ari omu mwaka gwa 3 ogw'eshomero kandi ahabwa obuhwezi kuruga omu kitongore ky'abaine oburemeezi bw'omutwe ahabw'obuhwezi obu arikwetenga ahabw'oburemeezi bw'omutwe bwe. Aha bi arikukora gye harimu okukura oku aineho akakwata n'obureezi bw'okushoma n'okuhandiika, ekyamuhwereire kubaasa kutunga n'okwetaba omu bintu ebirikukorwa. Nangwa Lorena ayorekire omutima murungi gw'okwega, aine obwetengo bw'obuhwezi kubaasa kukora omu bweteengwa ahabw'okugumirwa kwe kw'okwetegyereza, eki kirikworekwa obu arikwetenga kukoraana amakuru agarikwetengwa kwetegyereza eki ashemereire kukora obu arikurabamu omurimo. Omu muringo ogu, narindira omwegyesa we kumwijaho kumuhabura eki ashemereire kukora. Kurugiira aha eki oshoreme, ni muringo ki ogurikukwataana n'okukora aha bwetaago bw'obuhwezi bwa Lorena?
answer_a: Habwe Lorena omu kubangira omu kukora omurimo ogu, okumuhweera n'ebibuuzo ebirikumwegamya kumushoboroora ebintu ebirikugwiira omu murimo ogu. Hanyuma, shoma ebiragiro kandi orinde kumwetegyereza.
answer_b: Tebeekanise enteekanisa y'okuyambazana n'abanywani ba Lorena abari haihi, nukwo bashobore kumuhwera omu kuza omu maisho n'emirimo, kandi bakakuratira ngu ahabwetiise ebiragiro, haine okugumya omukago gwe n'abanywani be ab'omu kelasani.
answer_c: Mubembereze omurimo gw'okukora omurimo gwona ogw'ekibiina, n'ebibuuzo ebirikubahabura ebirikworohereza okwetegyereza ebintu by'omugasho by'omurimo ogwo, ebi biriija kuhandiikwa aha bbaoodi abeeshuri babashe kubireeba ku barikugumizamu baine okutaanisa.
answer_d: Lorena, bwanyima y'okushoboororwa kw'ekikundi aha murimo, muhe eky'okureeberaho kya buri murimo, noogushoboorora butoosha aha butoosha kandi nomuha ekyahandiikwa eki arikubaasa kureeba yaaba aine okutaanisa.

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurataho: Felipe ni omwegyesa omu mwaka gwa kana owaashangwa aine oburemeezi bw’obwongo. Aha bi arikukomera, harimu okwetwara omu muringo murungi, okugira eki arikwenda kumanyisa, n’obushoboorozi bw’okubara nk’abandi be. Omwegyesa we naaba naakora aha kuzigura ebizibu by’omubaro ebirimu okwikaza, omu byo Felipe arikutaanisa kumanya eki ashemereire kukora kugira ngu azigure ebizibu ebyo, ahabw’okugira ebigambo bike. N’ahabw’ekyo, omwegyesa w’eisomo, hamwe n’omwegyesa w’abaana abaine oburemeezi, nibashushana engyenderwaho z’okwegyesa kugira ngu bahikiirize ebi omwegyesa orikwetenga kumuhwera. Kurugiirira aha mbeera eri ahaiguru, ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurataho erikuhiga okukura kw’obushoboorozi oburikwija kureka Felipe kukora aha biteekateeko?
answer_a: Tebeekanisa ekizibu nk'eky'abandi omu class kandi oreke eky'okureeberaho ky'okukoresa empindahinduka erahura omu kumara ebzibu.
answer_b: Tebeekanisa ekibuuzo nk'eky'ekaasi yoona kandi ohe ebintu ebirikukwata aha mishoora kwemerera ebintu ebirikukigira n'okuhiga okwetegyereza.
answer_c: Sharamura y'okushobora ekizibu omu muringo ogurikwenda omwegi n'okugyenda n'entambwe ezirikukuratirwa omu kumumaraho.
answer_d: Teitura omukoro ogurikugambwaho omu kibuzo ogutwarire omu mbeera erimu omugasho mwingi, noohwere abeeshuri kukoresa akakoomi k'okwebemberaho.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurira: Omwegyesa owa ক্লাসে ya kana omu ishomero erikuruheraine eririkukorera abeeshure abarikugira oburemeezi bw’omutwe atungire ngu abeeshure be abamwe baine oburemeezi bukuru bw’okushobora kworeka ebi barikuteekateeka n’okubaraana embeera za burizooba, ahabw’okuba emiramwa yaabo n’muke. N’ahabw’ekyo, acwireho kukoresa engyenderwaho z’okugarukamu ebyetengo ebirukwoorekwa omu beeshure be. Kurugiirira aha mbeera eri ahaiguru, ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurira erikukwata aha kugarukamu ebyetengo by’obuhwezi ebirukwoorekwa abeeshure?
answer_a: Ninyenda kushobora kurondora ebintu, ebishushani, ebifo, abantu, n'ebindi ebirikushisha ekibiina.
answer_b: Teeka omuringo gw'okuhandiika eby'ebigambo nk'ebyesharirizo, enyiriri, n'ebyeshongozi ebikwata aha bintu bikuru
answer_c: Ha omuhanda gw'okutebeekanisiza abaana ebishushani ebirikukwata aha nshonga nkuru, nk'enyamaishwa n'emikoro.
answer_d: Shaba eby’okubazaana eby’abaana, engano, emigenzo n’ebindi bitabo ebirimu eby’okushoma ebirikushemeza abeeshuri.

question: Shoma omubaire: Omu klasse y'ekibarizo, omwegyesa w'eky'okushatu ari kukora aha kucumura ebizibu n'okukubisa, arikukoresa emiringo y'ebigambo n'ebishushani by'emyitooro kwanguhya okwetegyereza kw'abegyi be. Omu aha begi aba ni Constanza, omwegyi orikugira oburemeezi bw'omutwe orikwiihura kucumura omurimo ogurikumuhairwe, narikugarukamu n'ekishuba. Omwegyesa acwireho kuhwera Constanza omu muringo ogu: Okubanza, abikiireho emyitooro n'ekaratasi kwongyera obwengye bwe aha kigambo. Namubuuza ebibuzo ngu Constanza akunganye amakuru agahikire kwetegyereza eki barikumushaba. Reero namushaba kushoboorora ekizibu ekirikukwataho kandi namuha omugisha gw'okushushana amakuru agakunganyirize. Ekyakurataho, abikiireho emyitooro kandi namushaba kugarukamu, obutoosha narinda omutindo gwe ogw'okwiihura. Kurugiirira aha mbeera eri ahaiguru, niki aha bigambo ebiri ahansi ekirikuhikiiriza okucwamu kw'omuringo ogurikukoresibwa omwegyesa?
answer_a: Kureetera Constanza kukoresa embeera z'obuhwezi kumuhwera kwetegyereza omurimo, nikireetera okugabanya okutangaara aha murimo ogwo.
answer_b: Okuhiga kw'okwegyesa omuringo ogurikubaasa kuteekateekwa omu bwire obundi, okureetera n'omugyendane gw'okukuratanisa oguraazibira emicwe y'obuhumbu.
answer_c: Okucumya omuhendo gw'ebirikukwata aha murimo ogu orikukora n'okuta omutima aha kwetegyereza eki omurimo ogu gukwetagisa, nikikuha obumanzi n'obwesigye omu kuzaanaagura.
answer_d: Kuzibira emicwe emibi, kureetera okukunganya ebintu byona ebikuru ebyetaagisa kwongera okwetegyereza, nikuha omugisha gw'okukoresa ebintu ebirikureetera omuntu kureeba, kwetantara kugarukamu ebintu otabireebire.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Sebastian, omwegi owa klasse ya kabiri orikugira oburemeezi bw’omutwe, naafuna obuhwezi kuruga omu kitongore ekirikukora aha beegi abaine oburemeezi omu ishomero rye. Nyamushanga omu mizano, ahabw’okuba ayihuta kandi aine amaani, naraga okusiima okukuru omu kwega eby’omubiri. Ahabw’ebizibu bye, ayorekire obwetago bw’obuhwezi omu kwetegyereza ebi arikugambirwa n’okukurata amagombolora obu garimu emirimo erikukira aha magombolora abiri nari okukiraho. Kandi ahabw’okukora aha byetago bye by’obuhwezi, omwegyesa w’abegi abaine oburemeezi naateekateeka okutwara omutwaro gw’omwegi ogu omu kwega eby’omubiri ahabw’okugumya obwengye obu arikubura omu klasse y’emotoka. Kurugiirira aha mbeera egi, ni bumwe aha bintu ebirikukurataho oburikwongyera aha kwetegyereza kwa Sebastian amagombolora omu klasse y’eby’omubiri?
answer_a: Mubuuze Sebastian na bagenzi be okugyenda nibashoboorora ebiragiro omu magambo gaabo bwabo bamaze kuhurira okushoboororwa kw'ebicweeka by'omuringo gw'omutindo gw'emotoka, nibagamba eki bategeera ngu baine kukora.
answer_b: Mureke Sebastian akore ebiragiro by'omuzingo gw'amasannyalaze omu omwe, agyendeeze emirundi mingi, kwonka akore omuzingo gw'emotoka oguhwereera ogurikumuha obushoboorozi bw'okwegyenda omu biragiro byoona.
answer_c:
Mworobi omwegyesa ayorekane eky'okukora omuri buri mutendera gw'omuringo ogu motoka ekoramu, akoresa ebigambo biraiguru:

1.  **Ebirooto:** Teeka omutwe. (Omwegyesa ayorekane)
2.  **Okutebeekanisa:** Tebeekanisa eby'okukora. (Omwegyesa ayorekane)
3.  **Okuragira:** Ragira emikono. (Omwegyesa ayorekane)
4.  **Okukora:** Mikono ekore. (Omwegyesa ayorekane)
5.  **Okugyezaho:** Reeba eki ekorwa. (Omwegyesa ayorekane)
answer_d: Tebeekanisa obuhabuzi bw'okukwasa abanywani baawe, abanywani b'eklassi bagyerere obwabo ebi barikwega kandi bashoboorore ebicuucu by'omuringo gw'omutwe n'orurimi orurikwenda.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Ekikundi ky’abanyeshuri ab’omu mwaka gwa munaana nigitebeekanisa omuringo gw’okuhiga Pia, omunyeshuri orikugira oburemeezi bw’omu bwongo orikureebwa nk’omucwezi kandi atarikwetaba mumaishaara, n’obu abanyeshuri abandi barikubuuza ebibuuzo nari kugarukamu ebibuuzo by’omusomesa. Kandi, nikireebwa ngu omu biro omusomesa w’abarikugira oburemeezi bw’okwega arikuba omu ishaara, obumwe akora enyimaishwa ez’ekyama kandi agabaana ebi akora. Ekikundi ky’ab’omu ishaara, nibakuratira ebyetengo ebirikureebwa omu munyeshuri kandi omu muringo gw’okwegyesa ogurikwetegyereza emisingi y’entebeekanisa y’okwegyesa ey’omutaano, nibashaka kuteekamu okukoresa ICT omu muringo ogurikugyenda omu maishaara yoona okuhiga okuhurirana kwe n’okwetaba kwe, ekirikwija kureetera abasomesa boona kumanya oku Pia arikugyenda omu maisho. ICT eshemereire kugira mbeera ki okuhiga okuhurirana kwa Pia n’abasomesa?
answer_a: Kikugambira omwegyesa kutaaha eby'okugarukamu kuruga omu mirimo y'abeeshuri kandi ahawe eky'okugarukamu ekikuru.
answer_b: Kikabaasa kwikiriza okusika ebipande by'okuruga omuklassi ebirikworekwa omu muringo gw'okuhakanisa, omu kubanza kukurikiranisa aha buhinguzi bw'ekigyendererwa ky'eklassi
answer_c: Kikabaasa kworeka omugisha gw'okugarukamu ebibuuzo by'abegyesi, nooha abantu obubonero ahabw'okugarukamu ebirungi kureetera abantu kukwatamu.
answer_d: Kikabaasa kwikiriza kuhana ebibuuzo n'ebyakusoborora omwe-omwe n'abegyesi, kyorobiize okugarukwamu enyima.

question: Shoma omwegyegyesa omukuru w’ekicweka ky’okutebeekanisiza omu ka ey’abaana abarikugyenda omu ishomero ery’abaana abataire kukwata gye omutwe naagira ngu nikikuru abaana abato abari omu course ye kumanya amakuru g’ebishushani by’oburinzi ebirikukirayo obukuru ebi barikubaasa kutoorana omu mwanya gwabo gw’emirimo, ahabw’okuba eki nikibaasa kureetera okwerinda obuzibu. Ni engyenderwka ki aha zirikukurira ezirikukwata aha biri omunda ebyatooranirwe omwegyesa kuruga omu muringo gw’okukora ogurikukwata aha butonde?
answer_a: Tebeekanisa orugyendo rw’okwegyesa omu dduuka eriri haihi n’eishomero, abeeshuri, nibakwatanisibwa orutindo rw’ebishushani, barondere eby’okurya ebirimu ebishushani ebi, bamanye ebi birikukora n’omu mbeera ki ebirikukoresibwa.
answer_b: Tebeekanisa okutegyeka orugyendo rw'omuntu orikumanyirwe omu by'okushoma aije aha ishomero, ahe abeeshure n'ab'eka yaabo orubazo aha bintu ebiriho omu maka n'omu kicweka byona, ebi ebiriho ebishushani aha bishushanyo byabyo.
answer_c: Tebe hamwe n'abeeshuri kandi muhuriire hamwe n'omuganga w'omu ishomero orikukora aha by'emirimo, mutebeenteera "Eky'Emihango y'Obuteekaana" ahu abeeshuri abari omu workshop, nibakwatirirwa obutabo n'ebipande ebi baakozire, nibashoboorora amakuru g'ebishushani by'okurabura aha bindi beeshuri.
answer_d: Mugambe abazaire b'abeeshuli kutumira abaana eby'okurya ebirikushangwa omu kicweka ky'okuteekyera omuka, ebirikuba biremireho obubonero bw'okwerinda; nukwo bwanyima, aha ishomero, ebyo by'okurya birikubaasa kushwijumwa kandi bishushurwe abeeshuli.

question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurira: Ekibiina ky'abeesikati abari omu mwaka gwa kabiri nibateekanisa omukura gw'okukora ogwa Sofia, omwegi orikugira oburemeezi bw'omu bwongo n'obushoboorozi bukye obw'okukwata ebirikumuhika aha matwi (auditory) nari okureeba (visual). Omwegi ashemereire kugumizamu n'okweyongyera omumaisho omu kwega kushoma, n'ahabw'ekyo nibarikukiriza kwongyera aha kwijuka kw'omwegi omu mirimo yoona. Kurugiirira aha mbeera eri ahaiguru, oruhe murimo aha mirimo erikukurira orukusaanira okuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ekirikutekanisibwa ekibiina ky'abeesikati?
answer_a: Gamba omwana ahingure omu muzigyo gw'amasannyalaze. Yaaba akoze enshobi, ashemereire kugaruka aha kutandika.
answer_b: Gamba omwana agyendeze omuhendo oguhendekerwe omwegyesa: nk'oku kyolekwa omu ky'okureeberaho kandi n'enyima.
answer_c: Kora omupiira gw'ebigambo omu omwegi arikushobora kworekana aha kaadi ye ekigambo omwegyesi arikumugambira n'akikandika aha kaadi.
answer_d: Gamba omwana arikuhanuura amakaada aguririirwe ahansi, yaakore esente esinga okuruga omu rurengo rw'ebigambo.

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurataho: Nahuel ni omwegi owa klasse ya kabiri orikukunda emirimo erikwetenga kukwata aha bintu n’okwejyegyereza, ahabw’okuba akunda kutaayaayira omu klasse obutoosha. Ekicweka eki arikutsibira munonga kiri omu kubura ebigambo bingi, n’okutuura amaziina g’ebintu ebi arikukoresa buri izooba nk’ebikoreso by’eishomero. Ahabw’okuba ataine ebigambo bingi, nikimwetenga obuhwezi kuta omutindo gw’ebintu omu bibinja kurugiirira aha mutindo ogurikuhairwe. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, ni engyenderwaho ki aha ezirikukurataho erikuhwera omu kwongyera amaani omu buhairwe bw’omwegi bw’okuta ebintu omu bibinja?
answer_a: Kora omurimo gw'okutondoorora ebintu omu miringo etari emwe, okukoresa ebiri omu masomo agasiima kutondoororwa. Mushabe kuta eiziina ahari buri kimwe kandi omubuze ekikundi kyona hamwe orikukita ota: Ebi byona hamwe nibaita bita?
answer_b: Koresa eby'okureeberaho ebi orikubaasa kushanga omu kicweka ky'okwegyeramu, nk'okutebeekanisa, omwegi ashemereire kutoorana ebintu, kumubuuza eiziina ry'ekintu kimwe na kimwe kurugiirira aha mugasho gwakyo, bwanyima akabiteeka aha masherufu nari ahu birikugwana.
answer_c: Mugabire omwana omurimo ogurikukora omu kiraasi ogurikumuha omugisha gw’okwetaba omu bikorwa ebirimu okukwata ebintu, nk’eky’okugaba ebikoreso. Omu kasumi ako, shaba omwegi kukukwasa, orikumushaba kwatura ebintu ebi arikugaba n’ekigyendererwa kyabyo.
answer_d: Koresa omwana okukoresa kaada ezirimu ebintu ebirikumanyirwa omu bwire obwoona, omushabe kuta eiziina ry'ekintu kimwe na kimwe okuhameza ngu namanya ebintu ebi n'amazina agabyo. Bwanyima, omushabe kuzingurira nari kuhwera ebintu byoona kurugiirira aha muramuko gw'omutaano ogurateekanisiibwe.

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurataho: Diego ni omwegyesa omu mwaka gw'okubanza orikufuna obuhwezi kuruga omu kitongole ky'abaine oburemeezi omu ishomero rye ahabw'obuhwezi bw'eby'omushomo oburikuruga omu buremeezi bw'obwengye bwe. Ekibiina kye hati nikikora aha kwega emibaaro kuruga 1 kuhika 20 omu Kubara, kwonka, ab'ekibiina bakwetegyereza ngu Diego arikwetenga obuhwezi kwongyera omumaisho omu kwega eby'emibaaro ebirikukorwaho, ahabw'okuba bareeba ngu okumanya kwe aha mibaaro egi kukira aha kwega kw'okugarukamu orukurato rw'okwambukya. Omwegyesa w'abaine oburemeezi, ku yaingiire omu nshonga egi, areeba ngu omwegyesa takora enshushaniso enungi y'omubaaro n'obwingi, ahabw'okuba obumwe ahaheereza omubaaro gumwe aha bibinja bibiri ebirimu obwingi obutari bumwe. Kurugiirira aha ekyo, acwireho kutoora amagezi omu mutindo gw'Okubara okurikukora, kubaasa kwiha omwegyesa haihi n'okwega okurikutegyerezibwa. Eki nikimanyisa, amagezi agaheebwa nigaganihiiriza oburemeezi bwa Diego omu mushomo gw'Okubara kandi nigagumya okwega kwe?
answer_a: Mwegyende omwegi ashange kandi abale omuhendo gw'amakaramu agatetegyerezibwa kuha omwe buri omwe aha banywani be abarikukora nabo omu kibinja, arikwetenga kureeta omuhendo oguhikire.
answer_b: Ha omuhandiizi omulimo gw'okugaba obutabo bw'ebitebeekanizo by'okuhurirana ahari buri omwe aha banywani be omu kiraasi, okugabira buri omwe entebeekanizo erikumuhingurira.
answer_c: Shoma omubaro omu bwihikiro n'omubushomeezi, okoresheze orukurara rw'emibaro nk'obuhwezi kandi obuuze ebibuzo nk'ebi: mibaro ki eri ahagati ya 9 na 12?
answer_d: Mugambire omwegi akabare omuhendo gw'ebintu bimwe omu kibina kirimu ebintu by'emishobooro erikushaanana, nk'eky'okubara sente zonyine.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Abegi b'omu mwaka gwa munaana baine ekigyendererwa ky'eklassi ekigira ngu "Okukora ubushakashatsi aha by'okurya ebya buri izooba, emitwarize yaabyo mikuru, n'omugasho gwabyo omu mubiri." Ekikundi ky'abasomesa b'eklassi nikishangana kutebeekanisa engyenderwaho ezi baraakoresa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki omu mbeera egi, nibakora ebintu ebi abegi baraayegera omu klassi hamwe n'eka. Omu kutebeekanisa emirimo, emitwarize ya Jorge, omwegi orikugira oburemeezi bw'omu bwongo, neetwarwa nk'ekikuru. Atendekire kukora emirimo kwonka nayetaba gye emirimo ei asabwa kuheebwa ebirabo, narukworeka okushiisha aha matungo g'okutunga ekirabo. Kandi, aine oburemeezi bw'okukwaata ebirimu, eki kimuremesa kwega. Kwonka, okukora kwe n'okwetaba nibyongyera obu aheebwa ebiragiro. Kurugiirira aha mitwarize ya Jorge ezirikushoboororwa, ni engyenderwaho ki aha ezirikukurataho erikukwata aha bwetaazi bwe obw'obuhwezi omu muringo ogurikushaanisa?
answer_a: Mukorane n'abeeshuri kuhanga omucwe gw'ebirikukiriraho ebi baine kukikora omu class yaabo obu barikutebeekanisiza abantu eby'okurya ebirungi kurugiirira aha mbeera ebaheebwa, reero mwoleke eky'okureeberaho ky'omurimo ogwo n'ebirikwetegwa.
answer_b: Handiika aha bbuoodi entaanira abeeshuri abaine kukuratira omuri buri kimwe aha bikorwa hamwe n’obushoboroozi bw’ebintu bikuru omuri kiraasi ebikwatiraine n’omutwe gw’eby’okurya, reero muhereezaane emirimo kandi mufookaane obuhabuzi kuruga aha banyaanyaanyaani.
answer_c: Mukoresseza emizaano nk'eya dominos rundi emizaano y'okushushanisa ebirikukwata aha by'okurya ebya buri izooba n'ebirikubiranga. Aha muheru gw'eklassi, abari omu timu y'eklassi nibaija kuha abaana abeeshure eby'okubagambira kurugiirira aha ku barikukora.
answer_d: Yamba abegi kucwamu aha mirimo ebiri ehikaineho omu bwingwa, nk'ebicweka by'ebyesharizo nari ekiikaro ky'obwomeezi, ebirikukwata aha by'okurya bya buri izooba n'omugasho gwabyo omu mubiri. Aha muheru gw'eishomero, omwegyesa naija kubaza eby'okugarukamu ebirikuhikire.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Ekikundi ky'omuklassi gw'abanaani ab'eikumi na ibiri kishemereire kutebeekanisa eby'okwegyesa ebirikugarukamu obuhunguzi oburikworekwa abegi babiri, kuruga omu buremwa bwabo bw'obwengye. Boona nibahikiiriza okwetegyereza kurungi orurimi orw'omumwa, nibakora omulingo murungi okwegaita omu ishomero, niboreka okukunda omulimo gw'ekikundi okukira omulimo gw'omuntu omwe, kandi niboreka okugumisiriza omu mirimo y'eishomero, nibahikiiriza okwega kukuru obubarikukora butunu n'ebirikukorwaho. Omwegyesa w'essomo ly'Ebyafaayo, Eby'ensi, n'Ensi n'abantu n'omwegyesa w'enjegyereza y'abantu abairemu oburemwa nibasherura omulingo gw'okukora aha mugasho gw'ekigyendererwa ky'okwega ekirikukurataho: "Shoma kandi obaze empapura ezirikworeka embeera y'obusingye, orikukoresa obworekwa, emitwarize y'obuhangwa bw'omwanya, n'akabonero k'ebishushani" kandi n'okuhayo eby'okwegyesa ebirikuhikaana n'ebirikwetagisa abegi bombi, omu mutindo gw'okwegyesa okutali kumwe. Ni mulingo ki ogurikukiraho okukwatanisa okwega kw'abegi abairemu oburemwa bw'obwengye omu mbeera egi?
answer_a: Koresa ICT, ahabw'ekyo, omu maabuli gya kompyuta, abeeshuli bashemereire kutebeekanisa omugambi ogurikushushana n'ekibanza omu maka gaabo, nibakwatanisibwa obuyambi bw'ebishushani ebirikumanywa obwahati.
answer_b: Ha buri omwegi kuhendera, aha miringo mingi y’okwohereza ebiteekateeko, kuruga ahari yo omwe-omwe naakoresa ekishushani nk’obuhame, buri omwegi ateekateeka omugambi gw’ekishushani eki yaatooranize aha rupapura orweru.
answer_c: Ha eki kuhwera abegi omuringo ogurikukwatanisa, noobagambira kweshanga omu bibiri kubaije bakazane omuzano gw'ebintu ebyeziremu omugasho ebihisire, ahu abegi baine kushaka n'okushanga ebintu, nibakurata ebitegyerero by'okuringanisa ebifo n'obureezi.
answer_d: Haa omuringo ogurikukirra gwa kwohereza ebintu, okuruga ahari omwegyesa orikworeka abegi ekishushani ky'ekyombeko ekirikworeka, kurugiira omu tumanyiso, ebintu ebirikukwata ahakyo; bwanyima kubuuza ebibuzo ebirikukwata aha mwanya ebintu birimu omu kishushani.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Emilio ni omwegi aine oburemeezi bwa Autism Spectrum Disorder orikwega omu mwaka gwa 6 omu ishomero ery'abaine oburemeezi obutandukaine. Omwegi naabaasa kwegaita n'abandi beegi omu mizaano ei barikutaandika, naayegaitamu omu muringo ogurikusaana. Ayoreka ekigyendererwa ky'okuhurirana kurabira omu rurimi, arikukoresa ebigambo ebirikukora omu mbeera ezitandukaine. Omu bwire bw'emirimo, harimu okutahuumurira kw'omubiri, ekirikubaasa kureebeka kurabira omu kubahabura kw'omwegyesa. Omu kasumi akaherire, Emilio ayorekire oburemeezi omu kwegaita omu mirimo y'Okwegyesa Omubiri, ahabw'okugaanisa oku aine okuruga omu kikaari. Omu bintu ki ebi omwegyesa ashemereire kwetantara omu mbeera y'ishomero, Emilio asobole kwegaita omu mirimo y'Okwegyesa Omubiri?
answer_a: Okugaitana omu mbeera y'abantu, kuraba omu mizano eshemeza Emilio n'egirikwenda okutebeekanisa n'okuhaziindaanisa omurimo gw'ekibiina omu ishomero ry'okwegyesa omubiri.
answer_b: Okutunga omuhingo gw'okutabara, kuraba omu bikorwa ebi tukozeseza embeezi y'eklassi ya Physical Education, abanywani b'eklassi nibo bahwera Emilio kwetegyereza omu muringo murungi okuruga omu klassi n'emikorwa y'eklassi egi.
answer_c: Omuhanda, kuraba omu kifo eki Emilio arikubaasa kushoma, kumuhereza ebiragiro ebirikworekwa gye kandi ebirikumwetegyereza, kuraba omu by'okureeberaho ebirikumworeka ebirikwija kukorwa omu ishomero ry'okugumya omubiri
answer_d: Okuhereza, kuraba omu kutebeekateeka kw'Entebeekanisa y'Obuhwezi bw'Okuhereza ei Emilio arikubaasa kukoresa omu miringo yoona y'okuhereza, ahabw'okumuha obuhwezi oburikwongyera kumuhwera kwega n'okuteekateeka ebikorwa by'Eby'omubiri omu By'omugisha.

question: Shoma omuzingo ogurikukurira: Sergio ari omu mwaka ogw'okubanza omu ishomero eririmu obuyambi bw'abaine ebyetengo by'enjegyereza ebirikuruhande. Omu class, nashobora kutaaho omukago n'abanywani be hamwe n'abantu abakuru abamukuruhande kandi, omu bwire bw'okubangana, agataana omu mizano y'ekibiina. Kwonka, omu kuheereza, Sergio nacwekyereza omukago gwe n'abanywani be, ayoleka okukunda okuzana wenka, atekaine munonga, arikwemerera aha ntebe, agyema aha bintu ebirikushushana omu mbeera, kandi azinguruka obutoosha n'omubiri gwe. Oburemeezi bw'omuringo ki oburikukurira oburikushoborora emicwe ya Sergio?
answer_a: Okutahurira gye ahari ebintu ebirikukwata aha mutwe n'omubiri (hyposensitivity to vestibular stimuli)
answer_b: Okutahukaniza omubiri gw'omuntu n'ebintu ebirikukora aha mubiri ogwo (hypersensitivity) ahabw'amaani aga vestibular
answer_c: Okutahukaniza okungi aha bintu ebirikukwata aha mubiri n'omutwe gw'omuntu (proprioceptive stimuli)
answer_d: Okutahurira munonga ebintu ebirikukwata aha mubiri n'omutwe gw'omuntu (proprioceptive stimuli)

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Martina omwegi ow’emyaka ena orikwega omumutendera gw’okubanza ogw’okuhinduka. Akatandika kugaaya ebigambo bye eby’okubanza omu myaka ebiri n’ekicweka, okukira munonga kwetenga kwihaho obwetaago obuhangaine. Hati, nagumizamu n’orurimi rwe orutahurirwa, obumwe orurikushobororwa nk’orutahurirwa, nangwa n’obu okugambira kwe kurungi bwaba nagambira ebigambo ebi ahuriire ahari terefiziini. Agandiika n’ebigambo ebimwe kuruga omu bizane ebi akunda, naganira emiringo y’okugambira erimu okukora oburemeezi n’eddoboozi ry’omuringo ogu ahuriire. Emitwarize y’orurimi rwa Martina eyorekeireho omwegyesa we, orikwenda kukora okucungura kw’omutwe n’omutima kugira ngu amanye obutandikiro bw’emitwarize egi, ahabw’okuba nagira obuteebwa ngu omwegi ogu aine oburemeezi bw’omutwe oburikukwata aha muringo gw’okuteekateeka. Ni muringo ki ogu omwegyesa ashemereire kukora kukora okucungura kw’omutwe n’omutima kwa Martina?
answer_a: Baza ebirikukwata aha miringo y'emitwarize n'oburemu bw'okukora ebintu, ahabw'okushobora kumanya omuringo Martina arikwegamu n'obushobozi bwe, n'ekigyendererwa ky'okubangira amateeka n'enkoragana z'omurimo.
answer_b: Haandi y'okwebembera n'ekipimo ky'okushimira omuryango omu by'ahaiguru eby'okukura kw'omwana omu bintu bitari bimwe, kandi okagyeranisa ebirikugaruka omu kushimira oku n'ebi orikureeba omu klasa.
answer_c: Shaba omumwe gwezabu y'okushwijuma obwomeezi bwa Martina kuruga omu ka ye, okushobora kumanya IQ ye, kandi orugyendo rurugire omu by'okugarukamu, okukora entebeekanisa y'emirimo erikworeka ebice by'okukura ebi erikubaasa kuba neyoleka oburemeezi.
answer_d: Teeka erikwata aha bitegyererezo ebi erikushwijuma emigyendeserezo etaanu n'ebigyendererwa ebirikugambwaho omu Katebe k'Entegureza y'Eby'Okushomesa Abaana Abato, kushobora ebicweka ebirikwetenga obuhwezi n'okushobora ebi ebirikukorwa omu muringo ogurikumatiza.

question: Kushwijukya kureeba ebipimo by’okukura kw’omwana orikwija omu mwaka ogw’okubanza omu ishomero eririmu eishami eririkwata aha beene ekyetengo ky’omutaano, ni nkahi omu muringo ogurikukurira enyima ogurikukwata?
answer_a: Kukora okwetegyereza omwana omu biteekateeko n’omukugu omukora eby’obwomeezi, orikukozesa ekikoreso kya WAIS, kwetegyereza obwomeezi bw’omwana omu by’okwetegyereza.
answer_b: Hanga ebizami by'okushishoza, orikureeba embeera y'omweizi kandi, obwaba nibyetagisa, obihindure hamwe n'omwegyesa omukuru orikukora n'abaana abaine oburemeezi bw'okwega.
answer_c: Kukusanya ebimanyiso by’omuntu, embeera y’obuntu, n’eby’obuhangwa hamwe n’ekikundi ky’abegyesi ab’omutwe, orondoorere aha mutindo gw’okuganiira n’okwetungira, kwenda kutebeekanisa n’okucuura eby’okwegyesa by’omwegi.
answer_d: Shuubira omuringo gw'okukora okucungura kw'okumanya, okutandika n'okwombeka okuhitsya aha kucungura okw'aha muheru, n'abeesigwa ba buri isomo, kwetengyereza empindahinduka zoona ezirikwetengyesa omwegi.

question: Omu klasa y'abanaishomero b'omwaka gwa kabiri omu ishomero erikuru, abanaishomero mushanju abaine oburemeezi bwa Autism Spectrum Disorder nibeejunga. Omwegyesa naija kubeera naakora aha kiragiro ky'okwega: 'Kukuza amatsiko g'okumanya ebigambo nari emigaanuro ebi bataarikumanya n'okutooreza omulingo gw'okushuuruura amakuru gaabyo.' Omu klasa, harimu ebibiina bibiri eby'okwega: ekimu kirimu abanaishomero bataano abamazire kutunga obureezi bw'okushoma aha mutendera gw'ebigambo n'ekindi kibiina kirimu abanaishomero babiri abataratunga obureezi bw'okushoma. Ahabw'embeera enu, omwegyesa ashemereire kutebeekanisa eishomo erihikiire ekiragiro ky'okwega ekiragwiirwe, baitu n'emilimo ehikiire buli kibiina ky'abanaishomero ekyagambiirwe. Ni muringo ki ogurikukurira oguhikiire abanaishomero kwongyera obwengye bwabo bw'ebigambo?
answer_a: Omugyezibwa naija kuha abaana abarikushoma n’ebyangaanisa ebirimu ebigambo by’okushoma, ahabuhandiiki bw’ebigambo by’okuserchinga, ahu baraashanga ebigambo, reero bashange amakuru gaabyo omu dikishinari; abaana abatarikushoma, nibaija kukora n’obuhabuzi oburimu ebigambo n’ebishushani, ebi baine kweshushanisa ku baraabe bamanyire ngu nibishushana.
answer_b: Omugurusi arakuheereza ekibiina ekiine oburemeezi bw'okushoma ebipande ebiine ebigambo by'okukoraana nabyo omu kwatanisa n'okutoorana ebishushani by'ebigambo by'omugasho ahabeegi; ekindi kibiina ekiine obushoboorozi bw'okushoma kirakora aha kutoorana ebigambo kuruga aha bipande ebiine ebi baraakozesa kukora n'okuhandiika sentensi n'okuzishoma omu iraka.
answer_c: Omugyezibwa naija kukora arikukoresa omuringo gw’okukora ogurikukwata aha mirimo yoona n’abegi boona mushanju, arikushoma orutabo ruto kubaasa kuteeraho kwongyera aha kumanya ebi barikushoma, arikugyenda naayenda ngu abegi bakoresese ebigambo bingi barikugyenda nibahindura ebigambo n’ebishushani, nibabasiisa kubaasa kukora sentensi nini.
answer_d: Omugyezibwa naija kworeka ekikundi eki batakatunga bushobozi bw'okushoma enyuguta ibiri, P na M, ezi baraakenera kwegaita n'enyigizo kutandika kushoma enjigizo ezi baraareetera kukwatagana n'ebishushani ebirikugyenda n'enjigizo y'okubanza; ekikundi eki kirimu obushobozi bw'okushoma kiraashaka amazima g'ebigambo ebi bataarikumanya omu kabereberye erimu orugano kandi barashomeza amakuru gaabyo aha tabuleti zaabo

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurikira: Luis omwojo orina emyaka etaano, arikushoma omumutendera gwakabiri ogw’okuhindura omuishomero eririmu eishami ry’abaine oburemeezi obutaari bumwe. Nayegaita omu muringo gw’emirimo etarikushushana ey’omuriizoona kandi nashobora kugarukamu emizaano erikuragirwa, nangwa n’obu omumirimo erikwetaga omutindo ogwaiguru, nabura omuntu omurikwenda kumuhabura n’okumushagika omubiri kuruga omwegyesa. Ekizibu kye ekikuru omu bwengye bw’eby’okushoma n’orurimi, ahabw’okuba akoresa obugambo bumwe bw’omugasho kandi ahuraho ahuraho nagira obwengye bw’okutandika okugamba, ekirikuzibukwa orurimi rwe orurikugarukamu (okugarukamu ebigambo by’omuntu omuhanda hamwe n’ebirikugarukwamu nyima y’obwire). Ni muringo ki ogurikukwatanisa n’okwongyera aha mutindo gw’okugamba kwa Luis?
answer_a:
Omuzinga gw’ebigambo: Ekitabo ky’okukuratira ebigambo ebirikukora

Ekitabo eki nikikwaasa Luis kwongyera aha bushobozi bwe bw’okugamba kuraba omu bigambo ebirikukora ebirimu akabonero k’omugogo gw’ebinyagwa n’okutaanisa ebigambo omu ndimi.

Ebigambo ebirikukora:

Ndi (N-di): Nikimanyisa ngu nooli omuntu.
Oli (O-li): Nikimanyisa ngu nooli omuntu ogundi.
Ari (A-ri): Nikimanyisa ngu omuntu ondiijo.
Turi (Tu-ri): Nikimanyisa ngu nituli abantu.
Muri (Mu-ri): Nikimanyisa ngu muli abantu.
Bari (Ba-ri): Nikimanyisa ngu bali abantu.

Eky’okureeberaho:

Ndi Luis.
Oli Maria.
Ari John.
Turi abanyeshuri.
Muri abarezi.
Bari abakozi.

Ebigambo ebindi ebirikukora:

Nina (Ni-na): Nikimanyisa ngu nyine ekintu.
Oina (O-i-na): Nikimanyisa ngu oyine ekintu.
Aine (A-i-ne): Nikimanyisa ngu ayine ekintu.
Twiine (Twi-i-ne): Nikimanyisa ngu twine ekintu.
Mwine (Mwi-ne): Nikimanyisa ngu mwine ekintu.
Baine (Ba-i-ne): Nikimanyisa ngu baine ekintu.

Eky’okureeberaho:

Nina ekitabo.
Oina ekaramu.
Aine empapura.
Twiine eshomero.
Mwine omureezi.
Baine obwengye.

Ebigambo ebindi ebirikukora:

Ninkunda (Nin-ku-nda): Nikimanyisa ngu ninkukunda.
Ninkukunda (Nin-ku-ku-nda): Nikimanyisa ngu ninkukukunda.
Nimukunda (Ni-mu-ku-nda): Nikimanyisa ngu nimukukunda.
Nibakunda (Ni-ba-ku-nda): Nikimanyisa ngu nibakukunda.

Eky’okureeberaho:

Ninkunda maama.
Ninkukunda taata.
Nimukunda abanyeshuri.
Nibakunda omureezi.

Kurata:

Koresa ebigambo ebi buri izooba.
Gerageza kukora sentensi zaawe.
Shaba omuntu akukwase.
answer_b: Koresa eky’okukoresa orubazo rw’emikono n’endimi egi orikugambwa omu bwire bwona omu mirimo etungiirweho omwegyesa, okuraba omu bipande ebiteirwe omu myanya erikwetengwa ahu Luis arikubaasa kwegaita n’okwetegyereza obwire obutari bumwe n’emirimo, nikimwemerera kwongyera okwetegyereza kwe n’orurimi orikugambwa.
answer_c: Koresaamu akakwatanisibwa n’akatonde, omwegyesa yaashobora kuteeraho ebishushani by’ebintu rundi ebikorwa ebikwatanisaanisa n’omurimo oguraakorerwe. Luis ku araabe naatoorana eby’okukoresa n’emirimo omu bw’omwebembe n’akatonde, omwegyesa naija kuba naayoreka okutoora omu magambo ngu asobole kwiita omu maisho n’okuhuumuriza amakuru n’omurimo ogutebeekanisiibwe.
answer_d: Shaba omuringo ogundi gw'omukura gwa Minspeak kuraba omu bubaaara bw'okuhariirana obw'omutaano kurabira omuri kompyuta, aharikworekwa ebishushani ebirikushushana, ebirimu amakuru g'omutaano, ngu Luis ashobore kwakiira n'okwetegyereza obutumwa obutari bumwe kurikurugiira aha ku yatooranize ebishushani, nikyongyera okwetaba kwe n'okugamba omu mbeera ez'omutaano

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omu mwaka gwa mbere gw’eishomero ry’abaana abaine oburemeezi bw’omutwe, harimu Mateo, omwegi aine ekizibu kya Autism Spectrum Disorder orikukwatanisa gye n’abandi kandi aine orurimi orurikukora gye n’ebindi ebintu ebirikukwatanisa n’okugamba. Oburengane bwe bw’okushoma n’okuhandiika nibumwemerera kumanya enyuguta n’amazima agariho, kandi n’okushoma n’okwetegyereza ebigambo ebikwatanisa n’obugaragaro bwe obw’omunsi. Omu kubuurira kwe, ayorekire ebi arikukunda n’okutsigana n’okukwatanisa kw’ebigambo by’obujunaanizibwa. Omwegyesa wa Mateo aine ekigyendererwa ky’okukora aha bigyendererwa by’okwega ebirikukurataho n’eklassi: Kwetegyereza ebyahandiikirwe, okukoresa amagezi g’okwetegyereza okushoma, nk’eky’okureeberaho: okushusha eki ekyahandiikirwe kirikushoboorora. Ni bumwe aha magezi agarikukurataho oburikukora aha byetengo by’okushagika bya Mateo?
answer_a: okukoresa ebigambo ebiriyo amana ku mutwe gwe, ebi arikukoresa kuraba omu kumanya ebiragiro by'okuhandiika n'okushoma, ahabw'okukora omutaano gw'okwega: okushoma, okuhandiika, n'okwetegyereza
answer_b: Koresa omubazi ogufuuka omunaku, ogurikukwata aha bigambo ebirikukoresibwa omu by’okushoma, n’ebirikuhwera omwegi kwetegyereza ebi arikushoma.
answer_c: Koresa ebitabo ebirimu ebishushani ebirikukwata omutima omwegi kandi omwegi akoresa obushushani oburikumuheereza amakuru ag'omugasho, arikugyaho amakuru agataireho omugasho kurugiirira omu kitabo, eki nikikwata omutima gwe kumuhwera kwetegyereza.
answer_d: Koresa eby'okukoresa ebirimu ebigambo n'ebishushani, omwegi asobole kwegaita n'ekishushani nariho ekiteekateeko eki birikushushana, naayenda omu maisho kukora sentensi, kuruga omu zirikworoora kukyija omu zigumire, arikukoresa obubonero n'ebigambo.

question: Shomaisho omushomo ogurikukurataho: Mauricio naaza omuishomero ry'abato ery'omuriina ekitongore ky'abantu abaine oburemeezi obutaaine bumwe. Naatwariramu emirimo etari emwe erikutebeekanisibwa n'obushoboorozi oburikweyongyera buri kasumi. Oburemeezi bwe nibukwata aha rurimi ahabw'okuba, n'obu arikukora ebikorwa by'okushanga ebintu omu mwanya, bikaba bitarikomera, okugamba omu bwengye kukaba kurikukyeeka, kandi okukoresa ebigambo ebitarikwetegyerezebwa kwingi nikikoma omu kwetegyereza ebi arikugamba. Omwegyesa w'aha mutendera ogu naakora, omu mutima gw'Orurimi rw'Okugamba, aha mugingo gw'okwega: "Nitugamba n'abanywani baitu omu muringo murungi kandi ogurikwetegyerezebwa." Kandi ahabw'okworohereza okuhana ebiteekateeko n'okukuraaza orurimi rw'okugamba omuri Mauricio, omwegyesa naacwamu kutaaho enkora y'okuhana ebiteekateeko ey'emiringo ebiri omu muringo gwe ogurikugyenda n'emikono n'okugamba, omu kasumi kamwe arikukoresa omuringo gw'okuhurira n'okugamba n'omuringo gw'okureeba n'emikono. Naaiha omwegi obutumwa bw'orurimi orurikukirayo oburikworeka orutonde rw'omushorongo orurikwija kucwamu empindahinduka y'ebyo arikukora, hamwe n'obubonero bw'okureeba n'emikono. Ahabw'enki okutaaho enkora y'okuhana ebiteekateeko ey'emiringo ebiri omwegyesa kurikukwatanisa n'obuhangwa bw'okukora aha byetengo bya Mauricio eby'obuyambi?
answer_a: Ahabw’okuba nirukonyera kandi nikureetera omwegi kuganira n’obusi bw’omuburingwa bwe arikukoresa emihanda etari emwe neyongyera orurimi rw’okugamba.
answer_b: Ahabw’okuba nikyoreka omwegi omuringo gw’okutunga obwengye bw’okushoma n’okuhandiika omu bwangye, nikongyera aha maani g’omugisha gwe gw’eby’obushomesha.
answer_c: Ahabw’okuba nikongyeera omwana okwetwara omu maisho arikubaasa kugarukamu ebibuuzo by’okumwesereza ebirikutebeekanisibwe omu muringo murungi kandi ogurikworeka.
answer_d: Ahabw’okuba neekiha omwegi ebikoreso birungi okuhurikiza ebi arikukunda n’ebyo arikwetenga omu mizaano n’okukwatanisa n’abandi.

question: Shoma omu mbeera egi: Omu kiraasi ey’okubanza omu ishomero eririmu abaana abaine oburemeezi obw’omutaano, Veronica, omwegiaine n’ekizibu kya Autism Spectrum Disorder, nayegaho. Atwarirwa nk’omuntu orikukunda munonga kucweekereza ebintu kandi nashemererwa kukora n’ebikoreso by’okwegyesa; kwonka, ayorekwa emicwe y’obuhumbuura obw’amaani obu arikwenda kutunga ebintu ebi abegyi bane barikukoresa, ahabw’okuba abitatwara obuhendo. Emihwe emwe aha micwe egi negarukamu obu arikwetenga kuza omu byumba by’okwegyesa ebindi, ahu kimugumira kutaaha, eki nikigarukamu kandi obu arikuba asaana kugaruka omu kyumba kye ky’okwegyesa bwanyima y’okuruuhuka, eky’okulya, nari eky’okurugamu, ahabw’okuba abura omuhanda, akataaha omu byumba ebindi. Omu biteekateeko ebi orikurora nk’ebirikukwata aha muringo gw’okwegyesa ogurikusaana kukoresa kureeberera Veronica n’obweetaago bwe bw’obuhwezi?
answer_a: Nitwekyendeza aha kukuza obwengye bw’omwegyesa omu kiraasi, omwegyesa omuto aketegyereza ebikorwa bye ahabw’omuringo gw’okwegyesa ogurikukoresibwa nari ebikorwa ebirikumwemerera kureeba n’okuhindura emitwarize ye n’okugiringanisa n’eya banywani be.
answer_b: Higaanisa omukago ogw’amaani hagati y’omwegyesa n’omwegi, okugaziya omukago ogwo n’okugyira omu bitoosha ebiri ahagati y’ekikaari ky’okwegyera. Hanga entebeekanisa y’okuhindurana omu kisaa kya okuzanira n’omu kaafueteriya, gyeka abegyesa obwire bw’okubeera omu byanya ebi, nari obworaaba nikyeteengwa, shaho eky’okuragira ekirikworeka ngu buri kitoosha n’omurimo gwona gw’eishomero birikugyenda birikumpiirirwa.
answer_c: Higa omuringo gw’emyeshomereza mirungi omu klasirumu orikurabira omu kutebeekanisa ebirabo ebirungi ebirikukendeza omu muringo gw’okukora ebintu omu bwangu n’okwongyera amaani omwegi okukora ebintu omu muringo ogurikwetagisa, kandi okore obuhwezi bw’‘Omwebemberi’ hamwe na banywani be, orikwongyera aha bushobozi bwe bw’okutwara abantu omu miringo erikwetagisa n’okuhikiirira obushobozi bw’okumanya ahu ahererezi.
answer_d: Shuubya omuhendo gw'okukoresa obuhabuzi bw'amaisho omu ishomero, omwegi asobole kuteerereza empinduka, okuhindura embeera y'ekikaikuru n'ebifo by'amashomo eby'obutongore, n'okukoresa eby'okuteekamu ebintu by'omurimo eby'obutongore, nibyongyerwaho okukoresa ebishushani omu mbeera ez'omutaano.

question: Omu omwana Antonia, orikwega omu mwaka ogw'okubanza omu ishomero eririmu enteekateeka y'abanaab'eitaago erikuru, aine ekizibu ky'oburemeezi bw'omutwe (Autism Spectrum Disorder), akaijukira kutaaha omu kiraasi. Omuishwa ogu tarikumanyisa gye ebi arikwenda, nangwa obu arikuteeraho; narora abantu abakuru omu maisho kubaasa kumuta omutima; nayoleka okukunda ebintu okumara obwiire bukye kandi omu kiraasi, obutoosha naayenda ebintu bisya. Aine oburemeezi bw'okuhindura ebikorwa ahabw'okuba atarikukuratira entebeekanisa n'ebicweka by'izooba ry'eishomero, nayoleka obusungu, embeera erikukendeera omu makkati g'esande kwonka neegarukamu buri Bwaireero. Omu mbeera egi, abarikukwasa nibacwamu kukoresa omuringo na Antonia oguraamukwasa kwetegyereza entebeekanisa y'eishomero n'okuba omu kiraasi. Omu miringo egi erikukurataho, nigure ogurikukwasa abarikukwasa kugarukamu ebyetaago bya Antonia?
answer_a: Bumbaho obusinge oburikukwatanisa n'okuhiga: yoleka omutima ogw'okugumisiriza, obwangu n'okugumira, okore n'ebirikukurahura omu muringo ogurikugyendera aha bifaananyi by'okwebuzya ebirikuhiga okwetegyereza emicwe mirungi omu kiraasi.
answer_b: Muhemu obwire bwingi bw’okukuratamu omwana: koresa ebikoreso by’eby’okwegyesa ebirimu oburyo bwingi bw’okumanya ebintu ebirikukwatana n’ebyo arikukunda, mukorere hamwe omwe-aha-mwe omu bikorwa kutoora okuhitsya obu araatungye obwetengyeerwa, omutuurise n’abanywani be abarikubaasa kumuha eky’okureeberaho kirungi ekurikurata.
answer_c: Ha omuzingo ogutahinduka omu by’omugisha by’eshomero: tangaaza orutindo rw’omuntu omu bitebe byoona omwegi arikukorera omu, tebeekanisiza ekibanza kyawe eky’okukorera hamwe n’ebishushani ebirikuhikaana n’obwetengo bwawe n’amaani gaawe.
answer_d: Kuhanga emiringo: kutaho obwire bw'okuceeceera omu ishuri, kutebeekaniza emyitooro y'okubangura omutwe aha kutandika kw'amasomo na omu kubiindura ebikorwa n'obwire bukye, kworeka aha kabaho orutonde lw'ebiro n'okuhingurana kw'amasomo hamwe n'okukurikiraniza aha mutindo gw'okuhikiiriza emirimo.

question: Omuhanda ki ogurikukurira omu kubazamu ogusingiremu obuhikire kwenda kukurira omucwezi ogwatekwaireho ekitongore?
answer_a: Tebeekanisa okuheereza obuhabuzi bw'amaisho, nk'ebipande, okutebeekanisa n'okuhaziisa emizaano, okwongyera aha kutegyera kwa Tamara ebiri omunda y'ebirikukorwaho omu gumu gwona.
answer_b: Rooramu emizaano erikukuriraana n'ebyo Tamara akunda, orikukoresa ebintu eby'ahaiguru, kandi orikwanguhya okwegamira aha muntu kurabira omu kworeka emicwe y'abeesomesa na banywani be.
answer_c: Sharamura ebiri Tamara arikukunda, orikugyenderera aha bi, okore n'ekibiina buri sande orugyendo orw'aha bintu ebiri omu butwaare bwaitu ebi arikukunda, ahu arikubaasa kutooreza emikoranire n'abandi banywani be, omu mbeera etari nk'ey'omukiro.
answer_d: Shutama emizaano erikwebemberwa, erikuhikaana n’ebirikurugamu omu bigendererwa ebirikushobororwa omu Ndango, ahabw’okukora aha mikago ya Tamara n’abandi, kandi omu bwire bumwe, okukora omurimo gw’okwegyesa kurikuhikaana n’ebirikurugamu omu mutendera.

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurataho: Asuncian ni omwegi ow’emyaka ena owaakasangwa n’ekirwadde kya Autism Spectrum Disorder kandi aingire omuishomero erikuruukirwe. Ayoreka oburemeezi omu mikwatane y’abantu; nashobora kugarukamu gye ebikorwa ebimuragirwe, baitu akangaana kwehanganira empinduka omu byanya n’omuringo gw’ebintu. Nyina naagamba ngu kigumire munonga kuruga omuka na Asuncian kutaayaaya omuntu, kugyenda omu park, rundi kugura ebintu, ahabw’okuba atungura obutoosha, n’ahabw’ekyo okugyenda kwe kukendeeraho okumutwara omuishomero. Omugurusi n’omukugu w’eby’omutwe omu itendekyero bagira ngu nyina wa Asuncian akuratireho ebikorwa ebi: Okumworeka (ebishushani) n’okumugambira (ebihendo) omu bunaku oburikukuraataho n’oburikukurataho okuruga. Okumuhereza ebirabo by’okusiima omwegi ku ayoreka omulingo gwona ogurikwetegwa. Twaba nitwetegereza emicwe ya Asuncian, omuhendo ki ogurikukurataho ogurikushobora gye kwemeereza obukuru bw’ebikorwa by’okumutebeekanisiza ebi abakugu omu itendekyero eryo baragira?
answer_a: Baryamuha kumuha oburinzi kuraba omu kwongyerera amaani omukago gw'abantu.
answer_b: Baryamuha ngu bakamuhe obucureezi kuraba omu kumugumya omu by'eshuri.
answer_c: Baraamuha kumuha oburinzi kuraba omu kumuhiga omu mutima.
answer_d: Baryamuha kumuha obucureezi kuraba omu kuteeraho obwengye bwe.

question: Shoma omubaire: Daudi ni omwegi orikurwara endwara ya Autism Spectrum orimu omurongo gwakabiri omuishomero erikuru kuhikaana. Aine emitwarize mirungi aha by’okwega, naamanya ebishushani, kandi ari omubucweka bwa IV obw’okukoresa PECS (Picture Exchange Communication System). Nikimwe, nayoreka okusiima omumakuru g’omutanda, ekirikugumya emirimo ye y’eishomero ahabw’okuba arikuruga omu kicweka ky’okwegyeramu yaaza omu kicweka ky’obuhangwa kandi ahindura programu aha kompyuta. Kandi aiba esimu ye omuishomero kandi n’obu araabe naamanya ebiragiro kutagikoresa, nagikoresa n’obu kiraabe kiri kityo, nikireeta oburemeezi yaagaana kugita omukabati. Omwegyesa akakora oruteerane n’eka y’omwegi ahu bagambire ngu nabo baine oburemeezi bumwe omuka n’omu myanya endiijo ahabw’okuba Daudi nahindura programu nari ashorora amakuru kuruga aha kompyuta yoona ei arikuba aine omugisha gw’okukoresa; kwetantara obutabangaaniso, nibenda omwana waabo akorese esimu ye. Noorekire ebi Daudi asima esimu ye na kompyuta, ni muringo ki ogurikukirayo kuhikaana kureetera okukoresa obwire bwe obw’obusingye n’okukura kw’obureezi?
answer_a: Yombeka ebiragiro ebirikugambira abegi n'abazaire ebi baraabe nibakuratira omu class n'omuka, hamu n'okubara ebikorwa by'omwegi, n'okucweeka ebi arikukora aha mitwaro y'obuhangwa omu byombibi.
answer_b: Shutama enteekateeka y'obwire bw'okukoresa eby'omuburingaaniza omu bwire obutungiirweho, hamu n'ensaasi y'okumwesomesa obwire buhikire bw'okubireka, kandi osabe okugara eky'omunda ky'eisomero ebiro byoona n'okukora aha kompyuta kurugiirira aha misimbo y'okwingira.
answer_c: Teeka entebeekanisa n'obwire obutebeekanisiibwe omu ka, koresa ebintu ebirikworeka omu bwire bukuru, koresa ekintu ekirikukwatwa kuteeka omu kintu eki orikukunda kandi okikozese nka eky'omugisha, hamu n'okuhwerekyereza okukoresa ebitebeekanisiibwe ebirikworeka okukoresa gye eby'omuringo ogu.
answer_d: Teeka ebiragiro by'emyeshuro y'omutwarize murungi omu ka, aha biro bimwe, obwahati n'obucureezi bw'emyeshuro y'emitwarize mibi n'ebirikukurataho nibikozesebwa n'omwegi, kandi omu klasii hakozesebwa empapuro nungi ezirikworeka amateeka agahikire.

question: Omurongo gw'abeeshomesa ab'omwaka gwa kabiri omu ishomero erikuru, abarikwenda kwegamira aha bana batooreine oburemeezi bwa ADHD, nigushoboororwa nk'omukago ogurikugenda nigwongyera kutaahirira emiringo etahoireho, nibaha ekitiinisa amateeka nibahweerwa abakuru kandi nibamaraho oburemeezi oburikukorwa; kwonka, omu mirimo erikukurura omutima gw'ekuru, okutebeekanisibwa kw'obwire kukaba kutari kurungi, eki nikireebwa omu kuhindura omurimo. Ebi barikukunda nibimanyirwe kandi, omu mbeera ezimu, nibirikugumiisiriza okukira abandi, nibetenga okugambirwa n'okukwatwa omwegyesa kugarura omutima aha biteekateeko bisya by'okwega. Ni muringo ki ogurikukwata aha kukora aha kutebeekanisibwa kw'obwire n'ekuru egi?
answer_a: Teeka orukundo rw'okugyenda rundi akatabo akarikugambira ab'eka buri izooba omulimo ogukozirwe omu ishomero, orikukoresa ekishushani ekirikwoleka omukurukuzo gw'ebikorwa bya buri izooba
answer_b: Tebeekanisa ekikaali n'akakarenda, orikukoresa obusaazo oburikugwiiraana oburikworeka omwanya gw'okukoreramu, nobutwara omu mpishoona hamwe n'omu mwanya eby'okukoresa biriyo.
answer_c:

2. Okwebaza Ruhanga (6:15 AM): Okushaba Ruhanga ahe omugisha ebiro byaitu.
3. Okwesomesa (6:30 AM - 7:30 AM): Okusoma ebitabo n'okweihamu obwengye (abanyeshuri abamwe tibarikukunda).
4. Okutebeekanisiza Eshomero (7:30 AM - 8:00 AM): Okutebeekanisa engoye z'eshomero n'ebindi byona ebyetaagisa.
5. Okurya Ekyaire (8:00 AM - 8:30 AM): Okurya eky'aire kirungi.
