8. Okurya Ekyemisana (12:00 PM - 1:00 PM): Okuhuumuraho n'okurya ekyemisana.
9. Okusoma Omu Kiro (1:00 PM - 3:00 PM): Okugyenda omu maisho n'eby'okusoma (okukora emirimo y'omuka nikiba kigumire aha banyeshuri abamwe).
10. Okugaruka Eka (3:00 PM - 3:30 PM): Okugaruka eka kuruga omu shomero.
11. Okukora Emirimo y'Eka (3:30 PM - 5:00 PM): Okukora emirimo y'eka nk'okwoza engoye n'okuteeka (emirimo y'eka etarikukundwa abanyeshuri).
12. Okuhuumura n'Okuzana (5:00 PM - 6:00 PM): Okuhuumura n'okuzana emizaano.
13. Okurya Eky'omwabazyo (6:00 PM - 6:30 PM): Okurya eky'omwabazyo kirungi.
14. Okwesomesa (6:30 PM - 7:30 PM): Okugarukamu ebyo mwegyeseize (abanyeshuri nibenda kuhuumura omu kasumi aka).
15. Okutebeekanisa Eby'okusoma Eby'enyencumweru (7:30 PM - 8:00 PM): Okutebeekanisa eby'okusoma eby'enyencumweru.
16. Okugenda Omu Buriri (8:00 PM): Okugenda omu buriri kuhuumura.
answer_d: Koresa endagaano y'okurora omu maisho n'omutindo gw'ebishushani ogurikutebeekanisa embeera z'obwire n'okushoma kuruga ahari bumosho kuza buryo, ogu guza kuba n'ebirango bibiri by'amabara (obwire obw'obutaheebwa/omurimo), kurahura kwijuka n'okuhurirana.

question: Shoma omu mbeera egi: Sabina ni omwegyesa orikurwara endwara y’obwongo eyorikwetwa Autism Spectrum Disorder orikwega omu ishuri ry’abaana abato ery’ishuri eririkwenda abantu abarikurwara endwara ezirikukwata omu bwongo. Akunda enyimba z’abaana, ezi arikwoleka ngu azikunda munonga, kandi akunda kukora n’ebintu ebirikukwatwa n’amaisho kandi ebirikurabura. Omu by’okuhurirana n’okwetegyereza abantu, arikwoleka oburemeezi bwingi: tarikugamba; arikukoresa abantu abakuru kumuhereza eki arikwenda, nk’eky’okureeberaho, obu arikweshengyereza kwoleka eki arikwenda kandi batamwetegyereza, arikwehurira aha itaka naashweka okuhitsya obu arikukihereza; akakyayanga kutaaha omu kicweka ky’okwegyeramu, naagwatira aha muryango kandi naata ebintu bye. Kurugiirira aha mbeera egi, omwegyesa naakora omuringo gw’okukora ogu arikwenda kukoresa omu ishuri n’eka: naamwikiriza kuhurira orunyimba rwe orukundwa obu arikutaaha omu kicweka ky’okwegyeramu kandi naamuha ebintu bye ebi arikukunda arikukoresa ebishushani, naahwera omu kuhurirana arikukoresa ebishushani, kandi naashaba ab’eka kuteeraho kukora ebintu birungi. Omu bintu ebiri ahansi aha, ekiheebwa kiki ekirikushoboorora gye omuringo ogurikuteekateekwa omwegyesa omu mbeera ya Sabina?
answer_a: Okukoresa ebikoreso by'okwegyesa nikikonyaho omwegi ebiro by'okurira; n'ebikorwa ebirikuteekateekwa nibihikaana n'emyaka ye aha mutendera gw'esomero ery'abato.
answer_b: Omutindo gw'ebikorwa ebirikukorwa nigwija kuhwera omwegi kwetegyereza n'okutebeekanisa omuhanda gw'ebikorwa bye, nukwo kirukukora omutima gw'okwega n'okutegeka emikorere.
answer_c: Omukwenda ogu omukundwa n'ensibo erikuhiga abeeshuri abarikugira oburemeezi bwa Autism Spectrum Disorder; nikyorobiha kutaaha omu klasiruumu omu muringo ogurungi; okukira ahari ekyo, omutindo gw'ebikorwa ebirikutebeekanisibwa niguhikaana n'emyaka y'abaana abato ab'omu pulisikuuru.
answer_d: Ebirikukorwa nibiyamba omwegi kurengyesereza emicwe ye aha miteekateeko y’eklassi n’eka, nibikuriza okukura kw’obwesigye omunshomero n’omuka.

question: Omumwe aha ishomero erikuru, omwegyesa w'ekika kya munaana naakora buri izooba aha mikora y'obwomeezi omu muringo ogurikwambukira aha byona ahabw'okukuzamu okukura kw'obwengye bw'abegi be okurikukwatana n'okutegeka n'okwezirika aha mico yaabo, arikubatebeekanisiza omwaka ogurikwija obu baraahangaanira n'omutindo gw'omurimo ogurikugira ebiragiro bingi. N'ahabw'ekyo, naakora omutendera gw'emikora ogurikukurataho: 1. Okureeta enamba n'enjobe ezitarikutebeekanisibwa: omwegi omwe na omwe, buri omwe naagamba omu iraka, omu muringo gwona, enamba kuruga aha 1 kuhika aha 20 nari enjobe z'orunyara, atarikugarukamu njobe nari enamba ezi abegi be abandi baamaze kugamba. 2. Okugarukamu ebiceera: omwegyesa nashoma orutonde lw'ebigambo 20 kandi naashaba abegi kukoma aha mesa yaabo obu bahurira eiziina ry'enyamaishwa. Ku amaze kushoma, naabashaba kugarukamu ebigambo byona ebitari nyamaishwa reero n'ebiri nyamaishwa. 3. Engyendo z'okureeba omu mwanya: omwegyesa naayoreka akatimba ka 3 x 3 (ebikwaara bishatu aha buri rubaju), arikworeka ekikwaara ahu omweshongoro gutandikira. Reero, akatimba nikabura, kandi abegi baine kuha ebiragiro by'okureeba omu mwanya nk'ebi: yengyera aha iguru ekikwaara kimwe, genda omu maisho omu kikwaara ekiri aha buryo, kworeka ekikwaara ky'ekintu ekyatandikireho. Emikora ei omwegyesa ou arikukora neekwatana na miko ki y'obwomeezi?
answer_a: Okutebeekanisa
answer_b: Okukora omuntu kuremesa ebintu ebi arikwenda kukora
answer_c: Obwengye bw’okuhinduka omu biteekateeko
answer_d: Okukora ebirikukora

question: Omuheresi ahabw'enki emiringo ei omwegyesa yaakozeseze neeyikiriza kukuraho oburemeezi bw'okwega bw'abeeshure be?
answer_a: Ahabw’okuba emitindo egi neyombeka okwetegyereza embeera y’eishomero aha banyeshuri, neyongyera okucweekereza ebirikubetaho omu muringo murungi, kandi n’okuhindura ebikozesebwa kurugiirira aha mutendera gwabo, obusaasi buceera kandi n’okumanyira embeera nekwongyera.
answer_b: Ahabw’okuba emitindo egi negira amagara g’okumaraho ebizibu by’abeeshuri ebirikukwata aha kwangaanisa orurimi, okuhereza ebigambo n’ebitarikuherezebwa, n’okubaasa n’okubaasa ahabw’okuba negira amagara g’okumaraho oburemeezi bwabo omu mbeera z’abantu hamwe n’okubakurinda omu mwanya ogurikurindwa kandi ogutebeekanisibwe
answer_c: Ahabw’okuba emitindo egi neegyemereza kwetaho embeera ezirikwija kukuratira omu miringo n’okutwara amagyerageza ahari okwega n’ebigyendererwa by’okwegyesa, kurikukiriza okugarukamu omu miringo mibi erikwolekwa abeeshuri abarikwetenga obuhwezi oburikukiraho.
answer_d: Ahabw'okuba emitindo egi erikukwata aha byona neehikaana n'amaani n'omurimo gw'omuntu omwe-omu-mwe nk'oku abeeshuri abarikukwata aha kizibu kya autism spectrum disorder bashemereire kutunga, omurimo gw'omuntu omwe-omu-mwe, kandi nibwo nibareeba oburemeezi bwabo aha mutindo gw'obusinge n'emikwatane yabo n'abandi omu kashooba k'okuzana n'okushoma omu kiraasi.

question: Shoma omubaire: Benjamin omwegyeshwa orikugira oburemeezi bwa Autism Spectrum Disorder orikwega omu mwaka gwa kabiri omu ishomero eririmu abegyeshwa abarikukora omurimo hamwe. Agumize omukago murungi n'abegyeshwa bagyenzi be kandi obumwe neeyegaita omu mizaano omu bwire bw'oku huruuka. Orurimi rwe orw'okugamba rurikye, eki nikireeta okuhugura nari okwetenga omu kumanya ebintu ebirikugambwa n'ebi arikugamba, kandi atakahiitsireho kushoma omu buringaniza. Omu isomo ry'Obwegyesa bw'Eby'omugisha, omwegyesa w'abegyeshwa abarikugira oburemeezi n'omwegyesa omukuru nibakora aha birikukurataho: Kutebeekanisa emirimo y'okuhanga ekintu ky'eby'omugisha, okushobanura ebikorwa, ebintu, n'ebikoreso ebyetengwa okushiika aha birikwetegwa. Omu tubinja tukye, abegyeshwa nibaija kuhanga ebishushani by'ebintu, nk'eradiyo, ttivi, amasimu, n'ebindi. Hamwe na Benjamin, okuhindura omulingo gw'ebirikukurataho nikwija kukorwa, eki nikikwata aha kukoresa ebishushani by'obubonero okutebeekanisa ebikumanyisa n'okwongyera entaanira ezirikukuratwa okuhanga ekintu. Omulingo ki ogurikukoresibwa okuhindura omulingo gw'ebirikukurataho ogu abakugu baraakoresa ngu Benjamin atungye okwega n'okwetaba nk'abegyeshwa bagyenzi be?
answer_a: Okuteera omu obwire
answer_b: Okugyaho ebi orikwega
answer_c: Kugumya omugisha gw'ebyeshuro
answer_d: Kutahoora ebirikukirayo obukuru omu bitebeekaniso by'okwegyesa n'ebirikwegyesibwa

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurikira: Julian, omwegi aine oburemeezi bwa Autism Spectrum Disorder, nayenda esomero ry'abaana abato eririmu programu z'obwegyesa ezihangwa omu nshonga ze. Omuriiwe, obushoboorozi bw'okugamba nibureebwa ahabw'okuba nagamba ebigambo bimwe ebirikukora okuhikiiriza ebi arikwetenga omu kasumi ako. Aha bikwaata aha buhinguzi bwe bw'okuteekateeka, naamanya obumwe aha mitwarize y'ebintu ebiriyo omu magara, naragaana n'engaro kworeka ebyo, kandi naamanya emitwarize erikukiraho y'ebintu ebirikukwaata aha miringo n'amabara atarikukoresa muringo gw'okugyeragyeranisa. Omwegyesa nakora, omu mutima gw'okuteekateeka kw'ebara, aha mugasho gw'okwega: Kugezesa emikwatane y'obwengye-y'ebara y'okutebeekanisibwa, kutaaho emikwatane kuraba omu miringo n'emitwarize etari emwe. Twaba nituteekateeka aha ku buhinguzi bw'okuteekateeka bwa Julian burikukura, ni muringo ki ogurikukiraho kukora aha mugasho gw'okwega ogwatebeekanisiibwe omwegyesa?
answer_a: Koresa ebintu ebirikukozesebwa omurundi gumwe ebirikubaasa kuhindurwa n'ebishushani ebi Julian arikubaasa kumanya, ahu arikubaasa kukorera omugisha omu by'obwengye n'okubara, kurugiirira aha miteera nari amarangi.
answer_b: Koresa ebintu ebirikukirayo obukuru omu byaro ebi, ebi arikubaasa kukoresa kukuza obureezi bw'obwengye bw'okubara n'okutebeekanisiza omu mitindo, okutandika n'okwesigama aha miringo, bwanyima, aha nteekateeka.
answer_c: Koresa ebintu n'ebishushani ebirikushangwa omu magara, arikubaasa kugyenda nabo omu kubahindisa, arikutorana ebi birikushushana, kushobora ngu nabimanya reero akore emyitooro arikuronderera embeera y'omutindo n'erangi
answer_d: Koresa Julian akoreshe ebishushani ebi orikumanya, orikwegamira aha mishushani egi, mushabe akore emyitooro y'obwengye bw'ekibalangulo, orikukurata emisingi y'emiterere n'obunene, hanyuma akore emyitooro y'okutebeekanisiza omuhendo.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omu mwaka gwa kabiri gw'eshomero erimu abegyereza abaine oburemeezi obutari bumwe, Alondra, omwegyereza ow'emyaka munaana orikugyezibwa ngu aine ekizibu kya Autism spectrum disorder, nayegaho. Akatunga obureezi n'okuhandiika atarikukozesa obuhwezi bw'omutaano. Naayenda obwire bwona kugamba n'abakuru, kwonka ti na banywani be, abarikucweerwa nari batarikwetegyereza eki arikugamba ahabw'okuba ensonga ye y'okugamba nekomererwe aha kicweka eki arikukunda, ebimera, ebi arikugambaho omu rurimi rurikuzibira kandi rurungi munonga. Omubaire ogu gukomizeho okwegyenda omu bibiina by'emirimo n'emizano. Omu isomo ry'Orurimi n'Okugambirana, omwegyesa arateekanisa emirimo etari emwe n'ekigendererwa ky'okwegyesa eki kurugiirira aha kiraasi: "Okukozesa omu muringo ogurikwetagisa ebigambo bisya ebirikugyibwa omu bihandiiko ebirikuhurirwa nari ebirikushomwa omu kuhandiika." Ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurataho erikukwata ahari Alondra kwetaba omu kwega arikukora na banywani be?
answer_a: Shuuruza eklaasi omukazi orikwetwa Alondra yaayorekye omuhendo gw'amanye gye aine aha bikwaatsi, reero yaagarukamu ebibuuzo eby'abanywani be abarikumubuza aha by'ayorekire, abaraabe baine kutebeekanisa obucweka bw'ebyo yaayorekire.
answer_b: Tebeekanisize ebyangwe ebirimu ebigambo ebirikukoresibwa omu muringo ogwa kyabufuzi n'ebyangwe ebindi ebirimu amakuru gaabyo. Eklaasi neegaburwamu omutwe gw'abantu abarikukwatanisa ebyangwe kurugiirira aha kushoma kw'omuntu okw'ekigambo ekirikugyeenda, n'ekyangwe ekindi ekirikugira amakuru agarikuhikaana nago.
answer_c: Tegeka ebigambo ikumi ebitarikukira kugambwa kandi ebirikukwata aha mutwe gw'ebimera; bwanyima y'okutegeka, abeeshuri nibaija kushaka amakuru g'ebigambo ebyo omuri dikishinari zaabo kworeka ab'ekibiina eki barikushanga n'omugasho ogurikubaasa kukoresibwa:
answer_d: Teekateeka y’okushoma n’obuyambi bw’ekishushani kya PowerPoint erimu ebigambo Alondra arikumanya kandi ebikwata ku biti; bwamara kushoma oruteeka, ekibiina kiija kuhandiika omu bbitabo byabo ebigambo ebi bataamanya ebi baahuriire; bwamara kugaburwa omu bibiina, nibaija kubuuza Alondra amakuru g’ebigambo ebi baahandiika.

question: Omwegyesereza ki omwegyesa w’ekicweka eki arikukoresa kushemerera omutindo gw’obugufu bw’ekigyendererwa ky’okwegyesa?
answer_a: Ebirikuta omugasho gw'ebintu ebirikukwata aha kuhandiika n'okugamba nka: okugamba, okushoma n'okuhandiika omu kwega
answer_b: Obukuru bw'ebyo abeeshomiiriza kwegaho n'omulingo birikukwata aha mbeera y'abeeshomi, okurikukwatana n'amaani g'abarikwetenga kukoresa kubihikiiriza
answer_c: Omugasho ogu abeeshuri baine aha muringo gw'okugumirwa kw'ebintu ebi barikwega ebi bataarikubaasa kwegyera aha mbeera yabo y'okukura.
answer_d: Obukuru bw’okumanya omugyerageraniso gw’obucureezi oburikukorwa n’oburikukurikirana omu muringo murungi, nibwo bukuru ahabw’okwega kw’abanyeshuri.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omu kiraasi kya 3 omu ishomero erikwenda obwebembezi bw'okwegyesa obutaano, Maite, omwegi orikugambwa ngu aine Autism Spectrum Disorder, nayegaho. Aine orurimi orurikugamba, atunga obwengye bw'okugamba n'abantu arikukwata omugisha gw'okugamba nk'omutumwa n'omuhurikizi, natandika okugamba, kandi agarukamu ebirikugambwaho, kwonka, aine oburemeezi obumwe omu muringo gw'okuhurirana okuri haihi, ahabw'okutatuura kwe obutoora, arikwetenga obwebembezi bw'omwegyesa obutahwera kumuta omutima aha by'etengo by'omutwe gw'ekigambo. Omu isomo ry'Ekibalangulo, omwegyesa ari kukora aha mugingo gw'okwegyesa: "Kwooreka ngu nibetegyereza amakuru g'engyeso, nibamanyisa engyeso mpango, engyeso ndengwa, n'engyeso y'omutindo". Twaba niturora aha byetengo by'okwegyesa bya Maite, ni muringo ki ogurikukurataho ogw'okukora ebintu omu miringo etaano ogurikukwatanisa n'okutunga omugingo gw'okwegyesa ogurikugambwaho?
answer_a: Omugyezibwa, omuhendesi omu, naayoreka abegi purotirakita n’omugasho gwayo; bwanyima, naayoreka ebishushani by’engyeshera ezirikushangwa omu magara ga buri izooba, naapima nk’oku abegi barikugarukamu, naazishaanura kurugiirira aha bipimo byazo. Aha muheru, naayeta buri omwegi kushushana engyeshera ezitari zimwe omu bitoobe byabo.
answer_b: Omugyezibwa naayoreka abeeshuri okukoresa akakoreso k'okupima engoro (protractor) okupuima engoro; bwanyima, naayeta ekikundi kuza hanzi y'eishomero kushaera engoro ezirikushushana, ezi bashemereire kupima, bwanyima bakahandiika eby'okupima byabo n'obureeberezi obu barikuzishangamu; ku barikugaruka omu kicweka ky'okwegyeramu, abeeshuri nibagabana engoro ezi bahandiikire, reero bagyenda aha kintu ky'okurora n'okuhurira ekirikwetwa "Engoro ezindengyeiremu"
answer_c: Omugurusi naija kwenda abegi kumureetera ebyoma byabo by'okugera embiringito (protractors) ahabutandikiro bw'eklassi; naija kushushana embiringito aha bbaozi abegi abaine kwegyeraho omu buuku zaabo kandi naija kwegyesa oku bagera embiringito; bwanyima, naija kworeka eky'obuhangwa ekirikworeka "Embiringito ezindemeereize". Eky'ahaheru, naija kweta abegi kukora omurimo oguri omu kitabo ky'essomo kandi naija kuhiga abarikutoorana n'oburemeezi obwingi omu murimo ogwo, arikugarura omutima gw'abegi aba obwoona obu barikuhugura omutima ahabw'ebintu ebiriho.
answer_d: Omugyezibwa naija kubuuza abeeshure kukora kaati y'emiringo, omuboona bashemereire kushiisha buri muringo n'ebipimo byagwo kuraba omu kipima-muringo;

question: Omu omwegyesa omu oruganda rwa 4 orw’eshomero eririmu abaana abarikwetenga obuhabuzi obutaano, harimu abaana babiri abaine oburemeezi bw’omutwe oburikwetwa Autism Spectrum Disorder. Omwegyesa ashemereire kutebeekanisa omurimo gw’ekigyendererwa ky’okwega: “Kucumura ebizibu ebirimu okukubisa omu muringo ogurikukwatwaho, ogw’ebishushani, n’ogw’akabonero.” Abaana abaine oburemeezi bw’omutwe oburikwetwa Autism spectrum disorder omu isomo eri nibamanyirwa kuba baine obuhangwa oburungi omu bantu, bakora gye munonga omu miringo y’eshomero, kandi n’obuhwezi bw’ebigambo n’ebirikureebwa, nibacumura emirimo yaabo y’eshomero omu muringo ogurikumatiriza. Ni engyenderwaho eziha ezirikukuratanisa ezirikukirayo kukwata aha mwegyesa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ky’okwega ekirikugambwaho n’oruganda oru?
answer_a: Omugyezaho areetera abeshuri vidiyo erikukwata aha biteekateeko by'okubaza emirundi; bwanyima yashoboorora n'eby'okureeberaho bingi aha kibaho, kandi akagabura abeshuri omu bubiri bubiri kuba bajunjuure omugasho ogwongyeireho ogurikugambira aha by'okureeba ebirikworobiya omurimo.
answer_b: Omugurusi naayegyesa omuringo gw'okubaaza, naashoboorora aha bbaaho ngu n'omutaano mugufu; bwanyima, abeeshuri nibakora omutwe gw'abantu omu miringo y'enyama kandi nibamaraho okukora emyitooro y'okubaaza etari emwe, nibakoresa ebiranga n'ebishushani.
answer_c: Omugyezibwa akoresa empapura z'okubisa kushaisha omushomo gw'okubisa; bwanyima, abeeshuli, abarikutebeekanisibwa omu bubiri bubiri, bakora empapura omuri ekitabo ky'esomo eryo kandi bakakora eby'okukora omu bbitabo byabo. Obwanyima, bakareeba ebirugiremu hamwe.
answer_d: Omugurusi areetera abegi PPT erikukora hamwe nabo omu kutaangaaza omuringo gw'okubaaza n'okwoleka eby'okureeberaho; bwanyima, abegi bagaburwa omu bibinja kwihaho ebizoobu by'omugurusi abaheereza, nibakoresa ebishushani n'ebikoomi ikumi. Obwanyima, bagabana ebyabahikireho aha bbaoordi.

question: Omu omukuru omu klasse ey'abanaishomero ab'omwaka ogwa kabiri, omuri Clara, omwana orikurwara endwara ya Autism Spectrum Disorder, naija. Aine obushoboorozi bw'okugamba, nashobora kugarukamu ebibuzo by'abandi abanaishomero na bakuru be, natongyera aha mishonga, nangwa n'obu atarikukunda omushonga ogurikugambwaho. Kwonka, omwegyesa yaamugambira, nabaasa kugarukira aha mishonga erikugambwaho. Omu ishomo ly'ebyobutonde, omwegyesa ari kukora aha mugasho gw'okwega: "Kumanya n'okuringanisa, kuraba omu kweshomesa, embeera zaamaizi nk'ekikakafu, ekirikwita, n'omuyaga." Ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurataho erikuteekateeka aha mbeera ya Clara omu kwegyesa okw'omutaano okuhikiiriza omugasho gw'okwega ogurikugambwaho?
answer_a: Omugyezibwa naija kworeka abegi Powerpoint erimu ebishushani n'ebyahandiikwa ebi abegi boona bashemereire kushoma; naija kushoboorora orutindo rw'amaizi n'omugasho gwaarwo omu magara gaitu; bwanyima, naija kujuza omugasho gw'okukora aha mbeera z'amaizi, kandi eky'aha muheru, abegi boona nibaija kugabana eby'okugarukamu byabo.
answer_b: Omugurusi naija kubuuza abegi kwetebeekanisiza okwohereza ebiteekateeko byabo omukutaanira gw'amaizi, ebi baine kwetebeekanisiza omu maka; bwamara kwohereza ebiteekateeko byabo, naija kubagabira obuhabuzi bw'okukora, ebi barikwija kugarukamu omu bwabo kandi bwamara, bagabane eby'okugarukamu byabo, nibareeba yaaba birikukwata nari kutakwata.
answer_c: Omugyezibwa naija kutandika eishomo n'orw'omuziki 'Orwendo rw'Amaizi', reero aite abegi kwetaba omu murimo oguri omu kitabo ky'eishomo 'Emikorere y'Abantu n'Obutonde', naata abegi abarikugumirwa munonga haihi n'emeeza ye, naacwecwekamu ebiragiro kandi naagarura obwengye bwabo kwetantara ebiri kubahugura.
answer_d: Omugurusi naija kweta abegi boona kuba 'abahanga' arikuhindura eicumbi nk'eicumbi ry'okukoreza ebintu bya sayansi omu araakorerera eky'okureeberaho ekirikukwata aha mutindo gw'amaizi; bwanyima, naija kushaba abegi kukora omu tubiina ducure kandi bakore eby'okureeberaho byabo n'ebintu ebi bareetsire kuruga omu maka, arikubahabura aha kukwataganya engyenderwaho n'ebirikurugamu.

question: Maria ni omwegi orikukora omwaka gwa 6 omuishomero eririmu abegi abarikukwatanisa kandi aine oburemeezi bw’omutwe oburikwetwa Autism Spectrum. Nk’obusingye, omwegi ou aine emikago mirungi n’abanywani be, naagumirana nabo omu kasumi k’okuhemera n’aha muheru gw’eizooba, kwonka omu mashomo naashangwa atekateeka kandi atarikugamba. Naagarukamu ebibuuzo kandi naatandika eby’okugamba, kwonka tarikumanya kubigumiisiriza ahabw’okubura obuhame n’obukwatane omu bigambo bye. Ruhanga aha ruhanga, akakora munonga kureetera obuhangwa bwe obw’okushoma n’okuhandiika kwongyera kwomeera, narugaasa omu kushoma. Omu ishomo ly’Ebyafaayo, Eby’ensi, n’Ensi n’abantu, omwegyesa naareeba ngu Maria tarikumanya gye ebi arikwegyesa ebirikukwata aha bigyendererwa by’okwega: Okutaanisa abantu abamwe ab’ekibiina ky’eby’obufuzi n’obuteeka bwa Chile, narugaasa aha bapulezidenti baayo n’obwire bwabo. N’ahabw’ekyo, naacwamu kukora omuringo ogurikutaana, arikureeba ebizibu ebi Maria aine. Omu miringo ei orikurora, niki ekirikukwata aha bigyendererwa by’okwega ebi omwegyesa arikukora omu mbeera egi?
answer_a: Omugyezibwa naija kushaaba abegi kukora omurongo gw'ebiro, kurugaana abagabe n'ebintu bikuru ebyabaireho omu bwire bwabo, kandi naija kuhiga Maria arikumuha ebishushani ebikwata aha bantu n'ebintu ebirikworekwa omu murongo ogwo.
answer_b: Omugurusi naija kworeka omutendera gw'ebiro kuruga ahari purozidenti na ebintu byabo, okurabira omu kworeka data: abeeshuri baine kuijuzaho akagyeziro n'amajanja g'ebyo ebirikworekwa kandi bagabane eby'okugarukamu byabo na banywani baabo.
answer_c: Omugurusi naija kushuuma omwegi weena kworeka ebi akakoraga omwebembezi ou yaatooranize, kurugiirira aha muhendo gwe n'ebyo arikukunda; omu kworeka oku bashemereire kugambaho aha mitwarize ye kandi batwarizeho ebimwe aha bikuru ebyabaireho omu bwire bw'obulemi bwe n'ebishushani.
answer_d: Omugyezibwa naija kuhindura eicumbi kandi atebeekanise ebibiina kureeta omuntu omu bwomeezi owa buri pulezidenti, hamwe n'okworeka ebyabaho ebirukuru omu bwire bwabo; bwanyima, naija kubeta kwesherura pulezidenti kandi bareete ebirooto by'obwomeezi obuto, orwimbo, rundi ekicweka ky'ebyakashangwa nibamworeka, kurugiirira aha muhendo gwe yaataireho omu ihanga.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omwegyesa wa Agustin, omwegi aine oburemeezi bwa Autism Spectrum omu kiraasi ya 1, ari kukoragana n’ekiraasi yona aha kwongyera aha muhendo gw’ebifo n’okuteekateeka kw’omubaro, okurikwatana n’embeera za buri izooba abegi abakozesa emibaro. Kandi, nayenda kubaha ebizibu omu kiraasi ebirikugambira aha kubara omu muringo gwa 10 na 50, kuhika aha kikumi. Nk’eky’okureeberaho, baine kugura ekibala aha muhendo ogurikukira 100 pesos kandi baha nari bashaba enkyukira omu bicweka bya 10 na 50 pesos. Kandi, kwongyera aha kwetegyereza okwa kubara oku, omwegyesa atandika n’okuhereza abegi omurimo ogurikukurataho: Omwegyesa ashohora abegi kukora omurimo ogurikukurataho: Bate omu kabokisi ebicweka ebirikwetagisa kuhikiiriza 100 pesos: Kurugiira aha biri ahaiguru, ahabw’enki enteekateeka y’okutebeekanisa neyambazisa okwega kwa Agustin?
answer_a: Nikumuhwera kumwetegyereza ebiri omu by'okusoma ebihihyia arikubyegyezaho ahabw'obuhangwa bw'okubireeba.
answer_b: Nikumuhwera kumutegyereza butunu butunu eby'okubara ebirikukomera ahaiguru kandi kimwihaho okutaahirwa obu araabe naayehangaanira n'ebitarikumanywa.
answer_c: Nikumuhwera kumwemerera ebirimu ebyashubwirwemu kuraba omu kwicamu omugani ogu araabe aine kukoresa omu kucumura ebizibu
answer_d: Nikimuhiga kumukozesa ebimanyiriro bye aha bikwatiraine n'okuguza n'ebicweka by'ensimbi omu kwetegyereza emiramu y'ekibalangulo.

question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurataho: Carlos, ow’emyaka munaana, akagira obuhuuka bw’obwongo obucureezi (TBI) obukumire aha rubaju rw’omu maiso rw’obwongo. N’ekirikurugamu, aine oburemeezi omu kuteeraho omutima n’okutebeekanisa ebiriho, hamwe n’okutaaho ensalo. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, oburemeezi ki obo Carlos yoreka nk’ekirikurugamu omu buhuuka bw’obwongo (TBI) obu agizire?
answer_a: Emikorwa y'obushoboorozi bw'omutwe kuragira
answer_b: Okukora ebizibu
answer_c: Obushoboorozi bw'okuganiira
answer_d: Okukora aha makuru

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omwojo ow’emyaka ikumi na mukaaga orikugira oburemwa bw’obwongo obucureezi, obugongo obutari burungi, n’amatwi mato, naagumira hamwe na bazaire be na mukuru we, ou baganzi b’emizano ya vidiyo kandi naamuherekeza omu ishomero. Ni murungi kandi naayenda abantu, naatwariramu omu kibiina ky’eby’emizano. Naakurikira embeera y’okurya, obweresi, n’eby’okwambara omu bwomeezi bwe. Naamanya enamba, naabara, kandi naakoresa encence n’empapura z’eishillingi. Naahandiika eiziina rye kandi naakopiinga sentensi. Naakora emirimo micureezi, ei atandika kandi akagimaliriza, kwonka agira oburemeezi omu kucumura ebizibu ebirikukiraho kugumira. Kurugiirira aha Muringo ogw’Emyanya Emyingi, obureezi obu nibwo burikwetenga obuhwezi bwingi ahabw’omwojo ogu?
answer_a: Obushoboorozi bw'okwetegyereza embeera n'okugihindura nk'oku erikwetagiisa
answer_b: Obushoboorozi bw'omutwe
answer_c: Obushoboorozi bw'omubiri n'okukora
answer_d: Obushoboorozi bw’okuhuurana

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omwegyesa w'abaana abaine oburemeezi obutaano omu kiraasi ya mbere ariyo naatebeekanisiza ebiro bye byona eby'omwezi ogu. Omu mbeera egi, atekereza kukora emirimo erikukwata aha kumanya ebiri ahantu kuraba omu mizano n'ennyimba. Ebimwe aha bintu by'okumanya nibi: ahaiguru, ahansi, omunda, aha rubaju, aha rubaju rumwe, n'aha rundi. Omu mirimo yoona, abaana baryakoresa boona n'abandi baabo nk'ebyokurorraho. Twaba niturora omuhanda gw'okukora ogurikukwata aha mbeera y'abantu n'ebintu ebibetoroire, omu mirimo egi erikukurataho n'oguhe ogurikukwatana n'enteekaniza eyakozirwe omwegyesa w'abaana abaine oburemeezi obutaano?
answer_a: Okuteerera omu ku arikushoma eky'omugani 'Ahiguru na Hasi' ogwa Oliver Jeffers, okuhurira ahu abantu abarikukora omu mugani baraabeere.
answer_b: Kumanya ebirikugambwaho omu rupapura orwandikirwe ahari we baraabe nibasha kutaaho akamanyiso aha mwanya gw'ebishushani ebirikutaana omu kubuurana n'eky'okureeberaho
answer_c: Kwegamira omu biteekateeko by'obwengye bw'ahaiguru omu bikorwa bya buri izooba, nk'okumanya omwegi orikukwata ahomosho n'ahoburyo, kutebeekanisa akakoba kaabo buri izooba n'ebi baraakoresa byonka, n'ebindi.
answer_d: Okukoresa emirimo y'obuhangwa n'ebyangwa omu, abeeshuri abarikubaasa kworeka n'okushoboorora banywani baabo, ab'eka yaabo, n'abanywani baabo omu mbeera ez'omutaano n'omu myanya omu kashushani

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurira: Omu omutaano gw'okubanza, harimu omwegi orikwetwa Alicia, orikwetabamu omurongo gw'okwegyesa abantu boona ahabw'okuba aine oburemwa bw'obwengye obutari bwingi, ataxia, na dysarthria. Aine amaani mato g'emikono n'okuhangaanisa n'abandi kiri omu mutendera gw'okutandika kworeka ebintu. Abegyesa omu kiraasi nibenda kukora aha kumanya amakuriro n'omutaano, nibareeta amakuriro g'omutaano agari omu kiraasi. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, ni bintu ki ebiri ahansi ebirikworobiiza Alicia kugarukamu amakuriro agari omu kiraasi?
answer_a: Omutwe gw'akasharazo
answer_b: Omutego gw'enkoni
answer_c: Okugarukamu omu ndimi
answer_d: Omukomuniketa w'akacupa

question: Cristabal, orikw'emyaka musanju, naayegyesa omu ssomero erito na aine oburemwa bwa myelomeningocele n'okureeba kubi. Abakozi b'omu kiraasi nibakora omu by'okwegyera hamwe n'okwetegyereza ebirikukikuru omu butonde, ahabw'ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa eki: "Kumanya ebintu ebimwe ebirikukikuru omu butonde, nk'ebishoro." Abakozi baine kutoorana ekikoreso ekirikworobiiza Cristabal kwetaba omu murimo ogurikukorwa omu kiraasi. Ni kikoreso ki aha bikurikukurataho ekirikukiraho obuhangwa bw'okworobiiza Cristabal kugarukamu okusoomoozibwa kw'okwegyesa oku?
answer_a: Omunwe ogurikukoresebwa aha kyasha ky'okukoraaho
answer_b: Omukoro gw'ebicweka by'okutaayaaya aha kibumbiro kurora ebishushani aha kompyuta
answer_c: Kushashuura omu maiso kushobora kutorana ebishushani ebirikworekwa aha ka tablet
answer_d: Omushorozi gw'omutwe kworeka ebishushani ebirikworekwa aha kikorereso ky'okuhurirana

question: Rodrigo ari omu ishomero ry'abaana abaine oburemeezi obutaano omu Pule-shonga. Azaarirwe ari omupuuli kandi aine oburemeezi bw'omubiri oburikwetwa spastic diplegia. Agyezireho kutunguura okwetegyereza ebintu ebiri omu mwanya. Omwegyesa n'omwegyesa w'abaana abaine oburemeezi nibakora aha kicweka ky'okukuratira ebyo omwana arikwega, okushushanisa n'okwetegyereza ebirikukikuruukya, nibagira ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa abaana kushoboorora omwanya ebintu n'ebintu ebiriho biri, nibakoresa okwetegyereza omwanya n'oburaayo nk'omu, aha rubaju, ahaiguru, ahansi, haihi, n'ahaara. Abegyesa baine kukora omurimo ogurikwombeka okwetegyereza kwa Rodrigo n'okumuheereza omugisha gw'okwetaba omu by'okwega. Omu mirimo egi erikukuraho, niki ekirikworeka okwetegyereza okutebeekanisibwa kw'ebintu omu mbeera egi erikworekwa?
answer_a: Buzanisa emizaano y'omubiri omu omu n'omundi omuri babiri erikukoresa emiramizo y'omunda/aha rubaju, aha iguru/ahansi, haihi/hare, omu bukuru bw'ebintu ebirikwetengwa kandi erikukwatanisa empinduka omu mwanya.
answer_b: Kukoresa omukono kugambira omwana omuhanda gw'okukwata aha rupapura rwona, orikugamba amaziina g'ebishoro, reero okagyeragyeranisa ebintu ebi orikukoresa obuhangwa bw'ahaiguru.
answer_c: Shuuruza aha rupapura orukukwataho orukozire omu rangi ogutabirwe n'esemolina n'ebindi bintu bibiri nk'oku biragizibwe: shuuruza ahu ekyenyanja kiri, kwata aha rupapura orikugyeragyeranisa, kandi okore otyo n'enyamaishwa endiijo.
answer_d: Hanga eky'okureeberaho ekirikushushana n'obutaaka n'amaizi, oteekyemu enyamaishwa nto, orikukoresa omukago gw'okuringaanisa kurabira omu kuhendeka n'okuhindura omwanya kwazo kushobora emyanya yaazo.

question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurira: Matilde ari omu mwaka gwa 5 omu ishomero erikuru. Ayine oburemeezi bwingi kandi akuraize okuteekateeka kw'akabonero. Aha kutandika kw'ekiro kya kabiri, ekibiina ky'abakugu kikazoora ngu omuhikiina ayine oburemeezi omu kutebeekanisa emirimo ye y'eishomero. Omu mwanya gw'embeera egi, ekibiina kyakozireho kucwamu ngu omuringo gw'okwegyesa gushemereire kuteekwa omu nkora kugira ngu gihikiirize ebyetengo bye. Omu miringo y'okwegyesa egi erikukurira, n'oguhe ogurikwija kukora aha bukuru bw'okutebeekanisa na Matilde?
answer_a: Okuteekateeka ebiteeso: omuringo gw'okucweekereza nigwija kukorwa hakuhenderaasa ekikoreso kya Go Talk
answer_b: Okwegamira omu mushomo: akalenda k'ebikorwa by'omushomo nikija kukorwa n'obuyambi bw'ebishushani
answer_c: Okwegyesa kuraba omu bizibu: eki nikiza kwombekwa kuraba omu karingiti y'obuhangwa n'eky'okworeka ekintu kikuru.
answer_d: Okwegyesa kurugiira aha biteekateeko: eki nikiza kwombekwa kurugiira omu PPT n'ebishushani hamwe n'ebipande by'ebiteekateeko ebi byahandiikwa.

question: Shoma omu mbeera egi: Federico omwegyesa ow'emyaka ikumi na ibiri orikugira oburemwa bw'omubiri bwona (spastic tetraplegia) kandi n'atekateeka nk'omuntu atarikukoresa bubonero (pre-symbolic level of thinking). Naagarukamu ebintu arikukoresa obubonero. Omu isomo ly'Obuhangwa, abegyesa nibakora aha mugingo gw'okwegyesa ogurikugira guti: "Kureeba n'okugyeragyeranisa enyamaishwa kurugiirira aha miringo nk'obunene, ebirikubisiiga omubiri, engyenda, n'obutaagi." Twaba niturora embeera egi, omurimo ki ogurikwongyera aha kuhurirana n'okwega kwa Federico?
answer_a: Yoreka vidiyo z'ebintu ebiriho omu bwomeezi bw'ebishoro n'emitwarize yaabyo
answer_b: Yoreka eky’okworeka aha kaadi y’okuhurirana erimu ebishushani n’emitwarize y’enyamaishwa zoona
answer_c: Koresa ebishushani by'enyama ebito, orikukozesa emiringo n'emitwarize yaabyo.
answer_d: Koresa ebiragiro by'ebishushani ebirikukuzibwa by'enyamaishwa omu muringo gw'okumanyisa n'okworeka embeera zaazo ez'omutaano.

question: Okurikurayo omwegi omu irabu ry'abana omu ishomero erikuru eririkwenda obwebembezi bw'okumanya, aine okuzindikirwa kw'oburemeezi bw'omubiri obwa spastic tetraparesis n'oburemeezi bw'obwomeezi obucureezi, niki aha ebikorwa ebirikworobiiza okwetaba kwe n'okuhurirana omu kiraasi?
answer_a: Leeta ebintu byoona n'amasherufu omu ক্লাসরুমু.
answer_b: Shitura akapanera k’ebirangiriro n’ebishushani ebirimu ebigambo bitari bimwe omu mesa z’okukoreraho.
answer_c: Tebeekanisibwe enshooro y'okukora ebintu omu miringo erikushaanisa abegi, okukuraaza okushoma, eby'okweshongora, n'emikoro endiijo.
answer_d: Tebeekanisa emeeza n'entebe omuhendo ogw'ekicweka ky'omuringo ngu buli omwe ashobole kuganira na mugyenzi we

question: Omuhereza aishemereire kukora ki kureetera abegi be kwega kurungi, omu mwanya gw'okubakora ebyo boona ebi barikwenda?
answer_a: Tebeekanisa okugyenda omu kubakazi b'emigaati abari haihi
answer_b: Kucuruza eby'okutunda byabo omu itale ly'omumaisi.
answer_c: Shaba omuhanda gw'okworeka emirimo ei barikukora omu wookishopu
answer_d: Hamu kukora omukago n'eishomero erikuru eririmu programu y'okuteeka emmere.

question: Shoma eky’okureeberaho eki: Omwishiki omuto ayoreka okushiisha kw’okwetaba omu gwazo gw’emizaano aha ka ye n’abegyesi be. Hamwe, bashwijuma omugisha gw’okwetaba omu muzano oguhindurirwe, omu mwishiki orikumpurra gye kandi ogurikuhikiiriza ebi arikwenda. Aine oburemeezi oburikwetengwa oburemeezi bw’amaani bw’omubiri (tetraparesis). Agyezaho okuhindura emikono ye nk’ekikomo kigumire omu maiso, enyima, ahaiguru, n’ahansi; ahabw’okwetegyereza n’okukurata ebiragiro by’omumwa ebitarikwetenga muno kandi ayoreka obureezi oburikukwatana n’okusaasira n’obujunaanizibwa. Nooreeba aha ky’okureeberaho eki, ni gwaazo ki oguhindurirwe ogurikukwataana n’emitwarize y’omubiri y’omwishiki ogwo?
answer_a: Bocce
answer_b: Omupiira gw'ekiteeteeyi
answer_c: Omupiira gw'engaro
answer_d: Omeza ya teeburo

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Ekikundi ky'abanyeshuri abaine oburembe bwingi omu kiraasi ya 2 bagyetabamu omu isomo ry'Orurimi n'Okuhurirana, erikugira ekigyendererwa eki: "okugyaho amakuru agirikworekwa kuruga omu mutwe." Okukuraaza omurimo, nibakoresa ebibaaho by'okuhuriranaho n'ebiro by'emirimo ya burizooba ebirikworeka ebishushani nk'eky'okureeberaho, okushushana ebikorwa. Hanyuma, nibakoresa ebintu ebiriyo, nibatandika kushoma orugano orurikworekwa omu bishushani, kuraba omu mashine erikworeka ebishushani. Kandi, orugano ruri aha by'omuntu by'abanyeshuri. Ni engyenderwaho ki aha ezirikukurataho erikwihaho abanyeshuri kugarukamu ebibuuzo ebirikworekwa aha rugano?
answer_a: Kukoresa ebishushani by'abantu abarikukora ebintu omu mulingo gw'obuto, abegi bashobole kugaruraho ebyabaho omu mulingo ogurikukoresa oburyo bwabo obw'okuhaburana obwongyeireho n'oburikukora nk'obundi.
answer_b: Koresa ebishushani kuruga omu mugani, orikubuuza ebibuuzo byangu omu miringo etari emwe n'etarikutebeekanisibwa, abeeshuri bashobore kugarukamu nibakoresa enkoresa yaabo ey'okwongyerera n'ey'okuhindura aha ku barikweshongora.
answer_c: Ninkoresa ebishushani by'abantu abarikukora omu mulingo ogu orikukoresa, abegi bashobole kugarukamu ebirikukwata aha mico yaabo kurabira omu nkoreso yaabo ey'okwongyera n'ey'okuhindura omu kubaza
answer_d: Kukoresa ebishushani by'abantu abarikukora omu mbeera n'okubumbaho akacweka k'omugani ngu abeeshuri bashobore kugarukamu nibakoresa enkoreso yaabo ey'okwongyerera n'ey'okuhindura aha kweshongora.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Abanyeshuri ab’ekicweka kya mbere omu ishomero erihuriireho nibakora aha isomo ry’Obuhangwa, narwo, okutaho omutima aha birimu amagara n’obusingye bw’ebiramu. Ekikundi ky’abasomesa omu kicweka eki nikigyerera kukuza obushobozi nk’okureeba, okushoboorora, okutaho omu mitwaro, n’okumanya kurabira omu kwetegyereza. Eki, nibagyerera kureeba ngu abanyeshuri abamwe baine ebi basigarirweho by’okuhurira n’okureeba, obugumire bw’okugyeenda, n’oburemeezi bw’obwengye obutari bumwe. Kurugiirira aha isomo ry’Obuhangwa erikukuzibwa, ninkaha aha bikorwa by’obwegyesa ebikuzaho okutwaramu embeera z’okwega ez’amazima?
answer_a: Leeta enyama ezirikufugwa omu ka ahaiguru abegi bashobore kureeba, kukwataho, kuhumuririza, nari kuhurira kurugiirira aha muhendo gwabo.
answer_b: Tebeekanisa emizaano y'aha rubaju rw'eka kugyendera aha kukwataho, kubaasa kushanga ebintu ebiri omu butonde bw'ensi obwa buri izooba.
answer_c: Yoreka vidiyo z'ebishoro by'enyamaishwa ezirikufuurwa omu ka, kubaasa kugarukamu aha maraka gaazo, emiringo yaazo, emibara yaazo, n'okuhendeka kwaazo
answer_d: Bahe eby'obutonde ebiruga omu kibanja ky'eishomero, kubaase kubigyeragyeranisa okurikurugaana n'emishusho, ebirangi, oburemerezi, n'obunene.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'abaana abaine oburemwa omu ishomero ry'abaana abaine oburemwa arikukora aha mutwe gw'ebyafaayo, eby'obutungi bw'ensi, n'enshonga z'abantu, aine ekigyendererwa eki: "Kushoma n'okushushana mapeesa ezirikwera z'obushangwa bwabo, nibakoresa ebintu ebirikubahiga, emitwarize y'obuhanzi bw'omwanya, n'obubonero bw'ebishushani." Abegi be baine oburemwa bwingi. Abamwe nibagambirana nibakoresa ebintu ebirikukwataho, abandi nibaragiira omu bubonero oburikukiikirira ebintu kuruga omu mazima. Abingi baine obugumiikiriza bw'okugyeza, obwetago omu kukora aha bihurira, n'okutsigamana kw'emitwarize. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, omurimo ogurikukurikiraho nigugumira abegi kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ekiteirweho omwegyesa?
answer_a: Shuuruura ebintu ebirikukwata omubiri omuklassi nookukoresa maapu ntozikye hamu n'okushoboorora ebirikumanyisa
answer_b: Kushobora kushoma mapepula matooro g'eishomero arikubafasha kukora emirimo nariyo kutwara obutumwa
answer_c: Baayambe maapu z'amaka gaabo, nibagamba ebi barikushanga omuka n'okukoresa emiramu y'ebitarohendeka.
answer_d: Kuzana kugyezaho omwana omu mwanya gw'arimu omu klasirumu, arikukoresa amagezi g'okumanya omuhanda n'oburengane.

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurataho: Adriana, ow’emyaka ikumi, ari omu mwaka gw’okubanza omu ishomero erikuru. Azaarwa ari mpumi, aine oburemeezi bw’obwongo obucureezi ahabw’okubura obureezi obuhikire, kandi aha mutindo gw’okuhuurana, ayorekire emitwarize y’okugyenda n’ekigendererwa. Omu myaka ye ena ey’okubanza, akaba ari omu matendekyero agari mushaanju atarikufooka obureezi oburikukiraho. Ni omwegi orikuteeka, orikukundira kwega. Ayeeteera nka omuntu n’abegi bagyenzi be kandi agabaana nabo omu bikorwa by’omukago n’obuhwezi. Ekikundi ky’omu kicweka ky’okwegera nikikora aha kigyendererwa ky’okwega: “Kutuma amaziina n’okukurikirania ebiro by’esande n’emyezi y’omwaka.” Noorekire emitwarize ya Adriana, niki aha bikorwa ebi orikubaasa kumuhwera kumumanyisa n’okugyenda n’amazina g’ebiro by’esande?
answer_a: Obuntu obukye bukwaataine n'emirimo ya butoosha
answer_b: Ebirango ebirikukwata aha muringo gw'emirimo ya buri izooba
answer_c: Emiringo y'ebintu ekwatagaine n'omulingo gw'obuzima obwa bulijo
answer_d: Ebintu ebirikukwatanisa n'emirimo ya burijo

question: Shoma omu mbeera egi: Rodrigo, omwegi w’akasomesa akato aha ishomero erikukoresa orurimi orutali rumwe, atungwa ahabwokwetaba omu bintu n’okutahumuza. question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omu kiraasi ya mbere omu ishomero eririmu obuyambi bw'abanyeshuri abaine oburemeezi obutaano, harimu abanyeshuri bashatu abazoirwe oburemeezi bw'orurimi orutari rumwe, abataireho amanota mato omu ishomero omu mutwe gw'eky'ongereza omu kasumi ka mbere. answer_b: Reeba oreebe obwengye n’oburemeezi bw’abeeshuri omu ishomo.

answer_d: Shuuruza egi orikukoresibwa omu kubaza ebikorwa byabo n'ebyo abegi ab'emyaka ehingwire abaahikire aha bitegyerwa by'okwega ebitari bishomeshe ahansi.

question: Shoma omuheru ogurikukuratira: Camila ni omwegi orikugyenda omu mwaka gw'okubanza aine oburemeezi bw'okugamba oburikugumya abantu kumwetegyereza, kandi arikwegyera omu shomero rye. Omu myaka ya pure-shool, akatunga obuhwezi butarikushisha kuruga omu timu y'omu kicweka ky'okwegyeramu, kandi akakora kurungi munonga. Nangwa n'obu kiraabe kityo, timu y'omu kicweka ky'okwegyeramu neeshanga ngu omwegi nagira omutwaro omu mirimo kwonka nagumirwa kugarukamu ebibuuzo ebirikugyezibwa, nk'obu arikushoborora, nangwa n'obu arikukoresa ebikwaato by'obuhwezi. Omu bigezo ebirikukuratirwa, harimu oburemeezi omu kworeka obwengye bwe, nangwa n'obu aine obuhwezi kuruga omu mwegyesa. answer_a: Yorobiise omuringo gw'okugyezaho omwana, omu kubaho ekibuuzo ekirikwetagisa okugarukwamu.
answer_b: Banza kuta omutwaro aha kucweeka oburemeezi bw'obwengye omu kumariiriza eky'okureeberaho ekirikukwata aha bwengye.
answer_c: Orikora ebirungi omwegi ashohoire omu mashomo ge arikukoresa ekyerengo ekirikushoborora.
answer_d: Kugyenda n'okukorera hamwe amahururu omu bunyoro bw'okwegyesa, orikukoresa ebikorwa by'okushashuura ebirikushushana.

question: Shoma eky'okureeberaho eki: Omu giraade ya 2 y'eishomero erikugira Entebeekanisa y'Obuhwezi bw'Eby'enjegyereza Eyombekire hamwe, abanyeshuri bana nibeeza omu klasse abarikugira oburemeezi bw'okukura omu rurimi, abakikora enshobe nyingi omu mazina g'ebigambo, nk'oku kirikwetegerezebwa omu myaka yaabo. question: Ekibiina kya 3 ekyaishomero eririmu enteekanisa y’okwegyereza hamwe n’abandi, n’ekibiina ekiine obwitaba n’amaani maingi, aharikuba abegyeki baingi, omubariimu babiri abaine oburemeezi bw’orurimi, niboreka okugumirwa omu kuhingura omulingo gwabo gw’okushoma. question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omu kiraasi ky'omwaka gwa kashatu, harimu abeeshure abarikworeka oburemeezi bw'orurimi obutahikire kandi barikugumirwa kukuratira ebiragiro birikukomera ebihairwe omu muringo ogutahikire hamwe n'okushaba okwetegyereza, embeera egi etera kubareetera kureka emirimo yaabo etaragiirwe. question: Ni eni ahaansi eziirikukurira ezi orikukwatanisa n'omurimo gw'okwetegyereza ogurikuhiga abeeshomesa ab'ekibiina kya kabiri abaine oburemeezi bw'okwega obutaahukaine?

answer_a: Sita ebishushani kwongyera aha bigambo
answer_b: Shaba emiringo etarikukozesa magambo omu mirimo
answer_c: Nsiima, tindikuza kureeta bifaananyi. Ninkukwasisa ondihe ebyahandiikwa byonka.
answer_d: Ngyenda ezirikukurira omu itungo ry'omuntu zigyezibwa zita?

question: Shoma omwana David ori omwegyesa orina oburemeezi bw'orurimi orutari rumwe orikugyenda omu kika kya 3 omu ishomero eririmu enteekateeka y'okwegyereza hamwe. Ashemererwa eishomo ry'eby'obuhangwa n'omuringo, ahabw'okuba ayoreka obukugu bwingi omu mikono n'emirimo n'ebikorwa ebirimu obuhame bw'okukuratanisa nibyorobiya omurimo gwe. Okwezi oku ekika kikatandika kukora aha mutwe gw'ekigambo: "Ohingure ebintu by'eby'obuhangwa n'omuringo", ahu baine kutebeekanisa omurimo gw'okukora gwabo, kuronda ebikozesebwa, n'okuteera ekigyendererwa, kwonka ebiro bishatu byamaze kuhita kandi omwegyesa akaba atarikubaasa kushoborora omurimo gw'okukora, nagira ngu tamanyire oku arikutandika ahabw'okuba byona nibimubonekera nk'ebigumire. Okurikiraana n'embeera eyorekirwe, ni bumwe aha bintu ebirikukurataho ebirikukoresibwa omu muringo ogutari gumwe ebirikugyenda omu maisho n'okugumira oku omwegyesa ayoreka?
answer_a: Koresa abegyesi kubahereza eky'okureeberaho ky'okuteekateeka omu iraka
answer_b: Tugyezere hamwe ebiragiro kwenda kumanya ebigyendererwa by'obwire obuhango.
answer_c: Mureke abegi b’okubanza ebirango byabo omu miringo etari emwe n’emwe nk’okukoresa ebishushani
answer_d: Baashe kubanza kwebemeza nk'omuringo gw'okukurikiranira hamwe n'okucungura omugendo gwaabo

question: Omu klasa y'abanaishomero ab'orubanza orw'okubanza, abanaishomero bashatu abarikugira oburemeezi bw'orurimi oburikwetwa expressive specific language disorder nibooreka oburemeezi bw'emiramizo oburikuhindura ebiri omu bubaka bwabo, n'ekirikurugamu okukora aha murimo n'okwega. Omwegyesa omukuru naatandika kukora aha mugingo gw'okwega "Okukora aha murimo omu kubuurirana kw'omukago aha bihandiiko ebyashomwa nari ebyahurirwe omu klasa nari ensonga ezirikubahitsya," ahabw'ekyo ekiina ky'omu klasa nicamara kukora n'ensonga ezirikuhitsya abanaishomero, ezitebeekanisibwe omu migaano mito, kandi bagyeyongyererezaaho omukozi orikuruga omu kiina (omwegyesa omukuru, omwebembezi w'omu klasa, omwegyesa w'enjegyereza y'omutaano, omuganga w'eby'okugamba, na psychologist). Twaba niturora embeera eyo, niki ekirikukurataho ekirikugambira aha muringo gw'omutaano ogurikukwata aha kuremesa kw'abanaishomero?
answer_a: Ngyenda kukurora omu byoona ebi orikukora.
answer_b: Tebeekanisa omurimo omu muringo gw'omuntu omwe na omwe hamwe n'omuganga w'okugamba omu kikaari ky'obuhabuzi.
answer_c: Ha omuhanda gw'okuhwera abarikwega, teekanisa empapura ezirikworeka ebintu ebirikubaasa kubahwera omu kuza omu maisho n'omurimo ogu barikukora.
answer_d: Kukora omuringo ogurikukirayo gw'okugyenda nibakora okugaziya orurimi omu bwire bw'okugamba omu kibina

question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurira: Ekikundi ky’abegi abari omu mwaka gwa kabiri omuri Mathematics nikikoresa eby’okubara ebirikukirayo, obuhabuzi bw’ebishushani, okurekodi ebirango aha bboardi, n’ebibuuzo by’okwetegyereza kugira ngu bashoboorore abegi omuringo emigatsi erikukorwamu n’omuringo erikwegaanizibwamu kuruga aha namba 0 kuhika 50. Bwanyima, nibabeta kwega n’okukoresa ebi baayegire omu kuhingura omwegyesa omu kuza aha kugyenda omumaisho n’okukora omwegyesa gwabo. Omu kucondooza ebi barikukora, nikireebwa ngu abegi abamwe baine oburemeezi omu kuhingura omwegyesa, n’obu barikuba baarabamu ebibuuzo ebirikuragirwa omu kushoboorora ebirimu. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, kiki ekirikureebwa nk’ekirikuzibira omuntu kwega n’okwetaba?
answer_a: Okutabaaho obusinge bw'okwegyera obukora kandi obwa buri izooba aha banyeshuri
answer_b: Obureezi bw'okubura kw'emitindo erikukoresibwa omu kucweeka n'okuhereza ebi okwegyera aha banyeshuri omu bwiire bw'omurimo ogukozirwe
answer_c: Oburemeezi bw’ebikozesebwa ebirikukwasya omuhendo gw’okukora omurimo, okurikukurugaana n’obwengye bw’abeeshuri.
answer_d: Obutabaaho mutindo gw'okwegyesa ogurikwata hamwe ogurikuteekateeka okwetegyereza okwega kw'abeeshuri enyima, omu, na bwanyima y'eklassi

question: Shoma omu mbeera egi: Omu omukazi gw'okubanza, kuraba omu kintu ky'eby'omutwe, ebibiina by'endengo BL na BR nibikorwaho. Ekimu aha bikorwa ebirateekanisiibwe okutandika orurembo nigwo abeeshuri kureeba ekishushani ekirikwooreka ebintu bitari bimwe, amaryo gaabyo agari n'omugano n'emigano egyo, nibakanda aha bintu kuhurra amaryo gaabyo reero nibabiteeka omu bibiina by'endengo emwe nari endiijo. Ekyakurataho, nibakora okucwekyereza n'okuteera hamwe ekigambo n'omwegyesa. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, niki ekirikukora munonga omu bikorwa by'okutandika?
answer_a: Okureebeka ebirikumanyisa
answer_b: Okumanya ebigambo omuhendo
answer_c: Okumanya enjegyeka z'ebigambo
answer_d: Kushobora kutooroora ebintu omu misho

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurira: Omu kwetegyereza omwana owa iraaya rya kashatu omu by’omutwe n’okwegyesa, ahabw’okumwikiriza omu puroguraamu y’abaine oburemeezi obutaano, ekikundi ky’omu iraaya katekateire aha by’omwana eby’omu ishomero n’eby’okwegyesa, omubairemu ebyo ebirikukwata aha kwega emirundi n’okwetegyereza kwabo okutari okw’obusaasi. Kandi, ekikundi katekateire aha muringo gw’omwana, nk’obusoni, oburemeezi omu kwijuka ebintu, n’okutajanjamuka omu mashomo. Ni bintu ki ebi ekikundi ky’omu iraaya kirikweteekateeka kukora okukoraana ebintu ebirikukwata aha mwana ogu?
answer_a: Pima emiramuko yaabo y'obuntu.
answer_b: Ninsaba okushomesa omusaizi.
answer_d: Kora okubuza ebyafaayo by'omurwaire omu ka yaabo

question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurira: Ekikundi ky'abegyesa omu kiraasi ey'omukaaga, ahabw'okutabaasa kw'abanyeshuri kwetaba omu masomo, nicicwamu kukoresa obubaaho bw'omuntu omwe-omu, buri omwe asobole kugarukamu ebizibu by'okwega ebirikuteerwa omu kiraasi. Eki nikiza kubahwera kumanya omulingo barikwega ebirikukwata aha buhereza nari ebiri omu mutwe gw'ekyegyeso ekirikukorwaho, kandi nikiza kubahwera kureeta enyegyesa ezirikwetagisa. Kandi abakugu omu kikundi ky'abegyesa nibaija kubaasa kwombeka amakuru g'omunyeshuri omwe kubaasa kucungura oburemeezi bw'okwega oburikubaasa kuba buriyo. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, omulingo gw'okucungura ki ogu ekicweero ky'ekikundi ky'abegyesa kirikukwataho?
answer_a: Okugyeragyeranisa okw'okubanza
answer_b: Okugyerera okw'aha rugati
answer_c: Okugyezibwa kw'okushishoza
answer_d: Okugyeragyeranisa kw'omugatte

question: Shoma omubaire: Francisco, omwegi owa 6 omu grade orikugira oburemeezi bw'okwega omu kubara, aine ekizibu ky'omubaro eki: Omu maka g'ab'eishe-emwe bashatu, Carlos niwe muto, Pedro niwe wa hagati, na Jorge niwe mukuru. Pedro aine emyaka ebiri okukira Carlos, na Jorge aine emyaka eshatu okukira Carlos. Ab'eishe-emwe bashatu baine emyaka mingahi? Kiruge omu muringo gw'emibaro. Ku yaherize kushwijuma ekizibu eki, omwegi ayahukana ati: "X + 2 + 3". Twashwijuma ekyo, niki ekizibu ky'okwega eki Francisco arikwoleka?
answer_a: Okumanya gye kukuru kw'emiringo erikukuratirwa omu kubara eby'ebara.
answer_b: Okureetera embeera ez'amazima kuraba omu rurimi rw'ebibarizo
answer_c: Okwetegyereza omuhanda gw'okusoma okurikukirira aha kukora ebizoobu by'ebarafu
answer_d: Kutorana ebimanyiso by’omugasho omu kumara ebizibu by’ekibalangulo

question: Shoma eky’okureeberaho eki: Ekibiina ky’omu kicweka ky’eky’okushatu omu ishomero omu isomo ry’Orurimi n’Okuhurirana nikikora omurimo gw’okugumya okwetegyereza kw’ebyahandiikwa omu banyeshuri, na munonga abarikugira oburemeezi bw’okushoma. Omurimo ogu nigutwariramu kutoora eky’okubaza kandi, batakashoma, bagaabana omu bibiina eby’emirimo eby’okugarukamu ebibuuzo ebi: - Ahabw’enki ntooraine ekyahandiikwa eki? - Ninki eki ndikwenda kukora ndikushoma ekyahandiikwa eki? - Ninki eki ndikushaka kureeba obu ndikwenda kumanya ekyahandiikwa nk’eki eki ntooraine kirikwija kuba nikikwataho? - Kurugiirira aha kibuuzo ekirahize, ekyahandiikwa eki ntooraine nikija kuba nikikwata aha ki? Ni nshonga ki erikuhakanira omuringo ogurikukoresibwa omwegyesa w’enjegyereza y’abana batoire ekyahandiikwa eki batakakishoma?
answer_a: Nikuha amakuru omu kusoma, kuraba omu kumanya n'ebirooto abeeshuri baine
answer_b: Nigyenda nirekera abeeshuli kushoma baine ekigyendererwa ky'amaani kandi bateekateeke ebi baraashoma
answer_c: Ekyamba abeeshuri kumanya ebice by'omubimbi by'ekyahandiikwa n'okuha amakuru omu kushoma
answer_d: Nigyambaasa abeeshuri kukora ebiragiro kurugiira aha by'ebarikushoma kandi nikireetera okukuza okwetegyereza.

question: Shoma omubaire: Aha kutandika kw’omwaka, ekikundi ky’abegyesa omu kibiina kya kabiri kigyenda kukora omurimo gw’okushobora obwomeezi bw’abeeshuli omu kwega kushoma na kuhandiika. Okukora eki, bateekateeka kukoresa enyimba. Amakuru abu baineho aha kibiina n’agariho abeeshuli abashangwa baine oburemeezi bw’okushoma, abamwe abarikugamba ngu tibarikushobora kushoma na kuhandiika, n’abandi abarikworeka ngu tibarikukunda kushoma. Okugyeraho, okurikukurirana n’amakuru agataireho omwegyesa w’abeeshuli abaine oburemeezi, omuringo gw’obushoboorozi ogwakozirweho omwaka ogwahwa tigukataireho okukura oku barikweteenga. Muringo ki ogurikusaana kukoresa okuhikiiriza embeera y’okwega eyorekirwe?
answer_a: Shoma kandi oririmbe orweshongo hamwe n'abeeshure, nukwo bashuure ebicweka ebi barikukunda kurabira omu herufi ezirikwegyegyereza.
answer_b: Koresa abeeshuri n'ebibuuzo ebibahiga kuba batemere kandi batebeekane ebihendo by'amazina g'emitwe y'enyembo ez'omutaano.
answer_c: Yolesa omurongo gw'enyimba ezi oshemeire abeeshuri, nukwo bagukopi omu bitabo byabo, bateekyeho akamanyiso aha kicweka eki basemereirwe, kandi baguimbe.
answer_d: Shuuruura hamwe n'abeeshuri, oreeka orusyabwire rw'aha muheru rw'emitwe y'enyimba, kubaasa kworeka okushushana n'obutaanashushana oburi ahagati yaayo

question: Shoma omu mbeera egi: Etiimu y’eky’omwaka ogw’okubanza omu ishomero erikuru ery’orurimi n’ebitabo bateekaniza kukorera hamwe n’abegi omu kwetegyereza ekicweka ky’ekitabo, nibahamya obukuru bw’okushoborora oku ekifo kirikukwata aha mbeera y’omugani. Omwegyesa w’abegi abaine oburemeezi bw’okwega naaraga ngu abegi, hamwe n’abo abairweho endwara y’obutamanya kushoma, niboreka obwetengo bw’obuhwezi omu kutaaho omukago oguriho hagati y’ekifo n’ekikorwa, n’ahabw’ekyo nashaba kutebeekaniza emirimo erikubanza ehwereireho kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa. Kuruga aha biri ahaiguru, mugisha ki ogurikukwata aha kugarukamu embeera y’okwega y’abegi?
answer_a: Shwijuma enyeto kwenda kumanya omuntu mukuru omu nyeto, oreyebwe omwanya n'obwire ebirikumwetorora, omanye ebirikumuhiga, kandi oteebere ebi arikuhurira.
answer_b: Koragana n’omutwe gw’ekicweka ky’ekitabo eki barikwija kushoma, batebeekanisize ebikorwa by’abakuru b’ebyafaayo n’ebishushani kandi bamanye ebirikubaho ahari bo, ahu ebyabireho birikubera, n’oha orikukwatwaho nabyo
answer_c: Shobora omu kubanza ebintu ebirikukwatana n'ekigyendererwa eky'okuhikiirirwa kworeka obushozi bw'ebyafaayo n'ebikorwa by'abantu abarikukora omu byafaayo, kandi otegyereze embeera, obwire, omuyaga, obushozi bw'omutima, n'ebikorwa.
answer_d: Shwijuma ebice by’omu bitabo by’ebishushani kureeba ebi abantu abarikukora, ahu bari, n’oku barikwehurira, orikurora ebyahandiikirwe ebiriho n’ekishushani, emitwarize y’abantu, n’ebintu ebiri omu mwanya.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Abanyeshuri abamwe omu ক্লাসে ya kana, hamwe n'abo abarikugira oburemeezi bw'okushoma, nibashobora kugarukamu ebibuuzo by'okwetegyereza ebikwatanisa oburemeezi bw'omutindo ogw'okubanza. Kugasya omugisha gwabo omu by'okushoma n'okubashobozesa kweteegyereza oburemeezi bw'omutindo ogwa heeru, ekikundi ky'abasomesa nikikora n'enkoresa nk'ezi ezirikukurataho aha kubanza kw'amasomo: Omubaire ogurikwolekwa aha board (hamwe n'ebishushani) Guido akata omutura omu kibya yaataho baking powder. Omu kabokisi akandi, akagattisa sukaali na margarine n'amagi. Ku araamara kugattisa ebiri omu tubokisi twombi, akata amata yaakomeza kukuba. Ekibuuzo ky'abanyeshuri Guido arikukora ki? Ni nshonga ki eziri omu mutwe ogurikukulemesa kumwetenga? Wakozesa ki kugera oije aha kagarukiro? Ahabwaki ekikundi ky'abasomesa nikikozesa enkoresa egi y'okukora n'abanyeshuri?
answer_a: Kugira ngu bamanye ebintu, bagyeranisye ebintu by’omugasho, kandi bateekateeke omu mitwaro kurugiirira aha bukuru bwabyo
answer_b: kugira ngu babeasa kutoorana ebintu, babihurire hamwe, babihumishe n'obumanyi bwabo obw'enyima, kandi bahike aha biteekateeko.
answer_c: Kugira ngu bashobore kutooroora ebintu by’amazima bikuru, kubitebeekanisa omu muringo ogurikukurataana, kubihuriiraana n’ebirikurimu, n’okushahoora ebirikubaasa kubaho.
answer_d: kugira ngu bashobore kushanga amakuru agambirwe, bagataagurira hamwe n'ebindi bitabo ebisaanaine, bagahuumuriza hamwe n'omuntu (abantu) abarikugambwaho, kandi bateekateeka aha makuru g'ekitabo omu bunuukiriza bwago.

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurira: Leonor ari omu mwaka gwa 3 ogw’eshomero kandi aine oburemeezi bw’okushoma. Kandi agyire okushoma nk’oku kirikugambwa, omwegi ashemereire kwongyera okwetwaza n’okuteekateeka aha kwega okushoma n’okuhandiika. Obwo emiteekateeki erikugamiirwa aha mutindo gw’obwomeezi etarikureeta by’omugasho, omwegyesa w’abaana abaine oburemeezi ateekateeka emiteekateeki endiijo erikwetwaza aha mbeera z’omwishiki. Nk’eky’okureeberaho, obwetegyeki bwe n’okugumisiriza n’ebintu ebirikureebwa. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, muteekateeki ki erikukwatana n’okukoresa Leonor?
answer_a: Manya omubungo bw'okubanza omu mazina arikukuhiga kuhandika omubungo obwo, omuhendereze akahandike omubungo ogwo ahabwe n'okuhimba ebigambo kuruga omuri bwo.
answer_b: Reeba omuhendo gw'ebicweka by'ebishushani eby'omutaano kumureetera kwesherura omuntu ou akunda munonga omu bishushani ebyo, ahandiike arikushoborora omuntu ogwo omu bwomeezi bwe n'omu biteekateeko bye.
answer_c: Shwijuma encyclopedia ez’omutaano kumureetera omutima gw’okukora nobushishozi n’okuhandiika infographic aha bintu ebirimu, orikureeba aha kutebeekanisa, okuhandiika, okuhereza, n’okushaba ekitabo.
answer_d: Shoma ekigambo oreebe enjegyane z'ebigambo egi kumuhiga kwombeka enjuba ezitari zimwe nazo, orikurora ngu aine kumanya eiraka ryazo kandi azijukye arikukoresa ebishushani.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omwegyesa w'abaana abaine oburemeezi bw'okwega akoresa ebipimo bya Piaget kushuuruura omwana orikwega omu mwaka gwa kabiri orikubaasa kworeka oburemeezi bw'okwega omu kubara. Kurugiirira aha kukoresa akatabo k'ebipimo "okukoresa obwingi", omwegyesa arikush conclusions ngu omwana ayorekire obwetengo bw'obuhwezi omu kukwata aha biteekateeko ebiri omu kipimo eki. Ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurataho erikukora aha bwetaago bw'obuhwezi bw'omwana omu mbeera erikushoboororwa?
answer_a: Ha omuhanda omuhanda gye abeesikare omubara eby'okurugaho ebirikukurira omwegi kutebeekanisa okukurikirana nk'emitwarize erikukwatana n'ebintu ebirikutaana
answer_b: Yamba omushorongo gw'emibaro orikukoresa ebishushani, kworeka omwegi okushusha n'okutaanisa.
answer_c: Koresa kaada ngu omwegyesa akoresa kukora ebitekerezo by'obwingi bw'ebintu kandi akorese emisingi "ekukira aha ki" na "ekutakira aha ki"
answer_d: Koresa kaada ezirikwata n'omubaro hamu n'emiti ya ayisikiriiti, omwegi asobole kworeka omukago "ogw'omwe aha omwe" kurugiirira aha bwingi obwoorekwa.

question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurataho: Omu mashomo g'ekibalangulo omu kiraasi ya 3, abegyesa nibakora n'abanyeshuri aha muringo gw'okutebeekanisiza emirimo y'okubalangura. Baine omwe aha mirimo, nibareeba ngu Renata, omunyeshuri orikugira oburemeezi bw'okwega omu kubalangura, aine obuyambi omu kwetegyereza n'okubalangura omu mutwe okwongyera hamwe emibaare eri haihi n'ekumi, nk'eky'okureeberaho, obwo arikukora ebintu nk'ebi 26+9 nari 54+28. Twaba niturora egi nshonga eri ahaiguru, muringo ki ogurikubaasa kugarukamu obuyambi obu omunyeshuri arikwenda?
answer_a: Baza omuhendo gw'ebintu, orikukoresa oburyo bw'okugyezaho ebibarizo
answer_b: Shuuruura omuganyulo gw'ekifo eki buri namba erimu erimu, omuhendo gw'okubanza n'okucwekyera namba
answer_c: Nyihaho amahame g'okuhindura omurongo n'okwegaita omu kubaririza, okukora myitooro aha muteekaniso gw'ebintu ebirikugattwa.
answer_d: Yijuza enamba ezirikwenda zigyenda zigyerereza hamwe n'ezirikuruga aha mukuru zigyenda zisherura, oijuze omu myanya etarikumanywa egi orikukoresa kwongyera obwinganiza bw'enamba.

question: Shoma omubaire: Ekikundi ky’abegyesa omu kiraasi ey’ab’eishomo rya kabiri bakakorera hamwe n’ekiraasi yabo aha mugingo gw’okwega ogurikukurataho: Kuhandiika n’okusharamura omuhendo kuruga ahari 0 kuhika 100 omu muringo gw’okwongyeraana, omu muringo ogurikureebwa, ogw’ebishushani, n’ogw’akabonero. Omu kubumbura emwe aha kiraasi, ekikundi kakeebwa ngu obuhwezi oburikukirayo obw’abamwe aha abegi bukaba nibwo ngu tibarikubaasa kumanya ngu obumwe 11 nibumwe nk’ekumi 1 n’obumwe 1. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, mugisha ki ogurikugamiirwa aha kukoresa ebikoreso by’okwegyesa ogurikukwata aha kuhikiiriza omugingo gw’okwega omu mbeera egi?
answer_a: Nyihamu kukomeza omuringo gw'okwongyera n'okugyenda omu maisho, orikukoresa enamba aha murongo n'ekikoreso ky'okubara (abacus).
answer_b: Yegyesereza omuringo gw'okugyenda omu bibinja n'okugyenda omu bibinja bisya, n'ebirikoresibwa by'omutaano n'edaasi.
answer_c: Yegyesereza okwongereza hamwe okurikukiraho, orikukoresa obucweka bw'amabara n'emirongo y'emibaro
answer_d: Yegyesereza kutebeekanisa namba omu mwirondoozo ogurikwemerera n'ogurikushuuruura, orikukoresa ekideke ky'ebikaati ebirimu namba okuhika ahari ...

question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurira:  Sebastian ni omwegyeshwa omu mwaka gwa kashatu, ahabw'enshonga z'obushwere, tarikumara obwiire bwingi omu ishomero. N'ekirikurugamu, okukura kwe omu by'okwegyesa kukiri ahansi y'okw'abegyeshwa abandi omu kiraasi ye. Nk'eky'okureeberaho, omu isomo ry'Ekibalangulo nibakora okwongyera enamba z'obutonde ezirikushaanisa omu buningi. Kwonka, omwegyeshwa tarikumanyira kimwe enamba z'obutonde n'emikora yaazo, narikwoleka obwetengo bw'obuhwezi omu kurondaanisa enamba kurugiirira aha muhendo gwazo n'omu kukora n'okugyenda.  Ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurira ezirikugarukamu obwetengo bw'obuhwezi bwa Sebastian?
answer_a: Koresa omuringo gw'ekiro kubanza kwega, shoma namba orikukoresa kaadi kandi ogyerekane n'okusharamura ebishushani orikukoresa eby'okuzimbisa eby'emisingye mingi kwongyera kumanyira, orikukoresa akabaho k'ebifo.
answer_b: Koresa omuringo gw'okuzana (gamification), yegyesa okwongyera hamu enamba z'obutonde orikukoresa ebabaati by'emizano kandi okoreshe data kuhamibya okwetaba kwe, orikurabira omu kusoomooza okurikugenda nikweyongyera kukomera.
answer_c: Koresa omuringo gw'okukora omulimo ogurikugyenderera aha purojekiti n'emiringo y'okumaraho oburemeezi, orikukoresa ebyombeko by'emisingi mingi n'emeza z'emibaro kworeka obwingi oburikwongyerwaho no kubugyeragyeranisa n'ebikaati by'ebishushani.
answer_d: Koresa omuringo gw'ebifo by'okwegera hamu n'ebizibu ebirikubaho omu magara, n'ebicweka ebirikukwatanisa hamu n'emigogo ya Cuisenaire, kwongyera amaani aha biteekateeko by'okugyenda omu maisho, okwongyera hamu, n'okwegata hamu, n'ebindi.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Abekibiina ky'abareeberezi b'eishomero erikuru ery'eby'obuhangwa hamwe n'omwegyesa w'abaana abaine oburemeezi, bareeba ngu abeeshuli nibenda kugira emiteekateeka y'obuteetantara kandi "nibeesigama aha mwegyesa" omu byombeko. Eki nikireebwa omu mwanya gwabo gw'emirimo bwanyima, ahabw'okuba okwetantara tikurikusiimwa kurungi kuruga omu matendekero. Noorekire eki, ni muringo ki ogurikugarukamu ebyetengo by'okushagika abeeshuli omu mbeera erikugambwaho?
answer_a: Hanga embeera z'omukura n'enkoresa y'oburyo bw'okubamanya ebiro by'okukora emirimo omu maduka g'emishomo.
answer_b: Baituura omugasho gw'okukura kw'omushinga n'okugira ngu bashoboorore kwetaba omu kubanza kutebeekanisa emirimo n'ebigyendererwa ebi birikukirwa omu nteerane.
answer_c: Higa omwebuzo aha bikubirwe n'ebikorwa ebyakozirwe omu mahangaano, nukwo beete omugisha gw'okwetaba omu bikorwa ebirikukorwa.
answer_d: Hwera omuhendo gw'obugumu n'omutindo gw'ebintu ebikolebwa omu maduuka g'emikono kwongyera aha muhamuro gwabo omu nkora?

question: Shoma omu mbeera egi: Omu kiraasi ey'abataano omu mashomero ag'omunsi yoona, omu isomo ly'Ebyafaayo, Eby'obutwaatsi, n'Ensi n'obuntu, nibarikukora aha kigyendererwa "ky'okushoboorora omuringo gw'okutwaara Amerika na Chile, kurugiirira aha bantu abakuru abarikwetaba, obutumwa obumwe, n'entaaro z'obusiraamu". Omu kuza omu maisho n'emikora, ekikundi ky'omu kiraasi kireebire ngu abanyeshuri abamwe, n'abo abaine oburemeezi bw'okushoma, n'obu barikugarukamu ebibuuzo omu kanwa, baine obukwaatsi omu kwijuka ebintu bikuru kuruga omu bwire bw'ebyafaayo, bahwera omu bwangu kwijuka ebyabaho, kandi niboreka obwetegyerezi bukye omu miringo yaabo ey'okwega. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, omuringo ki ogurikukwata aha byetengo by'obukwaatsi bw'abanyeshuri?
answer_a: Gyeranisa ebitegyerezo omu bitundu bikye kandi oreebiremu ebiri kukura omu bwangu.
answer_b: Ha omuhanda gw'okurondera n'okutebeekanisa ebiri omunda y'ebintu nari emigyenzo erikukwatana n'ebyo orikwega.
answer_c: Koresa oburyo bw'okwijutsya n'ebishushani ebirikukwasa kwandika ebi orikwega omu kubangurira amakuru.
answer_d: Yebuze ebibuzo ebirikutegyereza nari se okwebuuza ebibuuzo okwesigamizirwe aha by'okukora ebi orikukora okwesiga omubiri gw'ebirikukuruga omu mutwe.

question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurataho: Ekikundi ky’abegyesa ky’omu kicweka ky’ebyafaayo, eby’obutegyeki n’eby’embeera z’abantu omu kiraasi ya 4 nibatebeekanisiza omurimo gw’okutandika kwegyesa ekigyendererwa ky’okwegyesa “kushanga ebifo aha maapu kurugiirira aha namba z’ebifo (oburinganiza n’obureingwa)”. Okukora eki, baine kuteekateeka aha biteenwa by’ekiraasi ebi: - Abegi 20. - Okubaho kw’abegi abarikurwara endwaara ya ADHD n’oburemeezi bw’okwega. - Nibetaba omu mirimo erikukorwa n’amaani. - Nibatiina okukora ebitabo n’okushoborora omu kanwa. Kurugiirira aha biteenwa by’ekiraasi egi, murimo ki ogurikukora okutandika kukora n’ekigyendererwa ky’okwegyesa eki?
answer_a: Mukore n'abaana abeeskuuli omupaapa mwinja munene, nk'ogw'ekitaabo ky'ensi yoona, kubaase kushanga amahanga agariho, nibakwata aha kushiisha ahu agaherereziire.
answer_b: Muzane abeeshure omuzano gw'okubuurara aha kaadi, nk'ogw'okurwanisa omu nyanja, bashemere kukwata ebishushani aha kantu akarikworeka omwanya, kibayambe kwetegyereza ebiri omunda batakahurikiza.
answer_c: Mureke abeeshuri bakoreshe ebintu bya pulasitiki, nk'omupiira, bashobeho emigyera n'emisalaba, ekyo kibayambe kuhuura omugasho gwabyo aha businge bw'ensi.
answer_d: Shambaana n'abeeshuli kushangwa amahanga, nk'eky'okureeberaho, aha globe, nukwo bashobore kumanya omurongo gw'ahagati n'omurongo gwa Greenwich, nibabasiisa kwetegyereza ebi biteekateeko nk'obwemeerero.

question: Shoma omwegyesa w’eky’omukaaga nagyezaho kwongyera aha kumanya omu kusoma, okukira munonga, ekigyendererwa “Kukomeza kumanya omu kubanza kusoma ekitabo.” Omu kiraasi, harimu omwegi atarikuhurra orikugambira omu rurimi rw’ebikomo kandi aine oburemeezi omu kwongyera n’okuhikiza ebigambo. Omwegyesa nashanga ensibo y’oburemeezi obu omu buzibu bw’okuhikaana kw’ekikomo n’amanyiso. Noorekire aha mbeera eri ahaiguru, ni enyegyesa ki ehinguraine erikwija kuhwereera omwegi ou aine oburemeezi bw’okuhurra kutunguura ekigyendererwa?
answer_a: Ekiragiro: Hindura ebyahandiikwa n'orurimi oruhikire omu mbeera omwegi orikukora.
answer_b: Muhe obusome bw'okusoma omu maisho, ngu ashome omu ka yaabo atakashome omu class.
answer_c:
Omumaro ogurikukwata aha bigambo ebirikwenda kushoboororwa:

Ekyeshongoro eki nikikwata aha by'okugyeragyeranisa omu by'obutegyeki n'eby'obushomesha.

Ebigambo ebi nibiza kushoboororwa:

1. Okugyeragyeranisa: Okushwijuma ebintu bibiri nari okukiraaho reero orora oku birikushushana nari oku bitarikushushana.
2. Obutegyeki: Omuringo ogu ensi nari eihanga eririkutegekanisibwamu n'okutegyekwa.
3. Eby'obushomesha: Ebintu byoona ebirikukwata aha kushomesa n'okwega.
4. Omwetegyeki: Omuntu orikukora omu butegyeki.
5. Omwegi: Omuntu orikwega.
answer_d: Muhemu obugambo bumwe na bumwe obu ashemereire kureeba amakuru gaabyo omu kikundiizo ky'ebigambo atakatandika kushoma omu kiraasi:

question: Shoma eky’obuhabuzi obu: “Nibamanywa ahabw’oburemeezi oburikukiraho omu mikorere y’obwongo n’emitwarize, nk’oku kirikworekyerwa omu buhinguzi, embeera z’abantu, n’obushoboorozi bw’omuntu kukora ebintu ebirikukora. Eki nikitandika omuntu atakazaire emyaka 18” (AAIDD, 2011, p. 25). AAIDD (2011). Oburemeezi bw’Obwongo. Okushoboorora, Okutegyeka, n’Entebeekanisa z’Obuyambi bw’Abantu. Alianza Editorial. Omu biteekateeko ebi orikuza kutoorana niki ekirikukwatana n’obuhabuzi obu?
answer_a: Obumwe bw'ebintu ebirikukora emirimo etali emwe n'etali emwe
answer_b: Oburemeezi bw'omutwe
answer_c: Eky'obwengye
answer_d: Oburemeezi bw'omutwe (Autism Spectrum Disorder)

question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurira: Jose ni omwegi orikugira oburemeezi ori omu kiraasi ya kana omu ishomero erya buliijo aine obuhwezi, natwariramu omu kiraasi kandi omu Kubara naashobora kukora eby’okubara omuhendo gwa 1-20, arikukoresa ebintu ebirikukwatwa. Hati, ab’ekibiina ky’omu kiraasi nibakora aha mugingo gw’okwega “kworeka okwetegyereza ebicweka ebirimu 12, 10, 8, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2” kandi nibenda kucungura yaaba Jose naayetegyereza omugingo ogu. Kurugirira aha mbeera eyo, n’omuringo gwa kucungura ki ogurikwija kubasobozesa kumanya yaaba Jose yaahikiiriza omugingo gw’okwega?
answer_a: Kushushani ebiragiro by'ebicweka ebimanyisirwe omu mishushani y'ebirikoresibwa eby'omutwaro ogurikushushana n'omutwaro gwona hamwe n'omutwaro ogucweirwe.
answer_b: Okukora omwegereka omu bibinja abeeshuri barikutebeekanisa kaadi ezirikworeka emicwe aha murongo gw'omubaro ogurikukora.
answer_c: Kushushani omuhendo gw'ebicweka by'omugaati gw'amatama gw'okuzarwa ogurikushushana n'omugabo ogurikworekwa omu kabaro k'omurimo akaheebwa ekikundi ky'omu kicweka ky'okwegyeramu
answer_d: Kutebeeka omukoki gw'abantu 12 nooha Jose pizza y'okuzanisa ei ashemereire kugaburamu ebicweka bingana kugira ngu agabane n'abanywani be ab'omu kiraasi.

question: Ni engyenderwaho ki aha ezirikukurira omwana orikwega omu mwaka ogw'okubanza aine oburemwa bw'omubiri omu by'okushobera omu klasa?
answer_a: Teeka omwana emirimo erikumureetera kuteekateeka aha bintu ebi arikukora n’okureeba omugasho gwabyo
answer_b: Teeka emirimo erikukwatsya omwegi kucwamu kuraba omu bibuzo ebitaine eky'okugarukamu kimwe.
answer_c: Tebeekanisibwe omurimo gw'okuhameza omwana arikureeba ekyakozirwe, kandi agyende omu muringo murungi.
answer_d: Teeka emirimo omwana arikukora omu bwiire oburikugyenda nibukura, ahabwekyo ashemereire kwandika ebintu byona ebi aba ayegire, kubaasa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki arikwenda.

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurikira: Sofia aine emyaka ikumi, nayegyesa omu mwaka gwa kashatu, kandi aine oburemeezi bw’okwega. Omu by’okubara, nashobora kukora emirimo ehandiikirwe arikukozesa ebishushani kandi n’ayetegyereza emiramu mikuru y’ekibalangulo, narora ebyetengo by’obuhwezi omu kuhandiika emanyiso z’ekibalangulo. Omwegyesa we omukuru ari kukora omu kiraasi aha buhiro bw’okumaraho oburemeezi bw’okwongyera hamwe n’okukuraho. Kurugiirira aha kuhabura oku, niki aha bikorwa by’obwegyesa ekirikuhiga embaganiza y’obuhiro bw’okumaraho oburemeezi bw’ekibalangulo?
answer_a: Gambira abeshomesa kuteekateeka embeera ezi barikubaasa kukora ebizibu by'ekibalangulo.
answer_b: Shuuruura n'abeeshuri oburemeezi n'ebizibu by'emibaro ebyakozirwe ebyahwereirwe kare.
answer_d: Reeka omuringo ogurikushobora kwikiriza abeeshure kushoborora omuringo ogukozirweho kukora ekibuuzo ky'ekibalangulo

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omwegyesa w’eky’okubiri omu mashomero nagira ekihika ky’okukuraaza amagezi g’abeeshuri be okwetegyereza ebi barikushoma kuraba omu nshomo ezi zirikusomwa omuntu omukuru. Omu kiraasi harimu Sofia, omweeshuri aine oburemeezi bwa Down syndrome. Orurimi rwa Sofia rurikwetegyerezebwa; aine okwetegyereza kurungi sentensi ezirikwenda kandi ayoreka oburemeezi omu kwijuka ebi yaaba ashomire. Ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurataho erikuhwera Sofia kwijuka ebi yaaba ashomire erikukwatana n’okwetegyereza ebi arikushoma?
answer_a: Okuteerereza omugani ogumanyirwe n'omugani oguhindurirwe, abeeshuri bashobore kugugolorora hamu n'okuhereza amakuru ag'amazima ahagugwo
answer_b: Okukamuukamuza ebibuuzo ebikwata aha mutwe gw'ebyahandiikwa omukye kandi okugarukamu oraba omu kubanza ekishushani, nukwo abeeshuri bashobore kworeka eki barikumanyisa.
answer_c: Kugamba ebi orikuteekateeka aha bantu n'embeera eziri omu bishushani, oreebete omulingo ebiri omu kishushani birikukwatana n'ebyo abeeshuri barikumanya.
answer_d: Okushushani orukakuraza aha kitabo ky'okushoma eky'omutaano eki washomereire owaanyu, kwongyera amaani abegi b'ekibiina kukwata ebirimu omu mutwe.

question: Shoma omwana Romina omwegi orikugira oburemeezi bw’omu bwongo orikwija omu rukurato rw’okwegyesa emirimo. Ayoreka omulingo gw’okuteekateeka ogutali mwingi kandi ayoreka emicwe y’obutekereza. Omwegyesa w’abaana abarikwetaaga obuyambi bw’omutaano acwireho kuhwera Romina kutebeekanisa ebintu omu bwire bw’emisomo arikukoresa omulingo gw’okugyenda ‘obutambwe aha butambwe’ omu kubumbabumba emirimo. Twahirira aha mbeera egi, ahabwenki omulingo ogwo gw’okwegyesa guhwere Romina kwega?
answer_a: Nikirikukwasisa kutaaho emikago n'okukuza okuteekateeka okutahurirwa.
answer_b: Nikikomeeza obwengye n'okuta omutima aha bintu by'eshomero n'aha maka
answer_c: Nikukoresa omuringo gw'okwebembera omu miringo, nikyongyera okwetegyeka kw'emyeshuro ye.
answer_d: Eri kukora aha mirimo y'omutindo ogurikukurira omu muringo ogurikwetegyereza kucweekereza emicwe etarikuteekateekaho.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Agustan ari omu kiraasi kya 5 kandi aine ekizibu ky’obwongo obutahikire. N’ashobora kwetegyereza ebiri kugambwa byona kuruga aha bantu bakuru n’ab’emyaka nk’eye, kandi n’ayoleka omutima gw’okugamba. Kwonka, obuyambi obukuru obu arikwetenga bukwata aha kugamba okurikwetegyerezebwa. Twahirira aha mbeera ya Agusta­n, niki ekirikukwatana n’ebikorwa by’eby’oburezi ebirikukirayo kumubazaho obuyambi obu arikwetenga?
answer_a: Higa omwoyo gw'okugamba orikukiriziibwa ebishushani
answer_b: Yongera aha kweshongora n'okukoresa ebishushani
answer_c: Shagika kwongyera omugambagambo kuraba omu kubanza kwongyera ekintu nk'ekirikukuru.
answer_d: Kugumya ebirikugambwa orikukozesa ekishushani ky'ekintu ekituura

question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurikira: Vicente ni omwegi aine oburemwa bw’obwengye orimu Greedi ya 1 kandi aine obuhwezi oburikwetagisa omu kwetegyereza orurimi, nk’eky’okureeberaho, arikukora ebiragiro byangu ebi ahabwa omu kanwa, kugarukamu ebibuuzo, n’okwetegyereza ebyahandiikirwe ebisomwa omuntu ondiijo. Aha mirimo y’obwegyesa erikukurikira, niki ekirikuhwera omu kukuza okwetegyereza okugamba omu mwegi ogurikushoboororwa?
answer_a: Yongyera obwire bw'okugarukamu
answer_b: Ha omuhanda gw'okukuratira ogw'okuhindura ebiragiro omu bitundu
answer_c: Gamba kworeka omuringo gw'okuhurikiza n'okugarukamu omu bwire oburikwetagisa.
answer_d: Yongera obutumwa n'ebirikworeka ebirikukwasisa amatsiko

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Juan ni omwegyesa orikugyenda omu mwaka gw'okubanza omu ishomero ry'abaana abaine oburemeezi bw'omutwe. Omu kiraasi, orikumureeba ashoora amaisho kandi ayenda kwega; kwonka, ebi arikugamba tibirikwetegyerezebwa abatarikumumanya gye. Ayetegyereza ebishushani n'obubonero kandi atandika kushoma. Omwegyesa nacwamu ngu nikihangwa kumuhwera aha bi arikugamba kumuhereza oburyo bw'okugarukamu ebikorwa. Tukurahiire ebi, niki ekikoreso ky'omutegyeki ekirikuhwera kutunga ekigyendererwa eki omwegyesa arikwenda aha mwegyesa?
answer_a: Ekikoreso ekirikukwata ebishushani n'ebifaananyi kwombeka obubaaho bw'okuhurirana, Ndeka ngambe
answer_b: Ekyombeko ekirikukozesa ekikoreso ky'okuhandiika ekirikukwihaho kuhandiika ebigambo n'ebishushani omurundi gumwe, Araword
answer_c: Entoronto eririkumegyera aha kwegyesa okushoma n'okuhandiika omu maka, Okwega kushoma na Bartolo
answer_d: Pulogulaamu ekora aha bishobooro by'orurimi ebirikushushana (okushoma, okuhandiika, n'okugamba), Leo Primero

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Paz ni omwegi w’emyaka ena orikugira oburemeezi bw’omutwe orimu esomero ry’abaana bato eririmu obuhwezi bw’enjegyereza enshobeeki. Ayemerera ahabw’okwijuka ebintu ebi arikureeba, ahabw’okuba naijukira ebishushani bingi, obubonero, n’ebintu ebi arikureeba, kandi akakura omu mubiri omu muringo oguhikire aha myaka ye. Omwegyesa w’aha somero ry’abaana bato, hamwe n’omwegyesa w’enjegyereza enshobeeki, bateekanisa omurimo ogurikukwata aha mutima gw’okwetegyereza n’okwetungira: kworeka obwetungire omu miringo ye y’okwambara. Twaba niturora emitwarize ya Paz, ni engyenderwaho ki ezi orikukurataho, ezirikukorwa omwegi, ezirikukwata aha kwongyera okukura kw’obwetungire bwe omu miringo y’okwambara?
answer_a: Orambe buri kasheeshe orweshongoro orurikukworeka oku orikubaasa kwambara ekitambaara kyaawe omu muringo ogurikwera, norikukoresa obuhabuzi bw'okuhurira
answer_b: Gambaaza apron y'omunywani waawe, reero ogambare ogitureho, ogitureho orikwimba orw'omuko.
answer_c: Yambara epuroni ye arikwenda naakwata orwimbo orurikuhereekereza ebikorwa by’emotoka ebirikumwijutsya entaanira z’okukurata.
answer_d: Yambara epuroni ye arikukwata aha bwihuri bw’okuhurira arikukoresa obuhinduzi oburikumuha kwemerera okucweeka obucweko omuhanda murungi kandi yenyine.

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurataho: Federico ni omwegi ow’emyaka 8 aine oburemwa bw’obwengye, orikushoma omu kiraasi ya kashatu. Aine okuteekateeka okurikukwata aha bintu ebirikureebwa, kandi omwegyesa omu kiraasi akazura ngu omwegi aine obuhwezi obw’amaani okwetantara embeera z’akabi omu kiraasi n’aha kibanja ky’okuzanira. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, ni bumwe aha bw’okukuratira nibwo burikukwatanisa okwerinda kwa Federico?
answer_a: Gamba engano omuri purogyramu ezirikukwata aha mbeera z'okwerinda.
answer_b: Yorekye omulingo gw'okwerinda nk'omuntu, omuhandiizi akulore nk'eky'okurorraho, akigye omumulingo ogwo.
answer_c: Baahangire omugisha gw'okubakora eby'okweyamba obutoosha.
answer_d: Teeka omuringo gw'okukora ebintu bya buri izooba orikukozesa ebishushani kusobora kukora ebikorwa eby'okwejanjaba omu muringo ogutebeekaine.

question: Shoma omu mbeera egi: Ku kuhingura aha ishomero ry'abato, Camila aine endwara y'obwengye, kandi abakozi b'omu kicweka baine kukora Puroguraamu y'Okwegyesa Omuntu omwe kukuraasa obureezi bw'okushoma nari obushoboorozi bw'okutandika omu muringo gw'okushoma, okukiraho okureeba n'okutooroora, nibashoma ebi omwegi akunda. Kurugiirira aha muringo gw'okushoma ogurikukwata aha byona, niki aha bintu ebi ekirikukuraasa obushoboorozi bw'okushoma omu ntandikiro yaagwo?
answer_a: Ekitabo ky'omwana ekirimu ebigambo by'omugaso
answer_c: Koresa kaadi z'ebishushani n'ebigambo kwegamira ekishushani n'eiziina ry'omuntu orikukwatana nawe omu ka.
answer_d: Manya ebigambo ebirikumanywa omu nsi yoona, orikukoresa amaziina g'ab'eisheenzi be nk'ebigambo by'okwega.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omu mushomesho gw'omukaaga, abashomi nibakora aha buhinguzi bw'oburemeezi. Rodrigo, omushomi orikugira oburemeezi bw'omutwe, ayetenga obuhwezi ahabw'okuba akiri omu mutendera gw'okuteekateeka ebintu nk'oku biri. Ni engyenderwaho ki ezirikukurataho ezirikwongyera aha buhinguzi bw'oburemeezi kuruga omu muringo ogurikukora omu kubara?
answer_a: Teeka oburemeezi obwine ebizoobo bibiri nari eshatu ebirikumanyisa omuntu ekirikuba kyo kihikire.
answer_b: Yoreka ebizibu ebirikukwata aha kubara omuhandiiko n'okukoresa obubazi nk'obuhwezi omu kumara ebizibu ebyo.
answer_c: Teeka ebizooba ebirikukirirana omuhendo, okurikukurirana n'emitwarize y'omwegiisa omwe na omwe, orikukoresa ebintu ebirikukwatwa.
