question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Julieta ni omwegi ow'emyaka munaana orikugumirwa kwega, kandi ari omu kiraasi ya 2 omu ishomero eririmu enkoreso y'okwegyesa abegi boona hamwe. Omwegi ogu tarikumanyisa gye ebi arikugamba, agyenda gye n'abandi beegi, kandi atwariramu gye omu bintu. Omu ishomero ry'ebyobutonde, abegi nibaija kukora emicwe y'okuteeka n'enva ezirikuruga omu musiri gwabo, ebi barikuteeka nibaija kubikwata vidiyo hanyuma bashuuruure aha mukura gw'ishomero. Ni enki aha mpinduka z'omukura ezirikukurataho ezirikukwasa Julieta kwetwariramu omu murimo ogu?
answer_a: Julieta naayehereza aha kureeta kamera, naatwariramu n'okwetaba omu murimo nk'omutebeekaneza.
answer_b: Julieta akakora omugutaano gw'omumikono aha mutwe gw'ebirikukwataho, nk'ekitabo ky'amabina nari ekitebyerezo kandi akagishana.
answer_c: Julieta akakoresa empapura ezirikworeka ebigambo n'ebishushani ebirikushoborora eki arikukora nk'ekirikuzibaho
answer_d: Julieta akakora vidiyo omu ka, omuri yo arikushoborora ebintu arikukoresa emikono omu buringanire.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Jaime ni omwegi aine oburemwa bw’omutwe orikwega omu kiraasi eya 5. Omwegi ogu asanga emirimo etarikwetegereza egi eri hare n’amagara ge ga burijo ng’egumire. Ekibiina ky’omu kiraasi nikitebeekanisiza ebikorwa by’enaku enkuru z’eihanga kandi nikiteekateeka aha mugingo gw’okwega: Kumanya emiringo etari emwe ey’obuhangwa bw’eihanga n’ekicweka kyaryo. Ni engyenderwaho ki aha ezirikukurataho erikukwata aha bwetaago bwa Jaime obw’okumuhwera kutunga omugingo ogurikuteekateekwa ekibiina ky’omu kiraasi?
answer_a: Teera omuhendo gw'ebirikwenda, omu bicweka by'eby'oburezi, emizaano ya Chile nk'oku eri omu bitundu bya Chile ebirikushushana
answer_b: Tebeekanisiza ebyafaayo by'omu Chile ebirukiraine kandi bwanyima obibaanikire ab'eka yaabo
answer_c: Mukorere hamwe murikutebeekanisa ebyafaayo n'ebihimbo by'ihanga ryaitu omu biposta
answer_d: Gwetaba omu kwetebeekanisa n'okukora eby'okurya by'omuhanda gwabo, bwanyima babiyanjwire aha siteendi.

question: Ni engyenderwaho ki aha ezirikukurira omuntu omuto orikugira oburemeezi bw’obwongo kwetungira obugabe n’okucwamu ebi arikukora omu by’okweshemeza?
answer_a: Higa omwana omuto kwetaba omu bikorwa ebirikushemeza eby'omuriitaka ryabo, oronde ebishoboorozi bye ebirikukirayo.
answer_b: Hanga omuntu aha bw'omwana omuto, orikugambira omwegyesa omurimo gw'okweshemeza ogurikukwatana n'emitwarize ye.
answer_c: Tebeekanisiza enteekanisa erikukwata omuntu omwe nk'okuhendera aha kikundi ky'obwebemberane bw'okuhindura, ekirikugambira ekikundi ky'obwebemberane kworekana emirimo ey'omwana omuto arikukunda.
answer_d: Rooreramu orutonde rw'emikoreso y'okweshemeza omwana omuto arikubaasa kukora omu maka gabo n'omu kaaro, kumwemerera kugira eby'okucwamu, kwihaho eki arikukunda.

question: Omuhanda gw'okukora ogurikukwata aha muyeego gwa Gloria, n'oguha ogurikukuratira omuringo ogu?
answer_a: Eizooba ebirikukuratira aha bigambo by'omusingye n'emitwarize omwegi omu akoleera hamwe n'ebiteekateeko, okutuma amara n'okumanya ebimwetengo.
answer_b: Yoreka eby'okukora ebirikworeka ebishushani bikuru omu class yoona, ebirikugumya okwetegyereza kwa Gloria, hamwe n'ebirikworekwa ebi turikwija kukoreraho.
answer_c: Kurabura omu muringo gw'okukwata omuhanda, yombeka okutorana ebigambo ebishushana n'ebirikwihakanisa omubuuriro, noongyerera aha miko mikuru y'okutwara omuhanda omu bantu abarikukura hamwe.
answer_d: Mureke omwana areebye ekishushani eki yaabaire yaashoboororwa, omwegyesa amubuuze eiziina ry'ekintu eki, bwanyima omwegyesa agambe eiziina ry'ekintu eki, Gloria akimanye.

question: Shoma omwe orikukurataho: Karina omwegyesa omu mwaka ogwa kana omu mashomero agyezire, akazindurwa obureme bw'amaisho oburikukirira (high myopia) kuruga omu mwaka ogw'okutaano, aine amaisho 20/400 aha kipimo kya Snellen. Nayenda abantu abamurukiraine kandi n'abakwatanisa. Nakora ebintu byoona omu bwihangane kandi nashaba obuhwezi ku kirikwetagisa. Kurugiirira aha biri omu mbeera egi, kandi kurugiirira omu muringo ogurikwetenga obuhangwa bw'omuntu bwona, niki ekirikwetagisa okukora aha bw'okuhereza obuhwezi obw'omutaano Karina?
answer_a: Ashemereire kukomeza okukoresa obuhangwa bwa braille, kubaasa kukora emirimo ye y'eshomero.
answer_b: Ashemere kushoora kutandika kwega emiringo ya Hoover ahabw'okugyenda yenyine atarikwebemberwa.
answer_c: N’ashemeire kwongyerwamu ebipapura ebirikugambwa, ekitebe ky’okutuuraho, hamu n’emyeshorongo erimu omwanya mwingi aha bikorwa bye by’eshomero.
answer_d: Ashemere kushoora kutandika kwega ebikoresho by'obuhangwa bw'omugasho kumuhwera kugaragaza ebirikumumanyisa omu miringo etari emwe.

question: Shoma omugabe w’ekicweka ky’abanaishomero ab’omukaaga omu ishomero eririmu enteekaniza y’okwegyesa abantu boona naayenda kutoorana omukago ogurikukwata aha mbeera z’abantu omu kicweka kye. Omu baineishomero be harimu Raol, ou orikureeba atakazairwe. Atakahandiika enteekaniza, omwegyesa naashaba abaineishomero kugarukamu ekibuuzo eki: ninjwehurira ntya ntaineishomero bangye? Raol naagarukamu ati: Tindikwejura kurungi omu kicweka, nikiriyo oruyo rw’amaani. Tindikumanya orikungambira, nibakora eki ningwaaha kandi ninyomeera kubyetegyereza. Ninjwehurira ndi nyenka. Ni nteekaniza ki eyorikukora kutoorana omukago ogurikukwata aha mbeera z’abantu omu kicweka eki n’okuta Raol omunda?
answer_a: Ereeka omuhanda gw'okworeka abanywani b'eklassi, omu bwire bw'okuteekateeka, obujurizi kuruga omu bantu abaine oburemwa.
answer_b: Kora eby'okushusha nk'abantu abarikukora emirimo omu class, orikwoleka omuringo abanyeshuri bashemereire kwegamurana.
answer_c: Mubuuze abegi boona omu kiraasi kworeka omu ndimi zaabo oku barikwehurira omu kiraasi yaabo.
answer_d: Shutama e mizaanzi y'emizaano ey'omutaano omuhanda abeeshumi boona omu class bagashaaga omu.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Maria Ignacia ni omwegi owa 5 omuishomero eririmu programu y’okutwara hamwe abantu boona. Ahabw’oburemeezi bw’amaisho ahabw’endwaara ya retinitis pigmentosa eyakula munonga. Omu by’emirooro n’omutima, ayoreka omukago murungi n’abanywani be. Abegyesi b’omu kicweka, omu isomo ry’Orurimi n’Obuhangwa, nibaija kushwijuma ekigyendererwa ky’okwegyesa: “Okuhandiika ebyafaayo omu muringo murungi, ogw’obuhangwa, n’ogu butarikutebeekanisibwa.” Ahabw’ekigyendererwa eki, omwegyesa w’abaana abaine oburemeezi naagumya obuhangwa bw’okukora engyenderwaho z’okuhikaana ahabwa Maria Ignacia. Nooreeba aha mbeera egi, ngyenderwaho ki ezi ziriyo ezirikukirayo kuba nungi kushwijuma ebi Maria Ignacia yaayegire?
answer_a: Koragana n'omwegyesa omunywani waawe.
answer_b: Hanga ebyafaayo bye omu braille
answer_c: Mugambire eby'afaayo bye omu kamwa
answer_d: Guzaho orukuganiro omwegyesa arikushoborora.

question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurira: Roberto ni omwegi omupofu oraaherize kwetaba omu rukurato rw'okuteeka. Okuteeka buzima nikumushisha, kandi nayenda kukora omu kicweka eki. Kwonka, natina amagezi ge okukwata ebikoreso ebirikutsya, ekirikureeta oburemeezi omu kwega kwe. Omwegyesa w'enjegyereza y'abaana abaine oburemeezi omu rukurato akashaho ekigyendererwa eki: Kwega emiringo y'okwerinda omu kucwa n'okukwata eby'okurya kubaasa kuteeka omu bwesi n'obwerinzi. Eki nikimanyisa ngu ashemereire kukuriraana n'okugarukamu ebyo Roberto arikwetenga kumuhwera. Kurugiirira aha biri ahaiguru, murundi ki ogurikukwata gwa kumukuriraana n'ekigyendererwa eki ekirashairweho?
answer_a: Koresa omukoro gw'okutema ebijanjaaro orikukoresa omuringo gw'okukwata omukono aha mukono, orikurugiirira aha biragiro ebiri omu kunoonyereza kw'emirimo.
answer_b: Koresa ekikuumiro ky'engaro, n'ebirikuragirira, omuhanda gw'okukikoresa, omu kubazamu ebijanja n'ebibala aha rubaho rw'okutemaho
answer_c: Kuruga ebiragiro eby'omumwa kuruga omuhendeeza omu kubamba n'okucweeka emboga otarikukoresa ekikoomi ky'okucweekeraho, orikuraba omu kumanya omu kubataata.
answer_d: Koresa omuhendo gw'amaizi g'omuti n'ebicweka bya silikooni rundi goma y'omuti kworeka omuhanda gw'obwogi bw'ekyoma, reero oteme eby'okulya aha kapaati k'okutemeraho.

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurataho: Fernanda ari omu mwaka gwa 1 omwishomero eririkwenda obuyambi bw'omutaano omu by'okwegyesa. answer_b: Okushoma n'okuhandiika omu muringo gw'okuhandiika ogwa Braille

answer_d: Okushoma n'okuhandiika Braille aha ka easel n'ekitabo ekirikutsindika enyima ekinene

question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurataho: Sergio aine emyaka ikumi na mukaaga kandi ari omu mwaka gwa 3 ogw’ishomero ry’ebyemikono eririkwega eby’oburimi. question: Shoma omubazo ogurikukurataho: Omu mwaka gwa kabiri gw’eshomero erikuru, omwegyesa w’ekibaro naakora aha kiragiro ky’okwega ekirikukurataho: Kushoborora ebirikuhairwe kwenda eby’okukora emigongo y’ebintu. question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Mati­as ni omwegi orikureeba butoosha kandi ori omwaka gwa 1 ogwa Middle school. Ayoreka obwengye oburikuringana n'emyaka ye. question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurataho: Rodrigo, omwegi orikugwirwa obuhute bw'amaisho obw'okuburwa amaisho kuruga obu azaarwa, orikureeba obutundu bw'ebintu bikuru kandi ebi haihi, akingira esomero ry'abaana abato omu ishomero eririmu puroguraamu y'okwegereza hamwe, narikutunga obwegi obutongye omurundi gwe ogw'okubanza. question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurataho: Francisco azaarirwe ari empumi buzima kandi ari omu mwaka ogwa 6 omu ishomero eririmu obuhwezi bw'enjegyereza y'abantu abaine oburemeezi. answer_a: Hinga omwegyesa orikukuratira omwezi weena

answer_c: Ha Dami­an kompyuta erimu screen reader, erimu ebikwa­ta­ra­nye ebi­ne­en­e­za omu­g­ye­nd­e­rw­a­mu.

question: Shoma omu mbeera egi: Maria Luisa ari omu mwaka gwa kana omu ishomero eririmu enteekateeka y'okwegyesa abantu boona hamwe. Aine oburemeezi bw'amaisho ahabw'okuba aine endwara ya aniridia na horizontal bilateral nystagmus. Omu kiraasi y'ebyafaayo, geography, n'eby'obuhangwa, abegyesi nibaija kukora aha kiragiro ky'okwega ekirikukurataho: Kugaragura okubaho kw'ebintu ebirikureebwa n'ebyobutonde (nk'ensozi, emigyera, amarungu, ebishingo, obwire, n'ebindi) omu bintu ebirikureebwa ebitari bimwe omu kitundu kye. Kandi ahabw'ekyo, abegyesi bashemereire kutebeekanisa enteekateeka erikwija kuhwera Maria Luisa kwetaba. Ni nteekateeka ki erikwija kuhwera Maria Luisa kwetaba n'okuhikiiriza ekiragiro ekyo?
answer_a: Hanga omu bwiini, ebirangi by'emiteremo y'ensi etari emwe n'emwe.
answer_b: Teeka ekishushani ekirikworeka enshushani z'obutaka ez'omutaano omuhendo, orikukoresa ebintu ebirikukwatwaho.
answer_c: Hangaanira kaadi z’okushoboorora ezirikukwata aha mikiri gw’obutaka omu bwijwire
answer_d: Yombeka eky'okureeberaho ekiine obubonero oburikukwatwaho oburikugyenda nibukwatanisa ebishushani by'obutaka ebitaanuuraane

question: Omugyenzi Martina ori omwegyesa omu mwaka gwe kubanza owa secondary, akaba aine endwaire ya aniridia, ekwataine na nystagmus hamu na strabismus y'amaisho goona. Nayoreka omukago murungi n'abegyeswa abandi kandi atandika emikago omu kiraasi. Nayoreka obureezi obuhikire omu by'okukora ebi ayenda buri izooba hamu n'okumanya ahu arikugyenda, kandi ariyo omu muringo gw'okuhindura okuruga omu bihandiiko birikukwata ahari braille. Aha isomo ry'orurimi n'ebitabo, abari omu timu y'ekiraasi nibacwamu kukora aha mugyenderwwa gw'okwegyesa: Kumanya n'okwetegyereza abantu abahandiiki b'ebitabo abari omu biiriri ebirikushomwa kwongyera okwetegyereza kwe. Abari omu timu y'ekiraasi nibashaba abegyeswa kukora orupapura rwa PowerPoint, orurikworeka ebiriri by'enyimba ezirikushangwa, hamu n'obwengye oburikugyenda nazo, ezirikuhurikwa kandi zikashomwa buri omwe, ngu Martina n'awe ashobore kwetaba omu kutebeekanisa hamu n'okworeka. Ahabw'enki omuringo ogurikukoresibwa abari omu timu y'ekiraasi nigukwatanisa okuhikiiriza omugyenderwwa gw'okwegyesa oguratebeekanisibwe na Martina n'ekiraasi ye?
answer_a: Nibyoreka abeeshuri omugisha gw'okutunga amakuru kuraba omu miringo etari emwe, erikubaasa kutwariramu amakuru ag'okuhurira, ag'okureeba n'omugatte gw'ago goona.
answer_b: Nibyoreka abeeshuri omugisha gw'okwetungira, kuraba omu kuhindura omu muringo entebeekanisa nari obwire buraabe buhingurirwemu kureetera amasomo nari okusesa kw'amaisho kukura.
answer_c: Nibyoreka abeeshuri omugisha gw'okukora omuhanda gwabo, kuraba omu kukora empinduka omu byanya, hamu n'obumbeera omukikorwa, omurimo, rundi okusesa kikorwa.
answer_d: Nibyemerera abeeshuri kukora emirimo, ebikorwa, n'okucungura ebintu kuraba omu miringo etari emwe n'ebikoreso ebirikushushana nari obuhangwa n'eby'obuhangwa ebyombekirweho buzima

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Emilio ni omwegyesa owa klasse ya kabiri orikwoleka oburemeezi bw'orurimi obutari bumwe. question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurira: Amalia ni omwegi ow’emyaka ena orikugyemwa oburemeezi bw’okugamba, orikwega omu ishuri ry’abaana bato ery’orurimi. question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Gabriela ni omwegi owa 3 omuishomero eririmu eishami ry’okwegyereza hamwe abegi abarikukora gye n’abarikukora kubi, aine oburemeezi bw’orurimi obutari bumwe. answer_a: Teeka omu rubriiki okwetegyereza orurimi rw'emigani omu mbeera z'okubuurirana n'abantu.
answer_b: Kuratwara omusingi gw'obuhangwa bw'okugambirana ogurikukoresibwa omu kubuurirana.

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurataho: Danieli ni omwegyeshwa omu ishuri ry’abaana abato, orwaire endwaara y’orurimi erikaguraine, orikugyenda omu ishuri ry’orurimi. question: Omu bireeberezo by'okutaayaayira amagombe, omurimo ki ogurikukuriza omwana omweegi aine oburemeezi bw'orurimi kukura omu kukoresa orurimi omu bintu bye bwaine?

question: Ni enki aha mirimo egi egumya okuteekateeka aha biteekateeko (metacognition) omu banyeshuri abaine oburemeezi bw'orurimi obutaahukaine, obu barikukora omugisha gw'obutegeki bw'abantu boona: okutorana omukuru w'ebikoreso by'ekiro?

question: Omu buringaniza omuby’okukora etofaari y’obutonde, kuruga aha bikorwa ebi orikuza kwolesya, niki ekirikukora aha kuteekateeka kw’abegi bwamara kugihembera?

answer_d: Gamba eby'okukora ekitaafaari ky'obutonde, orondooze ebizibu n'eby'oyegire.

question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurataho: Claudio, omwegi orikugambwa ngu aine oburemeezi bw’orurimi, nayenda omurongo gw’okushatu omu ishomero eririmu puroguraamu y’okwegyereza hamwe. answer_b: Hindura omuringo omwegi arikugarukamu ebibuuzo abe ariyo nagarukamu na kamwa.
answer_c: Ha omuhendo gw'obwire bwingi omu kwebuzibwa okuhandiikwa
answer_d: Yoreka ebintu by'omugisha omu kworeka okucungura.

question: Omuganda gw'abegyesa bagyenzi baaba nibatebeekanisiza okwongyera aha mateeka g'okwetegyereza n'okumanya ebiri omu bitabo ebirimu amakuru aha bana bato aba 3 abarikugira oburemeezi bw'orurimi, murimo ki ogurikubaasa kubahikya aha kigyendererwa eki barikwenda?

question: Shoma omwegyesa owa gireedi ya mbere ateekaniziise omurimo gw'okushoboorora ahu abegi bashemereire kushuuruura omuhendo gw'obwengye n'omugasho gwabwo. answer_a: Orurimi nirwo rureetera omwana kugarukamu ebi arikwenda n'ebi atarikwenda, ebi arikwega kurabira omu muringo ogurikworeka omuntu eki arikukora.

answer_c: Orurimi n'ekintu ekirikurugamu obwengye, nikimanyisa ngu nirukwatana n'ebirikurugamu okukura kw'obwengye.
answer_d: Orurimi nigo mutwarwa mukuru gw'omulingo gw'okuhana n'okuhereza obwengye omu mbeera y'okuhurirana n'obusinge.
